function Sr(e) {
  return encodeURIComponent(e).replace(/[()!'*]/g, e => `%${e.charCodeAt(0).toString(16).toUpperCase()}`);
}
function Ar(e) {
  try {
    return decodeURIComponent(e);
  } catch {
    return e;
  }
}
function $r(e, ...t) {
  const n = t.filter(e => null != e && "" !== e).map(Sr);
  return `${_r}${e}/${n.join("/")}`;
}
function xr(e) {
  if (!e || "string" != typeof e || e.length > 4096) return null;
  const t = e.trim();
  if ("string" != typeof (n = t) || !n.toLowerCase().startsWith(_r)) return null;
  var n;
  const r = t.slice(7),
    o = r.indexOf("#"),
    s = r.indexOf("?"),
    i = Math.min(-1 === o ? r.length : o, -1 === s ? r.length : s),
    a = r.slice(0, i).split("/"),
    c = (a.shift() || "").toLowerCase(),
    l = a.filter(Boolean).map(Ar);

  const d = c;
  switch (d) {
    case "thread":

      if (l.length >= 3 && "message" === l[1]) {
        const e = l[0],
          t = l[2];
        return {
          kind: "message",
          id: `${e}/${t}`,
          segments: [e, t],
          uri: $r("thread", e, "message", t)
        };
      }
      return {
        kind: "thread",
        id: l[0],
        segments: [l[0]],
        uri: $r("thread", l[0])
      };
    case "message":
      {
        if (l.length < 2) return null;
        const [e, t] = l;
        return {
          kind: "message",
          id: `${e}/${t}`,
          segments: [e, t],
          uri: $r("thread", e, "message", t)
        };
      }
    case "file":
      {
        if (l.length < 1) return null;
        const e = l[0],
          t = l.slice(1).join("/");
        return {
          kind: d,
          id: t ? `${e}/${t}` : e,
          segments: [e, ...l.slice(1)],
          uri: $r("file", e, ...l.slice(1))
        };
      }
    case "model":
      {
        if (l.length < 2) return null;
        const e = l[0];
        return {
          kind: d,
          id: `${e}:${l.slice(1).join("/")}`,
          segments: [e, ...l.slice(1)],
          uri: $r("model", e, ...l.slice(1))
        };
      }
    case "plan":

        kind: d,
        id: l.join("/"),
        segments: l,
        uri: $r("plan", ...l)
      };
    case "artifact":

        id: l.join("/"),

      };
    case "tool":

        kind: d,

              const e = Zs.resolve("sqlite-vec"),
                n = U.dirname(U.dirname(e));
              o.push(U.join(n, t, r)), console.log(`[sqlite-vec] Dev path from require.resolve: ${U.join(n, t, r)}`);
            } catch (s) {
              console.log("[sqlite-vec] require.resolve('sqlite-vec') failed:", s);
            }
            for (const n of o) try {
              const e = Ue(n, {
                throwIfNoEntry: !1
              });
              if (e) return console.log(`[sqlite-vec] Found extension at: ${n} (size: ${e.size}, mode: ${e.mode.toString(8)})`), n;
              console.log(`[sqlite-vec] Path does not exist: ${n}`);
            } catch (s) {
              console.log(`[sqlite-vec] Error checking path ${n}:`, s);
            }
            try {
              const e = Zs("sqlite-vec");
              if ("function" == typeof e.getLoadablePath) {
                const t = e.getLoadablePath();
                return console.log(`[sqlite-vec] Using fallback getLoadablePath(): ${t}`), t;
              }
            } catch (s) {
              console.log("[sqlite-vec] Fallback getLoadablePath() failed:", s);
            }
            throw new Error(`sqlite-vec extension not found. Tried paths: ${o.join(", ")}`);
          }();
          console.log(`[sqlite-vec] Attempting to load extension from: ${r}`);
          try {
            e.loadExtension(r), console.log("[sqlite-vec] Extension loaded successfully");
          } catch (t) {
            throw console.error("[sqlite-vec] loadExtension failed:", t), console.error("[sqlite-vec] Error message:", t?.message), console.error("[sqlite-vec] Error code:", t?.code), this.initializationError = t, t;
          }
          this.createTables(), this.initialized = !0, this.initializationError = null, console.log("MemoryService initialized");
        } catch (r) {
          throw console.error("Error initializing MemoryService:", r), console.error("Error stack:", r?.stack), this.initializationError = r, r;
        }
      }
    }

    }

    }

    async rebuildEmbeddings(e, t) {
      if (!this.db || !this.sqlite) return {
        success: !1,
        error: "MemoryService not initialized"
      };
      if ("rebuilding" === this.rebuildProgress.status) return {
        success: !1,
        error: "Rebuild already in progress"
      };
      const n = this.db.select().from(ws).all();
      if (0 === n.length) return this.setStoredEmbeddingModel(e.model || "text-embedding-3-small"), {
        success: !0
      };
      this.rebuildProgress = {
        status: "rebuilding",
        total: n.length,
        current: 0
      }, this.rebuildAbortController = new AbortController(), t?.(this.rebuildProgress);
      try {
        const r = await this.generateEmbedding(n[0].content, e),
          o = r.length;
        console.log(`[MemoryService] New embedding model: ${e.model || "text-embedding-3-small"}, dimensions: ${o}`), this.sqlite.exec("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS memory_embeddings"), this.sqlite.exec(`\n                CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE memory_embeddings USING vec0(\n                    memory_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n                    embedding FLOAT[${o}]\n                )\n            `);
        const s = JSON.stringify(r);
        this.sqlite.exec(`\n                INSERT INTO memory_embeddings (memory_id, embedding)\n                VALUES ('${n[0].id}', '${s}')\n            `), this.rebuildProgress.current = 1, t?.(this.rebuildProgress);
        const i = n.slice(1);
        let a = 1;
        const c = async t => {
            if (this.rebuildAbortController?.signal.aborted) return null;
            try {
              const n = await this.generateEmbedding(t.content, e);
              return {
                id: t.id,
                embedding: n
              };
            } catch (n) {
              return console.error(`Error rebuilding embedding for memory ${t.id}:`, n), null;
            }
          },
          l = async e => {
            const n = await Promise.all(e.map(c));
            for (const r of n) {
              if (r) {
                const e = JSON.stringify(r.embedding);
                this.sqlite.exec(`\n                            INSERT INTO memory_embeddings (memory_id, embedding)\n                            VALUES ('${r.id}', '${e}')\n                        `);
              }
              a++, this.rebuildProgress.current = a, t?.(this.rebuildProgress);
            }
          };
        for (let e = 0; e < i.length; e += 10) {
          if (this.rebuildAbortController?.signal.aborted) throw new Error("Rebuild cancelled");
          const t = i.slice(e, e + 10);
          await l(t);
        }
        return this.setStoredEmbeddingModel(e.model || "text-embedding-3-small"), this.rebuildProgress.status = "completed", t?.(this.rebuildProgress), {
          success: !0
        };
      } catch (r) {
        return this.rebuildProgress.status = "error", this.rebuildProgress.error = r.message, t?.(this.rebuildProgress), {
          success: !1,
          error: r.message
        };
      } finally {
        this.rebuildAbortController = null;
      }
    }
    cancelRebuild() {
      this.rebuildAbortController && this.rebuildAbortController.abort();
    }
    resetRebuildProgress() {
      this.rebuildProgress = {
        status: "idle",
        total: 0,
        current: 0
      };
    }
    async generateEmbedding(e, t) {
      if ("local" === t.type) {
        const {
          localEmbeddingService: r
        } = await Promise.resolve().then(() => rE);
        try {
          return await r.generateEmbedding(e, t.model);
        } catch (n) {
          const e = n instanceof Error ? n.message : String(n);
          throw new Error(`Local embedding model "${t.model}" failed to load (${e}). This usually means the model couldn't be downloaded from HuggingFace. Check your network, or switch to a remote embedding provider (e.g. SiliconFlow BAAI/bge-m3, OpenAI text-embedding-3-small) in Settings → Memory.`);
        }
      }
      return "google" === t.type ? this.generateGoogleEmbedding(e, t) : this.generateOpenAIEmbedding(e, t);
    }
    async generateOpenAIEmbedding(e, t) {
      const n = t.baseURL || "https://api.openai.com/v1",
        r = t.model || "text-embedding-3-small",
        o = {
          "Content-Type": "application/json"
        };
      t.apiKey && (o.Authorization = `Bearer ${t.apiKey}`);
      const s = await Ma(`${n}/embeddings`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: o,
        body: JSON.stringify({
          input: e,
          model: r
        })
      });
      if (!s.ok) {
        const e = await s.text();
        throw new Error(`Embedding API error: ${s.status} - ${e}`);
      }
      return (await s.json()).data[0].embedding;
    }
    async generateGoogleEmbedding(e, t) {
      const n = t.model || "text-embedding-004",
        r = `${t.baseURL || "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta"}/models/${n}:embedContent?key=${t.apiKey}`,
        o = await Ma(r, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: {
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            model: `models/${n}`,
            content: {
              parts: [{
                text: e
              }]
            }
          })
        });
      if (!o.ok) {
        const e = await o.text();
        throw new Error(`Google Embedding API error: ${o.status} - ${e}`);
      }
      return (await o.json()).embedding.values;
    }

    async addMemoryWithLLMDedup(e, t, n, r) {
      if (!this.db || !this.sqlite) throw new Error("MemoryService not initialized");
      const o = e.trim();
      if (!o) return {
        memory: null,
        skipped: !0,
        reason: "empty content"
      };
      const s = await this.searchMemories(t, {
        limit: r?.candidateLimit ?? 5,
        threshold: r?.candidateThreshold ?? .3,
        userIds: r?.userIds
      });
      if (s.length > 0) {
        console.log(`[Memory] Dedup: ${s.length} similar candidate(s)`), s.forEach((e, t) => {
          console.log(`[Memory]   ${t + 1}. score=${e.score.toFixed(3)}: "${e.content.substring(0, 60)}..."`);
        });
        const e = s.map((e, t) => `${t + 1}. ${"temporary" === e.metadata.durability ? "[temporary]" : "[permanent]"} ${e.content} ${Hs(e)}`).join("\n"),
          t = `${js}\n\nNew memory to add: "${o}" ${Hs({
            createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
            metadata: r?.metadata
          })}\n\nExisting memories in the database:\n${e}\n\nIs the new memory essentially a duplicate of any existing memory? Consider it a duplicate if ANY of these hold:\n- It carries the same core fact (even if worded differently).\n- It is a subset of an existing memory (the existing one already implies it) — adding it would be redundant.\n- It is a vaguer or noisier restatement of an existing, cleaner memory.\n\nIt is NOT a duplicate if it adds a materially new fact, constraint, or detail not present in any existing memory.\n\nRespond with ONLY a JSON object:\n- If duplicate: {"isDuplicate": true, "reason": "brief explanation", "duplicateOf": <number>}\n- If not duplicate: {"isDuplicate": false}\n\nPrefer keeping the store clean: when the new memory adds no genuinely new information, mark it a duplicate.`;
        try {
          const e = await ke({
            model: n,
            messages: [{
              role: "user",
              content: t
            }]
          });
          console.log(`[Memory] Dedup LLM response: ${e.text}`);
          const r = e.text.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/);
          if (r) try {
            const e = JSON.parse(r[0]);
            if (!0 === e.isDuplicate) {
              const t = "number" == typeof e.duplicateOf ? e.duplicateOf - 1 : -1,
                n = t >= 0 ? s[t] : void 0,
                r = e.reason || (n ? `duplicate of #${t + 1}` : "LLM marked as duplicate");
              return console.log(`[Memory] Skipping duplicate — ${r}`), {
                memory: null,
                skipped: !0,
                reason: r,
                duplicateOf: n ? {
                  id: n.id,
                  content: n.content,
                  score: n.score
                } : void 0
              };
            }
          } catch {
            console.log("[Memory] Failed to parse dedup response, proceeding with add");
          }
        } catch (i) {
          console.error("[Memory] Dedup LLM call failed, proceeding with add:", i);
        }
      }
      return {
        memory: await this.addMemory(o, t, r),
        skipped: !1
      };
    }
    async searchMemories(e, t) {
      if (!this.db || !this.sqlite) throw new Error("MemoryService not initialized");
      this.ensureVectorTableDimensions(e.length);
      const n = t?.limit || 10,
        r = t?.threshold || 0,
        o = JSON.stringify(e),
        s = this.sqlite.prepare("\n            SELECT\n                memory_id,\n                1 - vec_distance_cosine(embedding, ?) as score\n            FROM memory_embeddings\n            WHERE score >= ?\n            ORDER BY score DESC\n            LIMIT ?\n        ").all(o, r, n);
      if (0 === s.length) return [];
      const i = s.map(e => e.memory_id),
        a = new Map(s.map(e => [e.memory_id, e.score]));
      let c = this.db.select().from(ws).where(re`${ws.id} IN (${re.join(i.map(e => re`${e}`), re`, `)})`).all();
      if (t?.userIds && t.userIds.length > 0) {
        const e = new Set(t.userIds);
        c = c.filter(t => !t.userId || e.has(t.userId));
      } else t?.userId && (c = c.filter(e => !e.userId || e.userId === t.userId));
      t?.threadId && (c = c.filter(e => e.threadId === t.threadId)), t?.tags && t.tags.length > 0 && (c = c.filter(e => {
        const n = e.metadata.tags || [];
        return t.tags.some(e => n.includes(e));
      }));
      const l = c.map(e => ({
          ...e,
          score: a.get(e.id) || 0
        })).sort((e, t) => t.score - e.score),
        d = new Date().toISOString();
      for (const u of l) {
        const e = u.metadata,
          t = {
            ...e,
            lastAccessedAt: d,
            accessCount: (e.accessCount || 0) + 1
          };
        this.db.update(ws).set({
          metadata: t,
          updatedAt: d
        }).where(oe(ws.id, u.id)).run();
      }
      return l;
    }

    findExactDuplicateGroups(e) {
      if (!this.db) throw new Error("MemoryService not initialized");
      const t = e?.crossNamespace ?? !0,
        n = this.db.select().from(ws).all(),
        r = new Map();
      for (const s of n) {
        const e = Js(s.content);
        if (!e) continue;
        const n = JSON.stringify([e, qs(s)]),
          o = t ? n : `${s.userId ?? "__null__"}\0${n}`,
          i = r.get(o);
        i ? i.push(s) : r.set(o, [s]);
      }
      const o = [];
      for (const s of r.values()) s.length < 2 || (s.sort((e, t) => Qs(t) - Qs(e)), o.push({
        survivor: s[0],
        duplicates: s.slice(1)
      }));
      return o;
    }
    findExpiredTemporary(e) {
      if (!this.db) throw new Error("MemoryService not initialized");
      const t = Date.now(),
        n = 24 * e * 60 * 60 * 1e3;
      return this.db.select().from(ws).all().filter(e => {
        const r = e.metadata;
        if ("temporary" !== r.durability) return !1;
        if (r.expiresAt) {
          const e = Date.parse(r.expiresAt);
          if (!Number.isNaN(e) && e < t) return !0;
        }
        const o = Date.parse(e.createdAt);

  migrateProvidersTableRemoveTypeConstraint() {
    if (this.sqlite) try {
      const t = this.sqlite.prepare("\n                INSERT INTO providers (id, name, type, api_key, models, enabled, created_at, updated_at)\n                VALUES ('__type_constraint_test__', 'test', '__test_type__', '', '[]', 0, '', '')\n            ");
      try {
        return t.run(), void this.sqlite.prepare("DELETE FROM providers WHERE id = '__type_constraint_test__'").run();
      } catch (e) {
        if (!(e instanceof Error && e.message.includes("CHECK constraint failed"))) throw e;
        console.log("Migrating providers table to remove type CHECK constraint...");
      }
      this.sqlite.exec("BEGIN TRANSACTION");
      try {
        this.sqlite.exec("\n                    CREATE TABLE providers_new (\n                        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n                        name TEXT NOT NULL,\n                        type TEXT NOT NULL,\n                        api_key TEXT NOT NULL,\n                        models TEXT NOT NULL,\n                        base_url TEXT,\n                        enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n                        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n                        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL\n                    )\n                "), this.sqlite.exec("\n                    INSERT INTO providers_new (id, name, type, api_key, models, base_url, enabled, created_at, updated_at)\n                    SELECT id, name, type, api_key, models, base_url, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM providers\n                "), this.sqlite.exec("DROP TABLE providers"), this.sqlite.exec("ALTER TABLE providers_new RENAME TO providers"), this.sqlite.exec("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_providers_type ON providers(type)"), this.sqlite.exec("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_providers_enabled ON providers(enabled)"), this.sqlite.exec("COMMIT"), console.log("Successfully removed type CHECK constraint from providers table");
      } catch (e) {
        throw this.sqlite.exec("ROLLBACK"), e;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Error during providers table migration to remove type constraint:", e);
    }
  }
  hasMigrationRun(e) {
    if (!this.sqlite) return !1;
    try {
      return !!this.sqlite.prepare("SELECT 1 FROM migrations WHERE name = ?").get(e);
    } catch {
      return !1;
    }
  }
  migrateAihubmixBackupDomain() {
    if (!this.sqlite) return;
    const e = "aihubmix_backup_domain_v1";
    if (!this.hasMigrationRun(e)) try {
      const t = this.sqlite.prepare("SELECT id, base_url FROM providers WHERE type = 'aihubmix'").all(),
        n = this.sqlite.prepare("UPDATE providers SET base_url = ? WHERE id = ?");
      let r = 0;
      for (const e of t) Hr(e.base_url) && (r += n.run(jr, e.id).changes);
      r > 0 && console.log(`Migrated ${r} AiHubMix provider(s) to the backup request domain`), this.markMigrationComplete(e);
    } catch (t) {
      console.error("Error migrating AiHubMix request domain:", t);
    }
  }
  markMigrationComplete(t) {
    if (this.sqlite) try {
      this.sqlite.prepare("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO migrations (name, executed_at) VALUES (?, ?)").run(t, new Date().toISOString());
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(`Failed to mark migration ${t} as complete:`, e);
    }
  }
  migrateDuplicatePredefinedProviders() {
    if (!this.sqlite) return;
    const e = "duplicate_predefined_providers_v1";
    if (this.hasMigrationRun(e)) return;
    const t = ["openai", "anthropic", "gemini", "openrouter"];
    for (const r of t) try {
      const e = "gemini" === r ? "google" : r,
        t = this.sqlite.prepare("SELECT * FROM providers WHERE type = ? ORDER BY created_at ASC").all(e);
      if (t.length <= 1) continue;
      console.log(`Found ${t.length} duplicate providers of type ${e}, cleaning up...`);
      const n = t.find(e => e.id === r);
      if (n) {
        for (const o of t) if (o.id !== r) {
          if (o.api_key && !n.api_key) {
            const e = n.enabled || o.enabled ? 1 : 0;
            this.sqlite.prepare("UPDATE providers SET api_key = ?, base_url = ?, models = ?, enabled = ? WHERE id = ?").run(o.api_key, o.base_url, o.models, e, r), console.log(`Merged config from duplicate ${o.id} into ${r}`);
          }
          this.sqlite.prepare("DELETE FROM providers WHERE id = ?").run(o.id), console.log(`Deleted duplicate provider ${o.id} (type: ${e})`);
        }
      } else {
        const n = t.find(e => e.api_key) || t[0];
        this.sqlite.prepare("UPDATE providers SET id = ? WHERE id = ?").run(r, n.id), console.log(`Migrated provider ${n.id} -> ${r}`);
        for (const o of t) if (o.id !== n.id) {
          if (o.api_key) {
            const e = this.sqlite.prepare("SELECT * FROM providers WHERE id = ?").get(r);
            if (!e.api_key) {
              const t = e.enabled || o.enabled ? 1 : 0;
              this.sqlite.prepare("UPDATE providers SET api_key = ?, base_url = ?, models = ?, enabled = ? WHERE id = ?").run(o.api_key, o.base_url, o.models, t, r), console.log(`Merged config from duplicate ${o.id} into ${r}`);
            }
          }
          this.sqlite.prepare("DELETE FROM providers WHERE id = ?").run(o.id), console.log(`Deleted duplicate provider ${o.id} (type: ${e})`);
        }
      }
    } catch (n) {
      console.error(`Error migrating provider ${r}:`, n);
    }
    this.markMigrationComplete(e);
  }
  migrateProviderAvailableModels() {
    if (this.sqlite) try {
      try {
        this.sqlite.exec("ALTER TABLE providers ADD COLUMN available_models TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'"), console.log("Added available_models column to providers table");
      } catch (e) {}
      const n = this.sqlite.prepare("SELECT * FROM providers").all();
      for (const e of n) try {
        let t = [];
        try {
          t = JSON.parse(e.available_models || "[]");
        } catch {
          t = [];
        }
        let n = [];
        try {
          n = JSON.parse(e.models || "[]");
        } catch {
          n = [];
        }
        if (n = (Array.isArray(n) ? n : []).map(e => "string" == typeof e ? {
          id: e
        } : e).filter(e => "string" == typeof e?.id && e.id.length > 0), t.length > 0) {
          const r = t.filter(e => "string" == typeof e?.id && e.id.length > 0);
          let o = r.length !== t.length;
          t = r;
          const s = new Set(t.map(e => e.id));
          for (const i of n) s.has(i.id) || (t.push({
            id: i.id,
            name: i.name || i.id,
            capabilityOverrides: i.capabilities || i.capabilityOverrides,
            isManual: !0
          }), o = !0, console.log(`Added missing enabled model ${i.id} to available_models for provider ${e.id}`));
          o && this.sqlite.prepare("UPDATE providers SET available_models = ? WHERE id = ?").run(JSON.stringify(t), e.id);
          continue;
        }
        const r = this.sqlite.prepare("SELECT * FROM provider_models_cache WHERE provider_id = ? ORDER BY fetched_at DESC LIMIT 1").get(e.id);
        let o = [];
        if (r) try {
          o = JSON.parse(r.models || "[]"), console.log(`Migrated ${o.length} models from cache for provider ${e.id}`);
        } catch {
          o = [];
        }
        const s = new Set(o.map(e => e.id));
        for (const i of n) s.has(i.id) || (o.push({
          id: i.id,
          name: i.name || i.id,
          capabilityOverrides: i.capabilities || i.capabilityOverrides,
          isManual: !0
        }), console.log(`Added enabled model ${i.id} as manual model for provider ${e.id}`));
        o.length > 0 && (this.sqlite.prepare("UPDATE providers SET available_models = ? WHERE id = ?").run(JSON.stringify(o), e.id), console.log(`Saved ${o.length} available models for provider ${e.id}`));
      } catch (t) {
        console.error(`Error migrating available_models for provider ${e.id}:`, t);
      }
      console.log("Provider available_models migration completed");
    } catch (t) {
      console.error("Error during provider available_models migration:", t);
    }
  }
  migrateProviderModelsToIds() {
    if (!this.sqlite) return;
    const e = "provider_models_to_ids_v1";
    if (!this.hasMigrationRun(e)) try {
      const n = this.sqlite.prepare("SELECT id, models, available_models FROM providers").all();
      for (const e of n) try {
        let t = [];
        try {
          t = JSON.parse(e.models || "[]");
        } catch {
          t = [];
        }
        if (0 === t.length || "string" == typeof t[0]) continue;
        const n = t.map(e => "string" == typeof e ? e : e.id).filter(Boolean);
        let r = [];
        try {
          r = JSON.parse(e.available_models || "[]");
        } catch {
          r = [];
        }
        const o = new Map(r.map(e => [e.id, e]));
        let s = !1;
        for (const e of t) {
          if ("object" != typeof e || !e.id) continue;
          const t = o.get(e.id);
          t ? (e.capabilities && Object.keys(e.capabilities).length > 0 && (t.capabilityOverrides = {
            ...t.capabilityOverrides,
            ...e.capabilities
          }, s = !0), e.providerOptions && Object.keys(e.providerOptions).length > 0 && (t.providerOptions = {
            ...t.providerOptions,
            ...e.providerOptions
          }, s = !0)) : (r.push({
            id: e.id,
            name: e.name || e.id,
            capabilityOverrides: e.capabilities,
            providerOptions: e.providerOptions,
            isManual: !0
          }), s = !0);
        }
        s ? this.sqlite.prepare("UPDATE providers SET models = ?, available_models = ? WHERE id = ?").run(JSON.stringify(n), JSON.stringify(r), e.id) : this.sqlite.prepare("UPDATE providers SET models = ? WHERE id = ?").run(JSON.stringify(n), e.id), console.log(`Migrated provider ${e.id}: models converted from ${t.length} objects to ${n.length} IDs`);
      } catch (t) {
        console.error(`Error migrating models for provider ${e.id}:`, t);
      }
      this.markMigrationComplete(e), console.log("Provider models to IDs migration completed");
    } catch (t) {
      console.error("Error during provider models to IDs migration:", t);
    }
  }
  migrateMCPOAuthTokensRemoveForeignKey() {
    if (!this.sqlite) return;
    const t = "mcp_oauth_tokens_remove_fk_v1";
    if (!this.hasMigrationRun(t)) try {
      if (!this.sqlite.prepare("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='mcp_oauth_tokens'").get()) return void this.markMigrationComplete(t);
      const n = this.sqlite.prepare("SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='mcp_oauth_tokens'").get();
      if (!n || !n.sql.includes("REFERENCES")) return void this.markMigrationComplete(t);
      console.log("Migrating mcp_oauth_tokens table to remove foreign key constraint..."), this.sqlite.exec("BEGIN TRANSACTION");
      try {
        this.sqlite.exec("\n                    CREATE TABLE mcp_oauth_tokens_new (\n                        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n                        server_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n                        authorization_server_url TEXT,\n                        resource_url TEXT,\n                        client_id TEXT,\n                        client_secret TEXT,\n                        client_id_issued_at INTEGER,\n                        client_secret_expires_at INTEGER,\n                        access_token TEXT,\n                        refresh_token TEXT,\n                        token_type TEXT,\n                        expires_at INTEGER,\n                        scope TEXT,\n                        code_verifier TEXT,\n                        last_refresh_at TEXT,\n                        last_error_at TEXT,\n                        last_error TEXT,\n                        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n                        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL\n                    )\n                "), this.sqlite.exec("\n                    INSERT INTO mcp_oauth_tokens_new\n                    SELECT * FROM mcp_oauth_tokens\n                "), this.sqlite.exec("DROP TABLE mcp_oauth_tokens"), this.sqlite.exec("ALTER TABLE mcp_oauth_tokens_new RENAME TO mcp_oauth_tokens"), this.sqlite.exec("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_mcp_oauth_tokens_server_id ON mcp_oauth_tokens(server_id)"), this.sqlite.exec("COMMIT"), this.markMigrationComplete(t), console.log("Successfully removed foreign key constraint from mcp_oauth_tokens table");
      } catch (e) {
        throw this.sqlite.exec("ROLLBACK"), e;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Error during mcp_oauth_tokens foreign key migration:", e);
    }
  }

  createFtsTable() {
    if (this.sqlite) try {
      const e = this.sqlite.prepare("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='messages_fts'").get();
      let t = !1;
      if (e) {
        this.sqlite.exec("\n                    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fts_metadata (\n                        key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n                        value TEXT NOT NULL\n                    )\n                ");
        const e = this.sqlite.prepare("SELECT value FROM fts_metadata WHERE key = 'version'").get();
        (e ? parseInt(e.value, 10) : 0) < 6 && (t = !0, this.sqlite.exec("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS messages_fts"), console.log("Dropping old FTS table for recreation with jieba segmentation"));
      }
      const n = !e || t;
      this.sqlite.exec("\n                CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS messages_fts USING fts5(\n                    message_id UNINDEXED,\n                    thread_id UNINDEXED,\n                    content\n                )\n            "), this.sqlite.exec("\n                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fts_metadata (\n                    key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n                    value TEXT NOT NULL\n                )\n            ");
      const r = this.sqlite.prepare("SELECT value FROM fts_metadata WHERE key = 'version'").get(),
        o = r ? parseInt(r.value, 10) : 0;
      (n || o < 6) && ((this.sqlite.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM chat_messages").get().count > 0 || o < 6) && (console.log(`FTS rebuild needed: isNewTable=${n}, currentVersion=${o}, targetVersion=6`), this.rebuildFtsIndex()), this.sqlite.prepare("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO fts_metadata (key, value) VALUES ('version', ?)").run(String(6)));
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Error creating FTS table:", e);
    }
  }
  rebuildFtsIndex() {
    if (this.sqlite) try {
      const e = this.sqlite.prepare("SELECT id, thread_id FROM chat_messages").all(),
        t = this.sqlite.prepare("SELECT message FROM chat_messages WHERE id = ?"),

      n = (Array.isArray(t?.parts) ? t.parts : void 0) || (Array.isArray(t?.content) ? t.content : void 0);

  }

  extractToolPartImage(e) {
    if (!e || "object" != typeof e) return null;
    const t = e;
    if ("string" != typeof t.type || !t.type.startsWith("tool-") && "dynamic-tool" !== t.type) return null;

      r = "string" == typeof n.mime_type && n.mime_type.startsWith("image/") ? n.mime_type : "image/jpeg",

      mediaType: r,
      filename: s,
      url: `data:${r};base64,${n.image_base64}`

      mediaType: r,
      filename: s,
      url: `http://localhost/api/gallery/cache/${n.image_cache_file}`
    } : null;
  }

  computeImageMetadataForPart(t, r, o, s) {
    if (!r || !o) return null;
    const i = r.indexOf("/api/gallery/cache/");
    if (-1 !== i) {
      const e = r.slice(i + 19).split(/[?#]/)[0];
      if (!e) return null;
      const t = n?.getPath ? n.getPath("userData") : process.cwd(),
        o = K.join(t, "gallery_cache", e);
      if (s && s.file_path === o && null != s.width && null != s.height) return {
        width: s.width,
        height: s.height,
        aspectRatio: s.aspect_ratio,
        filePath: o
      };
      let a, c;
      try {
        const e = he(_.readFileSync(o));
        a = e.width || void 0, c = e.height || void 0;
      } catch {}
      return {
        width: a ?? null,
        height: c ?? null,
        aspectRatio: (a && c ? c / a : void 0) ?? null,
        filePath: o
      };
    }
    if (!r.startsWith("data:")) return null;
    if (s?.file_path && null != s.width && null != s.height && _.existsSync(s.file_path)) return {
      width: s.width,
      height: s.height,
      aspectRatio: s.aspect_ratio,
      filePath: s.file_path
    };
    const a = r.match(/^data:(.+?);base64,(.+)$/);
    if (!a) return null;
    const c = a[1],
      l = a[2];
    let d, u, h;
    try {
      d = Buffer.from(l, "base64");
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
    try {
      const e = he(d);
      u = e.width || void 0, h = e.height || void 0;
    } catch {}
    const p = u && h ? h / u : void 0,
      f = n?.getPath ? n.getPath("userData") : process.cwd(),
      m = K.join(f, "gallery_cache"),
      g = this.mimeToExtension(c),
      y = K.join(m, `${t}.${g}`);
    try {
      _.mkdirSync(m, {
        recursive: !0
      }), _.existsSync(y) || _.writeFileSync(y, d);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Failed to persist gallery image binary:", e);
    }
    return {
      width: u ?? null,
      height: h ?? null,
      aspectRatio: p ?? null,
      filePath: y
    };
  }
  mimeToExtension(e) {
    return {
      "image/png": "png",
      "image/jpeg": "jpg",
      "image/jpg": "jpg",
      "image/webp": "webp",
      "image/gif": "gif"
    }[e.toLowerCase()] || "bin";
  }

  refreshAgentMissionStatus(e) {

    if (0 === t.length) return;
    let n = "running";
    t.some(e => "running" === e.status || "queued" === e.status) ? n = "running" : t.some(e => "failed" === e.status || "cancelled" === e.status) ? n = "failed" : t.every(e => "completed" === e.status) && (n = "completed"), this.db.update(cs).set({
      status: n,
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
    }).where(oe(cs.id, e)).run();

  updateThread(e, t, n) {
    if (!this.db) throw new Error("Database not initialized");
    const r = {
      ...t
    };
    if (void 0 !== t.metadata) {
      const n = this.getThreadById(e);
      if (n) {
        r.metadata = {
          ...(n.metadata || {}),
          ...t.metadata
        };
        const o = r.metadata.activePath;
        if (Array.isArray(o) && o.length > 0) {
          const t = new Set(this.db.select({
              id: is.id
            }).from(is).where(oe(is.threadId, e)).all().map(e => e.id)),
            n = o.filter(e => t.has(e));
          if (n.length !== o.length) {
            const s = o.filter(e => !t.has(e));
            console.warn(`[updateThread] Thread ${e}: refused ${s.length} activePath entr${1 === s.length ? "y" : "ies"} with no message row (${s.slice(0, 3).join(", ")}${s.length > 3 ? ", …" : ""})`), r.metadata.activePath = n;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    if (!0 === t.enableArtifacts) {
      const t = this.getThreadById(e);
      if (t) {
        let e = !t.artifactWorkspaceId;
        if (t.artifactWorkspaceId && (this.getWorkspaceById(t.artifactWorkspaceId) || (console.log(`[updateThread] Artifact workspace ${t.artifactWorkspaceId} not found, creating new one`), e = !0)), e) {
          const e = this.createArtifactWorkspace(`Artifacts - ${t.title}`);
          r.artifactWorkspaceId = e.id;
        }
      }
    }
    return n?.skipUpdatedAt || (r.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString()), this.db.update(ss).set(r).where(oe(ss.id, e)).returning().get();
  }

AND m.created_at < ? AND m.parent_tool_call_id IS NULL\n              AND COALESCE(t.is_incognito, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(json_extract(t.metadata, '$.isCron'), 0) = 0\n              AND (json_type(t.metadata, '$.activePath') IS NULL OR EXISTS (\n                  SELECT 1 FROM json_each(t.metadata, '$.activePath') p WHERE p.value = m.id))\n            GROUP BY t.id ORDER BY lastMessageAt DESC LIMIT ?").all(e, t, n);

  addMessage(e, t, n) {
    if (!this.db) throw new Error("Database not initialized");
    if (!this.sqlite) throw new Error("SQLite database not initialized");
    const r = `${e}--${t.id}`,
      o = this.getMessageById(r);
    if (o) {
      this.db.update(is).set({
        message: t
      }).where(oe(is.id, r)).run();
      const s = {
        ...o,
        message: t
      };
      return this.syncGalleryImagesForMessage(s), n?.skipFtsIndex || this.updateFtsForMessage(r, e, t), [s, !0];
    }
    const s = n?.metadata ?? {},
      i = {
        id: r,
        threadId: e,
        message: t,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        metadata: s && "object" == typeof s ? s : {},
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        parentId: n?.parentId ?? null,
        slotId: n?.slotId ?? r,
        depth: n?.depth ?? 0,
        parentToolCallId: n?.parentToolCallId ?? null
      },
      a = this.sqlite.transaction(() => {
        n?.replaceAtMessageId && this.beginReplaceAtSlot(e, n.replaceAtMessageId);
        const t = this.db.insert(is).values(i).returning().get();
        if (Yr(t)) {
          const n = this.getThreadById(e),
            r = n.metadata?.chronology;
          this.updateThread(e, {
            metadata: {
              chronology: {
                firstUserMessageAt: r?.firstUserMessageAt || t.createdAt,
                lastUserMessageAt: t.createdAt,
                coverage: r?.coverage || "observed-since-update"
              }
            }
          }, {
            skipUpdatedAt: !0
          });
        }
        if (this.db.update(ss).set({
          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
        }).where(oe(ss.id, e)).run(), n?.appendToActivePath) {
          const n = this.getThreadById(e).metadata || {},
            r = Array.isArray(n.activePath) ? [...n.activePath] : [];
          r.push(t.id);
          const o = {
            ...n,
            activePath: r
          };
          this.updateThread(e, {
            metadata: o
          });
        }
        return t;
      })();
    return this.syncGalleryImagesForMessage(a), this.updateFtsForMessage(r, e, t), Yr(a) && qo(this, a.id).catch(() => {}), [a, !1];
  }

  replaceReferenceLinks(e, t, n = "message") {
    if (!this.sqlite) throw new Error("Database not initialized");
    const r = new Date().toISOString(),
      o = this.sqlite.prepare("DELETE FROM reference_links WHERE from_uri = ? AND source = ?"),
      s = this.sqlite.prepare("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO reference_links (from_uri, to_uri, to_kind, label, thread_id, message_id, slot_id, role, source, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)");
    this.sqlite.transaction(() => {
      o.run(e.fromUri, n);
      for (const o of t) s.run(e.fromUri, o.toUri, o.toKind, o.label ?? null, e.threadId, e.messageId, e.slotId, e.role, n, r);
    })();
  }
  indexBodyReferences(e, t, n) {
    if (this.sqlite) try {
      if (!t || !t.includes("](alma://")) return void this.sqlite.prepare("DELETE FROM reference_links WHERE from_uri = ? AND source = 'body'").run(e);
      const r = new Map();
      for (const n of Pr(t)) n.ref.uri !== e && (r.has(n.ref.uri) || r.set(n.ref.uri, {
        kind: n.ref.kind,
        label: n.label
      }));
      this.replaceReferenceLinks({
        fromUri: e,
        threadId: n?.threadId ?? null,
        messageId: null,
        slotId: null,
        role: "body"
      }, Array.from(r.entries()).map(([e, t]) => ({
        toUri: e,
        toKind: t.kind,
        label: t.label
      })), "body");
    } catch (r) {
      console.error("Error indexing body references:", r);
    }
  }

  beginReplaceAtSlot(e, t) {
    const n = this.getThreadById(e);
    if (!n) throw new Error("Thread not found");
    const r = n.metadata || {},
      o = Array.isArray(r.activePath) ? [...r.activePath] : [],
      s = o.indexOf(t);
    if (-1 === s) return {
      index: -1,
      activePath: o
    };
    const i = o.slice(s + 1),
      a = {
        ...(r.savedTails || {})
      };
    a[t] = i;
    const c = o.slice(0, s),
      l = {
        ...r,
        activePath: c,
        savedTails: a
      };
    return this.updateThread(e, {
      metadata: l
    }), {
      index: s,
      activePath: c
    };
  }
  rollbackFailedReplacement(e, t, n) {
    if (!this.db || !this.sqlite) throw new Error("Database not initialized");
    const r = this.sqlite.transaction(() => {
      const r = this.getMessageById(t),
        o = this.getMessageById(n);
      if (!r || !o || r.threadId !== e || o.threadId !== e) return !1;
      if ((r.slotId ?? r.id) !== (o.slotId ?? o.id)) return !1;
      const s = this.getThreadById(e);
      if (!s) return !1;
      const i = s.metadata || {},
        a = Array.isArray(i.activePath) ? [...i.activePath] : [],
        c = a.indexOf(n);
      if (-1 === c || a.includes(t)) return !1;
      const l = {
          ...(i.savedTails || {})
        },
        d = Array.isArray(l[t]) ? l[t] : [],
        u = [...a.slice(0, c), t, ...d];
      return delete l[t], delete l[n], this.updateThread(e, {
        metadata: {
          ...i,
          activePath: u,
          savedTails: l
        }
      }), this.db.delete(is).where(oe(is.id, n)).run(), !0;
    })();
    return r && (this.removeGalleryImagesForMessage(n), this.deleteFtsForMessage(n), this.deleteReferenceLinksForMessage(n)), r;
  }
  discardFailedAssistantMessage(e, t) {
    if (!this.db || !this.sqlite) throw new Error("Database not initialized");
    const n = this.sqlite.transaction(() => {
      const n = this.getMessageById(t);
      if (!n || n.threadId !== e || "assistant" !== n.message.role) return !1;
      const r = this.getThreadById(e);
      if (!r) return !1;
      const o = r.metadata || {},
        s = Array.isArray(o.activePath) ? [...o.activePath] : [];
      if (s[s.length - 1] !== t) return !1;
      const i = {
        ...(o.savedTails || {})
      };
      return delete i[t], this.updateThread(e, {
        metadata: {
          ...o,
          activePath: s.slice(0, -1),
          savedTails: i
        }
      }), this.db.delete(is).where(oe(is.id, t)).run(), !0;
    })();
    return n && (this.removeGalleryImagesForMessage(t), this.deleteFtsForMessage(t), this.deleteReferenceLinksForMessage(t)), n;
  }
  selectVersion(e, t, n) {
    const r = this.getThreadById(e);
    if (!r) throw new Error("Thread not found");
    const o = r.metadata || {},
      s = Array.isArray(o.activePath) ? [...o.activePath] : [],
      i = s.indexOf(t);
    if (-1 === i) return s;
    const a = {
        ...(o.savedTails || {})
      },
      c = s.slice(i + 1);
    a[t] = c;
    const l = Array.isArray(a[n]) ? a[n] : [],
      d = [...s.slice(0, i), n, ...l],
      u = {
        ...o,
        activePath: d,
        savedTails: a
      };
    return this.updateThread(e, {
      metadata: u
    }), d;
  }

  searchThreads(e, t) {
    if (!this.db || !this.sqlite) throw new Error("Database not initialized");
    const n = e.trim();
    if (!n) return [];
    const r = Math.max(1, Math.min(50, t?.limit ?? 20)),
      o = Math.max(0, Math.min(10, t?.contextSize ?? 3)),
      s = 2 * o + 1,
      i = Math.max(s, Math.min(200, t?.maxMessagesPerThread ?? 50)),
      a = function (e) {
        return ii(e);
      }(n),
      c = a.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).map(e => `"${e.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`).join(" "),
      l = this.sqlite.prepare("\n            SELECT thread_id, message_id\n            FROM messages_fts\n            WHERE messages_fts MATCH ?\n            ORDER BY rank\n            LIMIT 1000\n        ").all(c),
      d = new Map();
    for (const f of l) d.has(f.thread_id) || d.set(f.thread_id, new Set()), d.get(f.thread_id).add(f.message_id);
    const u = n.toLowerCase(),
      h = this.sqlite.prepare("\n            SELECT id FROM chat_threads\n            WHERE LOWER(title) LIKE ?\n            LIMIT 100\n        ").all(`%${u}%`);
    for (const f of h) d.has(f.id) || d.set(f.id, new Set());
    if (0 === d.size) return [];
    const p = [];
    for (const [f, m] of d) {
      const e = this.getThreadById(f);
      if (!e) continue;
      if (void 0 !== t?.workspaceId && e.workspaceId !== t.workspaceId) continue;
      const n = t?.metadataOnly ? [] : this.getMessagesByThreadId(f);
      if (!t?.metadataOnly && 0 === n.length && 0 === m.size) continue;
      const r = new Set();
      for (let t = 0; t < n.length; t++) m.has(n[t].id) && r.add(t);
      const s = new Set();
      for (const t of r) {
        const e = Math.max(0, t - o),
          r = Math.min(n.length - 1, t + o);
        for (let t = e; t <= r && (s.add(t), !(s.size >= i)); t++);
        if (s.size >= i) break;
      }
      if (0 === s.size && n.length > 0) for (let t = 0; t < Math.min(3, n.length); t++) s.add(t);
      const a = Array.from(s).sort((e, t) => e - t).map(e => n[e]);
      p.push({
        id: e.id,
        title: e.title,
        workspaceId: e.workspaceId ?? null,
        workspaceName: e.workspaceId ? this.getWorkspaceById(e.workspaceId)?.name ?? null : null,
        model: e.model ?? null,
        isGenerating: Boolean(e.isGenerating),
        createdAt: e.createdAt,
        updatedAt: e.updatedAt,
        matchCount: m.size || 1,
        messages: a
      });
    }
    return p.sort((e, t) => t.matchCount !== e.matchCount ? t.matchCount - e.matchCount : new Date(t.updatedAt).getTime() - new Date(e.updatedAt).getTime()), p.slice(0, r);
  }

  saveMCPOAuthToken(e, t) {
    if (!this.db) throw new Error("Database not initialized");
    const n = new Date().toISOString();
    if (this.getMCPOAuthTokenByServerId(e)) return this.db.update(Is).set({
      ...t,
      updatedAt: n
    }).where(oe(Is.serverId, e)).returning().get();
    {
      const r = {
        id: this.generateId(),
        serverId: e,
        ...t,
        createdAt: n,
        updatedAt: n
      };
      return this.db.insert(Is).values(r).returning().get();
    }
  }

  migrateMCPOAuthToken(e, t) {
    if (!this.db) throw new Error("Database not initialized");
    const n = this.getMCPOAuthTokenByServerId(e);
    if (!n) return !1;
    const r = this.getMCPOAuthTokenByServerId(t),
      o = new Date().toISOString();
    if (r) {
      const r = {
        updatedAt: o
      };
      return n.accessToken && (r.accessToken = n.accessToken), n.refreshToken && (r.refreshToken = n.refreshToken), n.tokenType && (r.tokenType = n.tokenType), n.expiresAt && (r.expiresAt = n.expiresAt), n.scope && (r.scope = n.scope), n.clientId && (r.clientId = n.clientId), n.clientSecret && (r.clientSecret = n.clientSecret), r.lastError = null, r.lastErrorAt = null, this.db.update(Is).set(r).where(oe(Is.serverId, t)).run(), this.deleteMCPOAuthToken(e), !0;
    }
    return this.db.update(Is).set({
      serverId: t,
      updatedAt: o
    }).where(oe(Is.serverId, e)).run().changes > 0;
  }

  getWorkspacePinnedReferences(e) {
    const t = [];
    let n = e,
      r = 0;
    for (; n && r++ < 5;) {
      const e = this.getWorkspaceById(n);
      if (!e) break;
      t.push(e), n = e.parentWorkspaceId;
    }
    const o = [],
      s = new Set();
    for (const i of t.reverse()) if (i.pinnedReferences) try {
      const e = JSON.parse(i.pinnedReferences);
      if (!Array.isArray(e)) continue;
      for (const t of e) {
        const e = "string" == typeof t?.uri ? t.uri : null;
        e && !s.has(e) && (s.add(e), o.push({
          uri: e,
          label: "string" == typeof t?.label && t.label ? t.label : e
        }));
      }
    } catch {}
    return o;
  }

  createTemporaryWorkspace() {

    const r = this.generateId(),
      o = K.join(t, `temp-${r}`);

      recursive: !0

  getSessionWorkspaceRoot() {
    try {
      const e = this.getSettings();
      if (e?.settingsData) {
        const t = JSON.parse(e.settingsData),
          n = t?.general?.sessionWorkspaceRoot;
        if ("string" == typeof n && n.trim()) return n.trim().replace(/^~(?=$|[/\\])/, P.homedir());
      }
    } catch {}
    const e = n?.getPath ? n.getPath("documents") : K.join(P.homedir(), "Documents");
    return K.join(e, "Alma");
  }
  slugifySessionName(e) {
    let t = (e || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]+/g, " ").replace(/[\p{Cc}\p{Cf}]/gu, "").replace(/\s+/g, "-").replace(/-+/g, "-").replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "").toLowerCase();
    const n = Array.from(t);
    return n.length > 40 && (t = n.slice(0, 40).join("").replace(/-+$/g, "")), t;
  }
  createSessionWorkspace(e, t) {
    if (!this.db) throw new Error("Database not initialized");
    const n = this.getSessionWorkspaceRoot(),
      r = new Date(),
      o = `${r.getFullYear()}-${String(r.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(r.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")}`,
      s = K.join(n, o);
    _.mkdirSync(s, {
      recursive: !0
    });
    const i = this.generateId(),
      a = this.slugifySessionName(t),
      c = a || `chat-${i.slice(0, 8)}`;
    let l = c,
      d = 2;
    for (; _.existsSync(K.join(s, l));) l = `${c}-${d}`, d += 1;
    const u = K.join(s, l);
    for (const m of ["outputs", "work", "tmp"]) _.mkdirSync(K.join(u, m), {
      recursive: !0
    });
    const h = r.toISOString(),
      p = (e || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim(),
      f = {
        id: i,
        path: u,
        name: p ? p.slice(0, 60) : a || "Session",
        isTemporary: !1,
        isSession: !0,
        showInList: !1,
        createdAt: h,
        updatedAt: h
      };
    return this.db.insert(os).values(f).returning().get();
  }

  deleteWorkspace(t) {
    if (!this.db) throw new Error("Database not initialized");
    const n = this.getWorkspaceById(t);
    if (n?.isTemporary && n.path && 0 === this.getThreadCountByWorkspaceId(t)) try {
      _.existsSync(n.path) && _.rmSync(n.path, {
        recursive: !0,
        force: !0
      });
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Failed to delete temporary workspace directory:", e);
    }
    const r = this.db;
    if (!this.sqlite) throw new Error("Database not initialized");
    return this.sqlite.transaction(() => (r.update(ss).set({
      workspaceId: null
    }).where(oe(ss.workspaceId, t)).run(), r.update(ss).set({
      artifactWorkspaceId: null
    }).where(oe(ss.artifactWorkspaceId, t)).run(), r.delete(os).where(oe(os.id, t)).run().changes > 0))();
  }

  orphanedChatWorkspace(e) {
    if (!this.db) throw new Error("Database not initialized");
    const t = this.getWorkspaceById(e);
    if (!t?.path || t.showInList || t.isWorktree) return null;
    if (!t.isSession && !t.isTemporary) return null;
    if (this.db.select({
      id: ss.id
    }).from(ss).where(ue(oe(ss.workspaceId, e), oe(ss.artifactWorkspaceId, e))).all().length > 0) return null;
    const r = n?.getPath ? n.getPath("userData") : process.cwd(),
      o = n?.getPath ? n.getPath("documents") : K.join(P.homedir(), "Documents"),
      s = t.isSession ? [this.getSessionWorkspaceRoot(), K.join(o, "Alma")] : [K.join(r, "workspaces")],
      i = K.resolve(t.path);
    return s.some(e => i.startsWith(K.resolve(e) + K.sep)) ? t : null;
  }

  getUsageStatsAggregated(e) {
    if (!this.sqlite) throw new Error("Database not initialized");
    const t = ["json_extract(m.metadata, '$.usage') IS NOT NULL"],
      n = [];
    e?.fromDate && (t.push("m.timestamp >= ?"), n.push(e.fromDate)), e?.toDate && (t.push("m.timestamp <= ?"), n.push(e.toDate));
    const r = `\n            SELECT\n                t.model as model,\n                date(m.timestamp) as date,\n                SUM(COALESCE(CAST(json_extract(m.metadata, '$.usage.inputTokens') AS INTEGER), 0)) as inputTokens,\n                SUM(COALESCE(CAST(json_extract(m.metadata, '$.usage.outputTokens') AS INTEGER), 0)) as outputTokens,\n                SUM(COALESCE(CAST(json_extract(m.metadata, '$.usage.cachedInputTokens') AS INTEGER), 0)) as cachedTokens,\n                SUM(COALESCE(CAST(json_extract(m.metadata, '$.usage.cacheWriteInputTokens') AS INTEGER), 0)) as cacheWriteTokens,\n                SUM(COALESCE(CAST(json_extract(m.metadata, '$.usage.reasoningTokens') AS INTEGER), 0)) as reasoningTokens,\n                SUM(\n                    COALESCE(CAST(json_extract(m.metadata, '$.usage.totalTokens') AS INTEGER), 0) +\n                    CASE WHEN json_extract(m.metadata, '$.usage.totalTokens') IS NULL THEN\n                        COALESCE(CAST(json_extract(m.metadata, '$.usage.inputTokens') AS INTEGER), 0) +\n                        COALESCE(CAST(json_extract(m.metadata, '$.usage.outputTokens') AS INTEGER), 0)\n                    ELSE 0 END\n                ) as totalTokens,\n                COUNT(*) as messageCount\n            FROM chat_messages m\n            JOIN chat_threads t ON m.thread_id = t.id\n            ${t.length > 0 ? `WHERE ${t.join(" AND ")}` : ""}\n            GROUP BY t.model, date(m.timestamp)\n            ORDER BY date ASC, t.model ASC\n        `,
      o = this.sqlite.prepare(r).all(...n),
      s = new Date();
    s.setFullYear(s.getFullYear() - 1);
    const i = s.toISOString().split("T")[0],
      a = this.sqlite.prepare("\n            SELECT\n                date(m.timestamp) as date,\n                SUM(\n                    COALESCE(CAST(json_extract(m.metadata, '$.usage.inputTokens') AS INTEGER), 0) +\n                    COALESCE(CAST(json_extract(m.metadata, '$.usage.outputTokens') AS INTEGER), 0)\n                ) as totalTokens\n            FROM chat_messages m\n            WHERE json_extract(m.metadata, '$.usage') IS NOT NULL\n              AND date(m.timestamp) >= ?\n            GROUP BY date(m.timestamp)\n            ORDER BY date ASC\n        ").all(i);
    let c = o.map(e => ({
      ...e,
      model: e.model || "unknown"
    }));
    return (e?.providerId || e?.modelId) && (c = c.filter(t => {
      const [n, r] = t.model.includes(":") ? [t.model.split(":")[0], t.model.split(":").slice(1).join(":")] : ["", t.model];
      return !(e?.providerId && n !== e.providerId || e?.modelId && r !== e.modelId);
    })), this.mergeAuxUsageStats({
      byModelAndDate: c,
      activityByDate: a
    }, e);
  }
  saveUsageRecord(e) {
    if (!this.db || !this.sqlite) return null;
    const {
        messageId: t,
        threadId: n,
        model: r,
        usage: o,
        timestamp: s
      } = e,
      i = r?.includes(":") ? r.split(":")[0] : null,
      a = s.split("T")[0],
      c = o.totalTokens ?? (o.inputTokens ?? 0) + (o.outputTokens ?? 0),
      l = new Date().toISOString(),
      d = {
        id: `usage_${t}`,
        messageId: t,
        threadId: n,
        model: r,
        providerId: i,
        date: a,

        outputTokens: o.outputTokens ?? 0,

        reasoningTokens: o.reasoningTokens ?? 0,

        timestamp: s,

      };

        }
      }).returning().get();
    } catch (u) {

    }
  }
  saveAuxUsageRecord(e) {
    if (!this.db || !this.sqlite) return null;
    const {
        purpose: t,
        model: n,
        threadId: r,
        usage: o,
        timestamp: s
      } = e,
      i = n?.includes(":") ? n.split(":")[0] : null,
      a = s.split("T")[0],
      c = o.totalTokens ?? (o.inputTokens ?? 0) + (o.outputTokens ?? 0);
    if (c <= 0 && !o.inputTokens && !o.outputTokens) return null;
    const l = {
      id: `aux_${Date.now().toString(36)}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`,
      purpose: t,
      model: n,
      providerId: i,
      threadId: r ?? null,
      date: a,
      inputTokens: o.inputTokens ?? 0,
      outputTokens: o.outputTokens ?? 0,
      cachedInputTokens: o.cachedInputTokens ?? 0,
      cacheWriteInputTokens: o.cacheWriteInputTokens ?? 0,
      reasoningTokens: o.reasoningTokens ?? 0,
      totalTokens: c,
      timestamp: s,

    };

      return this.db.insert(Rs).values(l).returning().get();

    }
  }
  getAuxUsageStats(e) {
    if (!this.sqlite) throw new Error("Database not initialized");
    const t = [],
      n = [];
    e?.fromDate && (t.push("timestamp >= ?"), n.push(e.fromDate)), e?.toDate && (t.push("timestamp <= ?"), n.push(e.toDate)), e?.providerId && (t.push("provider_id = ?"), n.push(e.providerId)), e?.modelId && (t.push("(model LIKE '%:' || ? OR model = ?)"), n.push(e.modelId, e.modelId));
    const r = t.length > 0 ? `WHERE ${t.join(" AND ")}` : "",
      o = this.sqlite.prepare(`\n            SELECT\n                COALESCE(model, 'unknown') as model,\n                date,\n                SUM(COALESCE(input_tokens, 0)) as inputTokens,\n                SUM(COALESCE(output_tokens, 0)) as outputTokens,\n                SUM(COALESCE(cached_input_tokens, 0)) as cachedTokens,\n                SUM(COALESCE(cache_write_input_tokens, 0)) as cacheWriteTokens,\n                SUM(COALESCE(reasoning_tokens, 0)) as reasoningTokens,\n                SUM(COALESCE(total_tokens, 0)) as totalTokens,\n                COUNT(*) as messageCount\n            FROM aux_usage_records\n            ${r}\n            GROUP BY model, date\n        `).all(...n),
      s = new Date();
    s.setFullYear(s.getFullYear() - 1);
    const i = s.toISOString().split("T")[0];
    return {
      byModelAndDate: o,
      activityByDate: this.sqlite.prepare("\n            SELECT date, SUM(COALESCE(input_tokens, 0) + COALESCE(output_tokens, 0)) as totalTokens\n            FROM aux_usage_records\n            WHERE date >= ?\n            GROUP BY date\n        ").all(i)
    };
  }
  mergeAuxUsageStats(e, t) {
    let n;
    try {
      n = this.getAuxUsageStats(t);
    } catch (a) {
      return console.error("Error reading aux usage stats:", a), e;
    }
    if (0 === n.byModelAndDate.length && 0 === n.activityByDate.length) return e;
    const r = new Map();
    for (const c of e.byModelAndDate) r.set(`${c.model}\0${c.date}`, {
      ...c
    });
    for (const c of n.byModelAndDate) {
      const e = `${c.model}\0${c.date}`,
        t = r.get(e);
      t ? (t.inputTokens += c.inputTokens, t.outputTokens += c.outputTokens, t.cachedTokens += c.cachedTokens, t.cacheWriteTokens += c.cacheWriteTokens, t.reasoningTokens += c.reasoningTokens, t.totalTokens += c.totalTokens, t.messageCount += c.messageCount) : r.set(e, {
        ...c
      });
    }
    const o = [...r.values()].sort((e, t) => e.date < t.date ? -1 : e.date > t.date ? 1 : e.model < t.model ? -1 : e.model > t.model ? 1 : 0),
      s = new Map();
    for (const c of e.activityByDate) s.set(c.date, c.totalTokens);
    for (const c of n.activityByDate) s.set(c.date, (s.get(c.date) ?? 0) + c.totalTokens);
    const i = [...s.entries()].map(([e, t]) => ({
      date: e,
      totalTokens: t
    })).sort((e, t) => e.date < t.date ? -1 : e.date > t.date ? 1 : 0);
    return {
      ...e,
      byModelAndDate: o,
      activityByDate: i
    };
  }

function Ei(e) {
  const t = e.host.includes(":") && !e.host.startsWith("[") ? `[${e.host}]` : e.host;
  return `${e.username ? `${encodeURIComponent(e.username)}:${encodeURIComponent(e.password || "")}@` : ""}${t}:${e.port}`;
}

}

      a = [];

function Tu(e) {
  if (e instanceof URL || "string" == typeof e || e instanceof Uint8Array) return e;
  if (e && "object" == typeof e && "type" in e) {
    const t = e;
    if ("url" === t.type && null != t.url) return t.url instanceof URL ? t.url : new URL(String(t.url));
    if ("data" === t.type || "text" === t.type) return Tu(t.data);
    if ("reference" === t.type) {
      const e = t.reference ?? t.id;
      if ("string" == typeof e) return e;
      if (e && "object" == typeof e) {
        const t = e,
          n = [t.openai, t.copilot, ...Object.values(t)].find(e => "string" == typeof e);
        if ("string" == typeof n) return n;
      }
    }
  }
  if (e instanceof ArrayBuffer) return new Uint8Array(e);
  throw new Error("Unsupported file part data shape: " + (null === e ? "null" : typeof e));
}
function _u(e, t) {
  if ("string" == typeof e && e.startsWith("data:")) {
    const t = e.indexOf(",");
    return t >= 0 ? e.slice(t + 1) : "";
  }
  return t(e);
}

function Au(e) {
  const t = [];
  for (const {
    role: n,
    content: r,
    ...o
  } of e) {
    const e = Su({
      ...o
    });
    switch (n) {
      case "system":
        t.push({
          role: "system",
          content: r,
          ...e
        });
        break;
      case "user":
        if (1 === r.length && "text" === r[0].type) {
          t.push({
            role: "user",
            content: r[0].text,
            ...Su(r[0])
          });
          break;
        }
        t.push({
          role: "user",
          content: r.map(e => {
            const t = Su(e);
            switch (e.type) {
              case "text":
                return {
                  type: "text",
                  text: e.text,
                  ...t
                };
              case "file":
                if (e.mediaType.startsWith("image/")) {
                  const n = "image/*" === e.mediaType ? "image/jpeg" : e.mediaType,
                    r = Tu(e.data);
                  return {
                    type: "image_url",
                    image_url: {
                      url: r instanceof URL ? r.toString() : `data:${n};base64,${_u(r, cd)}`
                    },
                    ...t
                  };
                }
                throw new Xt({
                  functionality: `file part media type ${e.mediaType}`
                });
            }
          }),
          ...e
        });
        break;
      case "assistant":
        {
          let n,
            o,
            s = "";
          const i = [];
          for (const e of r) {
            const t = Su(e),
              r = e.providerOptions?.copilot?.reasoningOpaque;
            switch (r && !o && (o = r), e.type) {
              case "text":
                s += e.text;
                break;
              case "reasoning":
                e.text && (n = e.text);
                break;
              case "tool-call":
                i.push({
                  id: e.toolCallId,
                  type: "function",
                  function: {
                    name: e.toolName,
                    arguments: JSON.stringify(e.input)
                  },
                  ...t
                });
            }
          }
          t.push({
            role: "assistant",
            content: s || null,
            tool_calls: i.length > 0 ? i : void 0,
            reasoning_text: o ? n : void 0,
            reasoning_opaque: o,
            ...e
          });
          break;
        }
      case "tool":
        for (const e of r) {
          if ("tool-approval-response" === e.type) continue;
          const n = e.output;
          let r;
          switch (n.type) {
            case "text":
            case "error-text":
              r = n.value;
              break;
            case "execution-denied":
              r = n.reason ?? "Tool execution denied.";
              break;
            case "content":
            case "json":
            case "error-json":
              r = JSON.stringify(n.value);
          }
          const o = Su(e);
          t.push({
            role: "tool",
            tool_call_id: e.toolCallId,
            content: r,
            ...o
          });
        }
        break;
      default:
        throw new Error(`Unsupported role: ${n}`);
    }
  }
  return t;
}

              }), r.hasFinished = !0));
            }
          }
        },
        flush(e) {
          p && e.enqueue({
            type: "reasoning-end",
            id: "reasoning-0",
            providerMetadata: h ? {
              copilot: {
                reasoningOpaque: h
              }
            } : void 0
          }), f && e.enqueue({
            type: "text-end",
            id: "txt-0"
          });
          for (const n of a.filter(e => !e.hasFinished)) e.enqueue({
            type: "tool-input-end",
            id: n.id
          }), e.enqueue({
            type: "tool-call",
            toolCallId: n.id ?? gd(),
            toolName: n.function.name,
            input: n.function.arguments
          });
          const t = {
            [u]: {},
            ...(h ? {
              copilot: {
                reasoningOpaque: h
              }
            } : {}),
            ...o?.buildMetadata()
          };
          null != l.completionTokensDetails.acceptedPredictionTokens && (t[u].acceptedPredictionTokens = l.completionTokensDetails.acceptedPredictionTokens), null != l.completionTokensDetails.rejectedPredictionTokens && (t[u].rejectedPredictionTokens = l.completionTokensDetails.rejectedPredictionTokens), e.enqueue({
            type: "finish",
            finishReason: c,
            usage: {
              inputTokens: {
                total: l.promptTokens,
                noCache: null != l.promptTokens && null != l.promptTokensDetails.cachedTokens ? l.promptTokens - l.promptTokensDetails.cachedTokens : void 0,
                cacheRead: l.promptTokensDetails.cachedTokens,
                cacheWrite: void 0
              },
              outputTokens: {
                total: l.completionTokens,
                text: void 0,
                reasoning: l.completionTokensDetails.reasoningTokens
              },
              raw: {
                prompt_tokens: l.promptTokens ?? null,
                completion_tokens: l.completionTokens ?? null,
                total_tokens: l.totalTokens ?? null
              }
            },
            providerMetadata: t
          });
        }
      })),
      request: {
        body: r
      },
      response: {
        headers: s
      }
    };
  }
}

  async cuaMouse(t, n, r, o, s = "left") {

  async cuaKeypress(t, n) {
    try {

        r = {
          alt: 1,

        };

      const s = [];
      for (const t of n) {
        const e = t.trim();
        if (!e) continue;

      }

      };
      for (const t of s) {

            text: n.text
          } : {})
        }), await this.sendCommand(e, "Input.dispatchKeyEvent", {
          type: "keyUp",

        });
      }

        success: !0
      };
    } catch (e) {
      return {
        success: !1,
        error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)
      };
    }
  }
  async getVisibleDom(t) {

  async pipFrame(t) {
    try {
      const e = this.resolve(t);
      if (this.ensureScreencast(e), e.screencast.pip = !0, e.screencast?.latest) return {
        success: !0,
        image_base64: e.screencast.latest,
        url: Bp(e.wc),
        title: e.wc.getTitle()
      };
      const n = e.hdRender && e.hdRender.width > 0 ? e.hdRender : null,
        r = n ? {
          width: n.width,
          height: n.height,
          dsf: n.dsf
        } : e.viewportParams ? {
          width: e.viewportParams.width,
          height: e.viewportParams.height,
          dsf: e.viewportParams.deviceScaleFactor
        } : null,
        o = this.displayScaleFor(e),
        s = r ? (r.dsf || o) / o : 1,
        i = r && r.width > 0 ? {
          x: 0,
          y: 0,
          width: r.width,
          height: r.height,
          scale: 1 / s
        } : void 0,

          format: "jpeg",

          optimizeForSpeed: !0,
          ...(i ? {
            clip: i
          } : {})
        });
      return {
        success: !0,
        image_base64: a?.data,
        url: Bp(e.wc),
        title: e.wc.getTitle()
      };
    } catch (e) {
      return {
        success: !1,
        error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)
      };
    }
  }
  subscribeFrames(e, t, n = {}) {
    const r = this.resolve(e);
    this.ensureScreencast(r);
    const o = r.screencast;
    if (o.subscribers.add(t), n.hd && o.hd.add(t), this.applyScreencastDetail(r), o.latestFrame) try {
      t(o.latestFrame);
    } catch {}
    return () => {
      const e = r.screencast;
      e && (e.subscribers.delete(t), e.hd.delete(t), e.pip || 0 !== e.subscribers.size ? this.applyScreencastDetail(r) : this.stopPipStream(r));
    };
  }
  setFrameDetail(e, t, n) {
    let r;
    try {
      r = this.resolve(e);
    } catch {
      return;
    }
    const o = r.screencast;
    o && o.subscribers.has(t) && (n ? o.hd.add(t) : o.hd.delete(t), this.applyScreencastDetail(r));
  }
  applyScreencastDetail(e) {
    const t = e.screencast;
    t && (this.setHdRender(e, t.hd.size > 0), 0 !== t.hd.size && this.captureHdFrame(e));
  }
  setHdRender(e, t) {
    if (e.wc.isDestroyed()) return Promise.resolve();
    const n = e.wc.hostWebContents;
    if (t) {
      if (e.hdRender || e.viewportOverride || !n || n.isDestroyed()) return Promise.resolve();
      const t = this.displayScaleFor(e),
        r = 2,
        o = r / t;
      return o <= 1.01 || (e.metricsGen = (e.metricsGen ?? 0) + 1, e.hdRender = {
        factor: o,
        displayScale: t,
        dsf: r,
        width: 0,
        height: 0
      }, console.log(`[iab-hd] on factor=${o} (${e.workspaceId})`), n.send("iab:hd-render", {
        webContentsId: e.webContentsId,
        factor: o
      })), Promise.resolve();
    }
    if (!e.hdRender) return Promise.resolve();
    if (e.hdRender = void 0, console.log(`[iab-hd] off agent=${!!e.viewportOverride} (${e.workspaceId})`), !n || n.isDestroyed()) return this.sendCommand(e, "Emulation.clearDeviceMetricsOverride").catch(() => {});
    const r = Date.now();
    return (e.viewportParams ? Promise.resolve() : this.sendCommand(e, "Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride", {
      width: 0,
      height: 0,
      deviceScaleFactor: 0,
      mobile: !1
    }).catch(() => {})).then(() => new Promise(t => {
      if (n.isDestroyed()) return t();
      n.send("iab:hd-render", {
        webContentsId: e.webContentsId,
        factor: 1
      });
      const r = e.hdShrinkWaiters ??= [],
        o = setTimeout(s, 500);
      function s() {
        clearTimeout(o);
        const e = r.indexOf(s);
        e >= 0 && r.splice(e, 1), t();
      }
      r.push(s);
    })).then(async () => {
      e.wc.isDestroyed() || (console.log(`[iab-hd] shrunk after ${Date.now() - r}ms (${e.workspaceId})`), e.viewportParams || (await this.sendCommand(e, "Emulation.clearDeviceMetricsOverride").catch(() => {})), this.settleMetrics(e));
    });
  }
  displayScaleFor(e) {
    const t = n.isPackaged ? 0 : Number(process.env.ALMA_IAB_DISPLAY_SCALE) || 0;
    if (t > 0) return t;
    const r = e.wc.isDestroyed() ? null : e.wc.hostWebContents,
      s = r && !r.isDestroyed() ? c.fromWebContents(r) : null;
    return Math.max(1, s ? o.getDisplayMatching(s.getBounds()).scaleFactor : 1);
  }
  settleMetrics(e) {
    const t = e.metricsGen = (e.metricsGen ?? 0) + 1,
      n = [150, 400, 1200],
      r = async o => {
        e.metricsGen === t && ((await this.checkMetricsOnce(e, o)) || e.metricsGen !== t || o + 1 < n.length && setTimeout(() => {
          r(o + 1);
        }, n[o + 1]));
      };
    setTimeout(() => {
      r(0);
    }, n[0]);
  }
  async settleNow(e) {
    const t = e.metricsGen = (e.metricsGen ?? 0) + 1,
      n = [0, 100, 250, 500];
    for (let r = 0; r < n.length; r++) {
      if (n[r] > 0 && (await new Promise(e => setTimeout(e, n[r]))), e.metricsGen !== t) return;
      if (await this.checkMetricsOnce(e, r)) return;
    }
  }
  async checkMetricsOnce(e, t) {
    if (e.wc.isDestroyed()) return !0;
    const n = e.hdRender,
      r = n ? n.width > 0 ? {
        dpr: n.dsf,
        width: n.width,
        params: {
          width: n.width,
          height: n.height,
          deviceScaleFactor: n.dsf,
          mobile: !1
        }
      } : null : e.viewportParams ? {
        dpr: e.viewportParams.deviceScaleFactor || this.displayScaleFor(e),
        width: e.viewportParams.width || 0,
        params: e.viewportParams
      } : {
        dpr: this.displayScaleFor(e),
        width: 0,
        params: null
      };
    if (!r) return !0;
    let o = 0,
      s = 0;
    try {
      const t = await this.sendCommand(e, "Runtime.evaluate", {
        expression: "[devicePixelRatio, innerWidth]",
        returnByValue: !0
      });
      [o, s] = t?.result?.value ?? [0, 0];
    } catch {
      return !0;
    }
    return Math.abs(o - r.dpr) < .01 && (0 === r.width || s === r.width) || (console.log(`[iab-hd] settle #${t}: page at ${o}x${s}, re-asserting ${r.params ? `${r.params.width}x${r.params.height}@${r.params.deviceScaleFactor}` : "clear"} (${e.workspaceId})`), r.params ? (await this.sendCommand(e, "Emulation.clearDeviceMetricsOverride").catch(() => {}), await this.sendCommand(e, "Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride", r.params).catch(() => {})) : (await this.sendCommand(e, "Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride", {
      width: 0,
      height: 0,
      deviceScaleFactor: 0,
      mobile: !1
    }).catch(() => {}), await this.sendCommand(e, "Emulation.clearDeviceMetricsOverride").catch(() => {})), !1);
  }
  setHdViewport(e, t, n) {
    const r = [...this.targets.values()].find(t => t.webContentsId === e);
    if (!r) return;
    if (!(t > 0 && n > 0)) {
      for (const e of (r.hdShrinkWaiters ?? []).splice(0)) e();
      return;
    }
    console.log(`[iab-hd] box ${Math.round(t)}x${Math.round(n)} hd=${!!r.hdRender} (${r.workspaceId})`);
    const o = r.hdRender;
    if (!o) return;
    const s = Math.max(1, Math.round(t)),
      i = Math.max(1, Math.round(n));
    o.width === s && o.height === i || (o.width = s, o.height = i, this.sendCommand(r, "Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride", {
      width: s,
      height: i,
      deviceScaleFactor: o.dsf,
      mobile: !1
    }).then(() => {
      this.settleMetrics(r), this.captureHdFrame(r);
    }).catch(() => {}));
  }
  captureHdFrame(e) {
    const t = e.screencast;
    if (!t || 0 === t.hd.size || e.viewportParams) return;
    if (t.hdBusy || (e.metricsHold ?? 0) > 0) return void (t.hdDirty = !0);
    t.hdBusy = !0, t.hdDirty = !1;
    const n = e.hdRender && e.hdRender.width > 0 ? e.hdRender : null,
      r = n ? {
        x: 0,
        y: 0,
        width: n.width,
        height: n.height,
        scale: 1
      } : void 0;
    this.sendCommand(e, "Page.captureScreenshot", {
      format: "jpeg",
      quality: 80,
      optimizeForSpeed: !0,
      ...(r ? {
        clip: r
      } : {})
    }).then(n => {
      if (e.screencast !== t || "string" != typeof n?.data) return;
      const r = t.latestFrame,
        o = {
          data: n.data,
          width: r?.width ?? 0,
          height: r?.height ?? 0
        };
      for (const e of t.hd) if (t.subscribers.has(e)) try {
        e(o);
      } catch {}
    }).catch(() => {}).finally(() => {
      t.hdBusy = !1, t.hdDirty && e.screencast === t && this.captureHdFrame(e);
    });
  }
  ensureScreencast(e) {
    if (e.screencast) return;
    const t = {
      pip: !1,
      subscribers: new Set(),
      hd: new Set(),
      msgHandler: (n, r, o) => {
        if ("Page.screencastFrame" !== r) return;
        t.latest = o?.data;
        try {
          this.sendCommand(e, "Page.screencastFrameAck", {
            sessionId: o.sessionId
          }).catch(() => {});
        } catch {}
        if ("string" != typeof o?.data) return;
        const s = o?.metadata ?? {},
          i = e.hdRender && e.hdRender.width > 0 ? e.hdRender : null,
          a = {
            data: o.data,
            width: i ? i.width : Number(s.deviceWidth) || 0,
            height: i ? i.height : Number(s.deviceHeight) || 0
          };
        t.latestFrame = a;
        const c = t.hd.size > 0 && !e.viewportParams;
        for (const e of t.subscribers) if (!c || !t.hd.has(e)) try {
          e(a);
        } catch {}
        c && this.captureHdFrame(e);
      }
    };
    e.screencast = t, e.dbg.on("message", t.msgHandler);
    try {
      this.sendCommand(e, "Page.enable").catch(() => {});
      const n = () => {
        e.wc.isDestroyed() || e.wc.insertCSS("html{background:#fff}", {
          cssOrigin: "user"
        }).catch(() => {});
      };
      t.paintBackground = n, n(), e.wc.on("dom-ready", n), this.sendCommand(e, "Page.startScreencast", {
        format: "jpeg",
        quality: 55,
        maxWidth: 1024,
        maxHeight: 768,
        everyNthFrame: 1
      }).catch(() => {});
    } catch {}
  }
  stopPipStream(e, t = {}) {
    if (e.screencast) {
      if (!t.keepGuestStreaming) {
        this.setHdRender(e, !1);
        try {
          this.sendCommand(e, "Page.stopScreencast").catch(() => {});
        } catch {}
      }
      try {
        e.screencast.paintBackground && !e.wc.isDestroyed() && e.wc.removeListener("dom-ready", e.screencast.paintBackground);
      } catch {}
      try {
        e.dbg.removeListener("message", e.screencast.msgHandler);
      } catch {}
      e.screencast = void 0;
    }
  }
  stopPipStreamFor(e) {
    try {
      const t = this.resolve(e);
      if (!t.screencast) return;
      t.screencast.pip = !1, 0 === t.screencast.subscribers.size && this.stopPipStream(t);
    } catch {}
  }
  soleWorkspaceId() {
    const e = [...this.targets.values()].filter(e => !e.wc.isDestroyed() && !Rp(e.workspaceId));
    return 1 === e.length ? e[0].workspaceId : void 0;
  }
  hasLiveTarget(e) {
    try {
      return this.resolve(e), !0;
    } catch {
      return !1;
    }
  }
  toolWebContents(e) {
    try {
      return this.resolve(e).wc;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }
}

  };

function Vm(e) {
  if (0 === e.length) return {
    hasPrefill: !1,
    prefillContent: null
  };
  const t = e[e.length - 1];
  if ("assistant" !== t.role) return {
    hasPrefill: !1,
    prefillContent: null
  };
  let n = "";
  n = "string" == typeof t.content ? t.content : t.content.filter(e => "text" === e.type).map(e => e.text).join("");
  const r = n.trim();
  return r.length <= 10 && (r.startsWith("{") || r.startsWith("[")) ? {
    hasPrefill: !0,
    prefillContent: r
  } : {
    hasPrefill: !1,
    prefillContent: null
  };
}
function Zm(e) {
  if (e && "object" == typeof e && !Array.isArray(e)) try {
    return JSON.stringify(e);
  } catch {
    return "{}";
  }
  if ("string" == typeof e) {
    const t = e.trim();
    if (t) try {
      const e = JSON.parse(t);
      if (e && "object" == typeof e && !Array.isArray(e)) return JSON.stringify(e);
    } catch {}
    return "{}";
  }
  return "{}";
}
function Qm(e) {

function tg(e) {
  if (e) switch (e.type) {
    case "auto":
      return "auto";
    case "any":
      return "required";
    case "tool":

        function: {
          name: e.name
        }
      };
    default:
      return;
  }
}

function rg(e) {
  if (e instanceof Error) {
    const t = e.message.toLowerCase();
    return t.includes("not a chat model") || t.includes("not supported in the v1/chat/completions") || t.includes("use v1/completions") || t.includes("use v1/responses");
  }
  return !1;
}
function og(e) {
  const t = [];

    });else {

      });else if ("image" === r.type) e.push({
        type: "input_image",
        image_url: `data:${r.source.media_type};base64,${r.source.data}`
      });else if ("tool_result" === r.type) {
        let e = "";
        "string" == typeof r.content ? e = r.content : Array.isArray(r.content) && (e = r.content.filter(e => "text" === e.type).map(e => e.text).join("\n")), t.push({
          type: "function_call_output",
          call_id: r.tool_use_id.slice(0, 64),
          output: r.is_error ? `Error: ${e}` : e
        });
      }
      e.length > 0 && t.push({
        type: "message",
        role: "user",
        content: e
      });
    }
  } else if ("assistant" === n.role) if ("string" == typeof n.content) n.content && n.content.trim().length > 0 && t.push({
    type: "message",
    role: "assistant",
    content: [{
      type: "output_text",
      text: n.content
    }]
  });else {
    const e = [];
    for (const r of n.content) "text" === r.type ? r.text && r.text.trim().length > 0 && e.push(r.text) : "tool_use" === r.type && t.push({
      type: "function_call",

      name: r.name,

async function* ig(e, t) {
  const n = qm("msg");

    o = 0,
    s = null;
