    } catch (o) {
      console.log("[TelegramBot] Follow reaction error:", o instanceof Error ? o.message : o);
    }
  }
  async transcribeGroupVoice(e, t, n, r) {
    try {
      const o = await import("fs");
      if (!o.existsSync(t)) return;
      const s = wi.getSettings();
      if (!s) return;
      const i = JSON.parse(s.settingsData);
      if (!1 === i?.whisper?.enabled) return;
      try {
        const {
            whisperService: s
          } = await Promise.resolve().then(() => Kz),
          a = i?.whisper,
          c = a?.model || "base",
          l = a?.language || "auto";
        if (s.isModelDownloaded(c)) {
          await s.initialize(c, l);
          const {
              execFile: i
            } = await import("child_process"),
            {
              promisify: a
            } = await import("util"),
            d = await import("os"),
            u = (await import("path")).default.join(d.default.tmpdir(), `alma-tg-stt-${Date.now()}.wav`);
          try {
            await a(i)("ffmpeg", ["-y", "-i", t, "-ac", "1", "-ar", "16000", "-f", "wav", u], {
              timeout: 3e4,
              windowsHide: !0
            });
            const c = await o.promises.readFile(u),
              l = c.indexOf(Buffer.from("data"));
            if (l > 0) {
              const t = c.readUInt32LE(l + 4),
                o = l + 8,
                i = c.subarray(o, o + t),
                a = new Int16Array(i.buffer, i.byteOffset, Math.floor(i.byteLength / 2)),
                d = new Float32Array(a.length);
              for (let e = 0; e < a.length; e++) d[e] = a[e] / 32768;
              const u = (await s.transcribe(d, 16e3)).trim();
              if (u) return void this.updateGroupVoiceTranscription(e, n, u, r);
            }
          } finally {
            await o.promises.rm(u, {
              force: !0
            });
          }
        }
      } catch {}
      const a = wi.getAllProviders();
      let c = null;
      for (const e of a) if ("openai" === e.type && e.apiKey && "dummy" !== e.apiKey && !e.baseURL) {
        c = e.apiKey;
        break;
      }
      if (!c) return;
      const l = await o.promises.readFile(t),
        d = t.split(".").pop() || "ogg",
        u = "mp3" === d ? "audio/mpeg" : "audio/ogg",
        h = new FormData();
      h.append("file", new Blob([l], {
        type: u
      }), `voice.${d}`), h.append("model", "whisper-1");
      const p = await Ma("https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/transcriptions", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${c}`
        },
        body: h
      });
      if (!p.ok) return;
      const f = await p.json(),
        m = f.text?.trim();
      if (!m) return;
      this.updateGroupVoiceTranscription(e, n, m, r);
    } catch (o) {
      console.error("[TelegramBot] Group voice transcription error:", o instanceof Error ? o.message : o);
    }
  }

  }

      onCallbackQuery: (e, t, n, r, o) => this.handleCallbackQuery(e, t, n, r, o)
    }), this.connectWebSocket(), await this.bot.start(), this.startHealthCheck(), console.log("[MessageBridge] Started")) : console.log("[MessageBridge] Telegram not enabled or no token");
  }
  async stop() {
    this.healthCheckTimer && (clearInterval(this.healthCheckTimer), this.healthCheckTimer = null), await this.bot?.stop(), this.bot = null, this.ws?.close(), this.ws = null, this.reconnectTimer && clearTimeout(this.reconnectTimer), this.activeGenerations.clear(), console.log("[MessageBridge] Stopped");
  }

    this.healthCheckTimer && clearInterval(this.healthCheckTimer), this.healthCheckTimer = setInterval(async () => {

          await this.bot.start(), console.log("[MessageBridge] Bot polling restarted successfully");
        } catch (e) {
          console.error("[MessageBridge] Failed to restart bot polling:", e);
        }
      }
    }, 3e4);
  }

  connectWebSocket() {
    this.ws && this.ws.close(), this.ws = new on(`ws://127.0.0.1:${this.port}/ws/threads`), this.ws.on("open", () => {
      console.log("[MessageBridge] WebSocket connected");
    }), this.ws.on("message", e => {
      try {
        const t = JSON.parse(e.toString());
        this.handleWsMessage(t);
      } catch (t) {
        console.error("[MessageBridge] WS parse error:", t);
      }
    }), this.ws.on("close", () => {
      console.log("[MessageBridge] WebSocket disconnected"), this.cleanupAllGenerations("WebSocket 断连，请重新发送消息。"), this.scheduleReconnect();
    }), this.ws.on("error", e => {
      console.error("[MessageBridge] WebSocket error:", e.message);
    });
  }
  scheduleReconnect() {
    this.bot?.isRunning() && (this.reconnectTimer && clearTimeout(this.reconnectTimer), this.reconnectTimer = setTimeout(() => this.connectWebSocket(), 3e3));
  }

  async handleCommand(e, t, n, r) {
    try {
      switch (n) {
        case "start":
          await this.bot?.sendMessage(e, "👋 Welcome to Alma!\n\nSend me any message and I'll respond using AI.\n\nCommands:\n/new [title] - Start a new conversation\n/threads - List your conversations\n/thread <number> - Switch to a conversation\n/stop - Stop current generation\n/model - Show/switch current model");
          break;
        case "new":
          {
            const n = r || "New Chat",
              o = wi.getSettings(),
              s = o ? JSON.parse(o.settingsData) : {},
              i = s?.telegram?.defaultModel || s?.chat?.defaultModel,
              a = String(t),
              c = Pg.getActiveMapping("telegram", String(e), a),

            Pg.setActiveThread("telegram", String(e), a, d.id);
            const u = l ? ` (继承自 ${l.slice(0, 8)}…)` : "";
            await this.bot?.sendMessage(e, `✅ 新对话已创建: "${n}"${u}`);
            break;
          }
        case "threads":
          {
            const n = Pg.getUserMappings("telegram", String(t));
            if (0 === n.length) {
              await this.bot?.sendMessage(e, "No conversations yet. Just send a message to start one!");
              break;
            }
            let r = "📋 Your conversations:\n\n";
            for (let e = 0; e < n.length; e++) {
              const t = n[e],
                o = wi.getThreadById(t.threadId),
                s = t.isActive ? " ✅" : "";
              r += `${e + 1}. ${o?.title || "Untitled"}${s}\n`;
            }
            r += "\nUse /thread <number> to switch.", await this.bot?.sendMessage(e, r);
            break;
          }
        case "thread":
          {
            const n = parseInt(r);
            if (!n || n < 1) {
              await this.bot?.sendMessage(e, "Usage: /thread <number>\nUse /threads to see the list.");
              break;
            }
            const o = Pg.getUserMappings("telegram", String(t));
            if (n > o.length) {
              await this.bot?.sendMessage(e, `Thread #${n} not found. Use /threads to see available conversations.`);
              break;
            }
            const s = o[n - 1];
            Pg.setActiveThread("telegram", String(e), String(t), s.threadId);
            const i = wi.getThreadById(s.threadId);
            await this.bot?.sendMessage(e, `✅ 已切换到: "${i?.title || "Untitled"}"`);
            break;
          }
        case "stop":
          for (const [t, n] of this.activeGenerations.entries()) if (n.chatId === e) return this.ws?.readyState === on.OPEN && this.ws.send(JSON.stringify({
            type: "stop_generation",
            data: {
              threadId: t
            }
          })), await this.bot?.sendMessage(e, "🛑 Generation stopped."), void this.cleanupGeneration(t);
          await this.bot?.sendMessage(e, "No active generation to stop.");
          break;
        case "model":
          {
            const t = wi.getSettings(),
              n = t ? JSON.parse(t.settingsData) : {},
              r = n?.telegram?.defaultModel,
              o = n?.chat?.defaultModel,
              s = r || o || "Not set",
              i = await this.buildProviderKeyboard();
            i.length > 0 ? await this.bot?.sendMessageWithInlineKeyboard(e, `🤖 Current model: ${s}\n\nSelect a provider to browse models:`, i) : await this.bot?.sendMessage(e, `🤖 Current model: ${s}\n\nNo providers configured.`);
            break;
          }
        default:
          await this.bot?.sendMessage(e, `Unknown command: /${n}\nSend /start for help.`);
      }
    } catch (o) {
      console.error("[MessageBridge] handleCommand error:", o), e > 0 && (await this.bot?.sendMessage(e, "❌ 命令执行失败").catch(() => {}));
    }
  }

  handleWsMessage(e) {
    if (!pH(e) || "string" != typeof e.type || !pH(e.data)) return;
    const {
      type: t,
      data: n
    } = e;
    mH("[MessageBridge] WS event:", t, n?.threadId || "");
    const r = "string" == typeof n.threadId ? n.threadId : null;
    switch (t) {
      case "message_delta":
        {
          const e = "string" == typeof n.messageId ? n.messageId : null,
            t = Array.isArray(n.deltas) ? n.deltas.map(fH).filter(e => null !== e) : [];
          r && e && this.handleMessageDelta({
            messageId: e,
            threadId: r,
            deltas: t
          });
          break;
        }
      case "message_added":
        break;
      case "generation_completed":
        r && this.handleGenerationCompleted({
          threadId: r
        }).catch(e => mH("[MessageBridge] Completion handling failed:", e));
        break;
      case "generation_error":
        r && this.handleGenerationError({
          threadId: r,
          error: "string" == typeof n.error ? n.error : void 0,
          model: "string" == typeof n.model ? n.model : void 0
        }).catch(e => mH("[MessageBridge] Error handling failed:", e));
    }
  }
  handleMessageDelta(e) {
    const t = this.activeGenerations.get(e.threadId);
    if (t && !t.completed) {
      t.generationTimer && (t.lastActivity = Date.now());
      for (const n of e.deltas) if ("text_append" !== n.type || "text" !== n.partType && "output_text" !== n.partType) {
        if ("text-delta" === n.type && n.textDelta) t.accumulatedText += n.textDelta;else if ("part_add" !== n.type || "text" !== n.part?.type && "output_text" !== n.part?.type || !n.part?.text) {
          if ("part_add" === n.type && ("tool-invocation" === n.part?.type || n.part?.type?.startsWith?.("tool-") && !n.part?.type?.includes?.("result"))) {
            const e = n.part.toolInvocation?.toolName || n.part.toolName || "unknown";
            if (t.toolStatus.push(`🔧 Using: ${e}`), t.hadToolCalls = !0, t.lastActivity = Date.now(), mH("[MessageBridge] Tool detected via delta:", e, "partType:", n.part?.type), 1 === t.toolStatus.length) {
              t.userMessageId && this.bot?.setReaction(t.chatId, t.userMessageId, "⚡").catch(() => {});
              const e = t.accumulatedText.trim();
              e && (this.bot?.sendMessage(t.chatId, e, void 0, void 0, t.topicId).catch(() => {}), t.earlySentText = e, t.accumulatedText = e, mH("[MessageBridge] Sent early acknowledgment:", e.substring(0, 80)));
            }
          } else mH("[MessageBridge] Delta type:", n.type, "partType:", n.partType, "part?.type:", n.part?.type);
        } else t.accumulatedText += n.part.text;
      } else t.accumulatedText += n.text ?? "";
    }
  }
  async handleGenerationCompleted(e) {

  scheduleToolWaitRecovery(e, t, n) {
    setTimeout(async () => {
      const r = this.activeGenerations.get(e);
      if (!r || r !== t || r.completed || r.responseSent) return;
      mH(`[MessageBridge] Tool-wait recovery triggered for thread: ${e} after ${n}ms`);
      if (t.startTime && Date.now() - t.startTime > 6e5) mH("[MessageBridge] Tool-wait hard cap reached (600000ms), forcing cleanup");else try {
        const n = wi.getThreadById(e);
        if (n?.isGenerating) return mH("[MessageBridge] Thread still generating on server, extending wait"), void this.scheduleToolWaitRecovery(e, t, 15e3);
      } catch {}
      try {
        const n = [...wi.getMessagesByThreadId(e)].reverse().find(e => "assistant" === ("string" == typeof e.message ? JSON.parse(e.message) : e.message).role);
        if (n) {
          const r = "string" == typeof n.message ? JSON.parse(n.message) : n.message;
          let o = (r.parts || []).filter(e => "text" === e.type).map(e => e.text).join("\n").trim();
          if (!o) {
            const e = (r.parts || []).find(e => "tool-AttemptCompletion" === e.type && e.output?.result);
            e && (o = e.output.result, mH(`[MessageBridge] Tool-wait recovery: extracted text from AttemptCompletion, length=${o.length}`));
          }
          if (o) {

const bH = /^\s*(`{3,}|~{3,})(.*)$/;
function vH(e, t = 2e3) {
  if (!Number.isInteger(t) || t < 64) throw new Error("Invalid Discord message limit");
  if (e.length <= t) return [e];
  const n = [];
  let r = e,
    o = "";
  for (; r;) {
    const e = o ? `${o}\n` : "",
      s = e + r;
    if (s.length <= t) {
      n.push(s);
      break;
    }
    const i = t - 12,
      a = e.length + Math.floor((i - e.length) / 2);
    let c = s.lastIndexOf("\n", i),
      l = 1;
    if (c <= a && (c = s.lastIndexOf(" ", i), c <= a)) {
      c = i, l = 0;
      const e = s.charCodeAt(c - 1);
      e >= 55296 && e <= 56319 && c--;
    }
    let d = s.slice(0, c);
    r = s.slice(c + l);
    const u = EH(d);
    u ? (d += `\n${u.marker}`, o = u.line.length <= 100 ? u.line : u.marker) : o = "", n.push(d);
  }
  return n;
}
function EH(e) {
  let t = null;
  for (const n of e.split("\n")) {
    const e = bH.exec(n);
    if (!e) continue;
    const r = e[1];
    t ? r[0] === t.marker[0] && r.length >= t.marker.length && !e[2].trim() && (t = null) : t = {
      marker: r,
      line: n.trim()
    };
  }
  return t;
}

function xH(e) {
  return e.replace(/\s+/g, "");
}
function IH(e, t) {
  const n = xH(t);
  if (!n) return e.trim();
  let r = 0,
    o = 0;
  for (; o < e.length && r < n.length; o++) if (!/\s/.test(e[o])) {
    if (e[o] !== n[r]) return e.trim();
    r++;
  }
  return r === n.length ? e.slice(o).trim() : e.trim();
}

  async handleCommand(e, t, n, r) {
    try {
      switch (n) {
        case "start":
        case "help":
          await this.sendMessageDedup(e, "👋 **Alma** here!\n\nSend me any message and I'll respond using AI.\n\n**Commands:**\n`/new [title]` - Start a new conversation\n`/stop` - Stop current generation\n`/model` - Show/switch current model");
          break;
        case "new":
          {
            const n = r || "New Chat",
              o = wi.getSettings(),
              s = o ? JSON.parse(o.settingsData) : {},
              i = s?.discord?.defaultModel || s?.chat?.defaultModel,
              a = Pg.getActiveMapping("discord", e, t),
              c = a?.threadId,
              l = wi.createThread(n, i, Rg("discord", e), void 0, c);
            Pg.setActiveThread("discord", e, t, l.id);
            const d = c ? ` (inherited from ${c.slice(0, 8)}…)` : "";
            await this.sendMessageDedup(e, `✅ New conversation created: "${n}"${d}\n🆔 Thread: \`${l.id}\``);
            break;
          }
        case "stop":
          for (const [t, n] of Array.from(this.activeGenerations.entries())) if (n.channelId === e) return this.ws?.readyState === on.OPEN && this.ws.send(JSON.stringify({
            type: "stop_generation",
            data: {
              threadId: t
            }
          })), await this.sendMessageDedup(e, "🛑 Generation stopped."), void this.cleanupGeneration(t);
          await this.sendMessageDedup(e, "No active generation to stop.");
          break;
        case "model":
          {
            const t = wi.getSettings(),
              n = t ? JSON.parse(t.settingsData) : {},
              r = n?.discord?.defaultModel || n?.chat?.defaultModel || "Not set",
              o = await this.buildProviderSelectMenu();
            o.length > 0 ? await this.bot?.sendMessageWithComponents(e, `🤖 Current model: ${r}\n\nSelect a provider to browse models:`, o) : await this.sendMessageDedup(e, `🤖 Current model: ${r}\n\nNo providers configured.`);
            break;
          }
        default:
          this.handleMessage(e, t, `/${n} ${r}`.trim(), void 0, void 0);
      }
    } catch (o) {
      console.error("[DiscordBridge] handleCommand error:", o), await this.sendMessageDedup(e, "❌ Command failed").catch(() => {});
    }
  }
  modelSelectCache = new Map();
  async buildProviderSelectMenu() {
    try {
      const e = OH(),
        t = await hH();
      if (0 === t.length) return [];
      const n = t.slice(0, 25).map(t => new e.StringSelectMenuOptionBuilder().setLabel(t.name).setValue(`mp:${t.id}`).setDescription(t.type)),
        r = new e.StringSelectMenuBuilder().setCustomId("model_provider_select").setPlaceholder("Select a provider...").addOptions(n);
      return [new e.ActionRowBuilder().addComponents(r)];
    } catch (e) {
      return console.error("[DiscordBridge] buildProviderSelectMenu error:", e), [];
    }
  }
  buildModelSelectMenu(e, t) {
    try {
      const n = OH();
      this.modelSelectCache.set(e, t);
      const r = t.slice(0, 25).map((t, r) => new n.StringSelectMenuOptionBuilder().setLabel(t.length > 100 ? t.substring(0, 97) + "..." : t).setValue(`ms:${e}:${r}`)),
        o = new n.StringSelectMenuBuilder().setCustomId("model_select").setPlaceholder("Select a model...").addOptions(r),
        s = new n.ButtonBuilder().setCustomId("model_back").setLabel("Back to providers").setStyle(n.ButtonStyle.Secondary);
      return [new n.ActionRowBuilder().addComponents(o), new n.ActionRowBuilder().addComponents(s)];
    } catch (n) {
      return console.error("[DiscordBridge] buildModelSelectMenu error:", n), [];
    }
  }
  async handleComponentInteraction(e, t, n) {
    try {
      if (n.startsWith("mp:")) {
        const e = n.slice(3),
          t = await uH(e);
        if (!t) return {
          content: "❌ Provider not found"
        };
        const r = t.enabledModels;
        return 0 === r.length ? {
          content: `📦 ${t.name} has no enabled models.`,
          components: await this.buildProviderSelectMenu()
        } : {
          content: `📦 **${t.name}** — Select a model:`,
          components: this.buildModelSelectMenu(e, r)
        };
      }
      if (n.startsWith("ms:")) {
        const e = n.slice(3),
          t = e.lastIndexOf(":");
        if (t < 0) return {
          content: "❌ Invalid selection"
        };
        const r = e.substring(0, t),
          o = parseInt(e.substring(t + 1), 10),
          s = this.modelSelectCache.get(r);
        if (!s || o < 0 || o >= s.length) return {
          content: "❌ Session expired, use /model again"
        };
        const i = `${r}:${s[o]}`,
          a = wi.getSettings(),
          c = a ? JSON.parse(a.settingsData) : {};
        return c.discord || (c.discord = {}), c.discord.defaultModel = i, wi.saveSettings(JSON.stringify(c)), {
          content: `✅ Model switched to: **${i}**\n\nSelect a provider to change again:`,
          components: await this.buildProviderSelectMenu()
        };
      }
      if ("model_back" === n) {
        const e = wi.getSettings(),
          t = e ? JSON.parse(e.settingsData) : {};
        return {
          content: `🤖 Current model: ${t?.discord?.defaultModel || t?.chat?.defaultModel || "Not set"}\n\nSelect a provider to browse models:`,
          components: await this.buildProviderSelectMenu()
        };
      }
      return null;
    } catch (r) {
      return console.error("[DiscordBridge] handleComponentInteraction error:", r), {
        content: "❌ Error processing selection"
      };
    }
  }
  handleWsMessage(e) {
    const {
        type: t,
        data: n
      } = e,
      r = n?.threadId;
    if (r && ("generation_completed" === t || "generation_error" === t || "message_delta" === t)) {
      const e = this.activeGenerations.has(r);
      if ("message_delta" === t) {
        const n = this.activeGenerations.get(r);
        n && 0 === n.accumulatedText.length ? RH(`[DiscordBridge] WS event: ${t} ${r} tracked=${e} (first delta)`) : e || this.R.has(r) || (this.R.add(r), RH(`[DiscordBridge] WS event message_delta for UNTRACKED thread ${r} — further deltas will be silently skipped`));
      } else RH(`[DiscordBridge] WS event: ${t} ${r} tracked=${e} activeKeys=[${Array.from(this.activeGenerations.keys()).join(", ")}]`), e || RH(`[DiscordBridge] WS event ${t} for UNTRACKED thread ${r} — event will still be processed`);
    }
    switch (t) {
      case "message_delta":
        this.handleMessageDelta(n);
        break;
      case "generation_completed":
        this.handleGenerationCompleted(n);
        break;
      case "generation_error":
        this.handleGenerationError(n);
    }
  }

  }

  async detectCommitment(e) {
    try {
      const {
          getEffectiveToolModel: t
        } = await Promise.resolve().then(() => Yw),
        {
          parseModelString: n
        } = await Promise.resolve().then(() => _m),
        {
          getAIModelByProviderId: r,
          getUnifiedProvider: o,
          getAIModel: s
        } = await Promise.resolve().then(() => zv),
        {
          generateText: i
        } = await import("ai"),
        {
          providerRegistry: a
        } = await Promise.resolve().then(() => If),
        c = await t();
      if (!c.model) return !1;
      const l = n(c.model);
      if (!l) return !1;
      let d;
      if (a.isPluginProvider(l.providerId)) d = await r(l.providerId, l.modelId);else {
        const e = await o(l.providerId);
        if (!e?.dbProvider) return !1;
        d = await s(e.dbProvider, l.modelId);
      }
      if (!d) return !1;
      const u = await i({
          model: d,
          messages: [{
            role: "user",
            content: `Analyze this chat message and determine if it contains a COMMITMENT or PROMISE to perform an action that requires using tools/commands (like writing files, running commands, searching, fetching data, etc.).\n\nA commitment means the speaker said they WILL DO something concrete (not just chatting/discussing). Examples:\n- "我现在就去写" → YES (promised to write something)\n- "I'll look that up for you" → YES (promised to search)\n- "Let me handle that" → YES (promised to do something)\n- "好的我知道了" → NO (just acknowledging)\n- "That's interesting" → NO (just chatting)\n\nMessage to analyze:\n"${e.substring(0, 300)}"\n\nReply with ONLY "YES" or "NO". Nothing else.`
          }]
        }),
        h = u.text?.trim().toUpperCase();
      return RH("[DiscordBridge] Commitment detection result:", h, "for:", e.substring(0, 50)), "YES" === h;
    } catch (t) {
      return RH("[DiscordBridge] Commitment detection error:", t instanceof Error ? t.message : t), !1;
    }
  }

  }

class KH {
  brand;
  phase = "idle";
  verificationUrl = null;
  qrDataUrl = null;
  scanPurpose = "app";
  lastError = null;
  appInfo = null;
  profileName = null;
  initProcess = null;
  loginCancelled = !1;
  onConnected = null;
  constructor(e) {
    this.brand = e;
  }
  setOnConnected(e) {
    this.onConnected = e;
  }

  }
  async run(e, t = {}) {

  }

  }
  parseJson(e) {

  }
  async isConfigured() {

        timeoutMs: 15e3
      }),
      t = JH(e.stdout || e.stderr);
    if (!Array.isArray(t)) return !1;

    return this.profileName = r.name || r.appId || null, !0;
  }
  async refreshAppInfo() {
    try {
      const e = await this.run(["config", "show"], {
          timeoutMs: 15e3
        }),
        t = JH(e.stdout || e.stderr);
      this.appInfo = t && !1 !== t.ok ? t : null;
    } catch {
      this.appInfo = null;
    }
  }
  async getState() {
    return "idle" !== this.phase && "connected" !== this.phase || ((await this.isConfigured().catch(() => !1)) ? ("connected" === this.phase && this.appInfo || (await this.refreshAppInfo()), this.phase = "connected") : "connected" === this.phase && (this.phase = "idle", this.appInfo = null)), {
      phase: this.phase,
      brand: this.brand,
      verificationUrl: this.verificationUrl,
      qrDataUrl: this.qrDataUrl,
      scanPurpose: this.scanPurpose,
      error: this.lastError,
      configured: "connected" === this.phase,
      appInfo: this.appInfo,
      cliVersion: await YH().catch(() => null),
      cliPath: WH()
    };
  }
  async startConnect() {
    if ("installing" === this.phase || "pending_scan" === this.phase || "finalizing" === this.phase) return this.getState();
    this.lastError = null, this.verificationUrl = null, this.qrDataUrl = null;
    try {
      this.phase = "installing", await zH();
    } catch (e) {
      return this.phase = "error", this.lastError = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e), this.getState();
    }
    return (await this.isConfigured()) ? (await this.ensureUserSessionAndConnect(), this.getState()) : (this.launchConfigInit(), this.getState());
  }
  launchConfigInit() {
    const e = WH();
    if (!e) return this.phase = "error", void (this.lastError = "lark-cli not installed");
    this.phase = "pending_scan", this.scanPurpose = "app";
    let t = "";
    const n = It(e, ["config", "init", "--new", "--brand", this.brand, "--name", `alma-${this.brand}`], {
      env: qH(),
      stdio: ["pipe", "pipe", "pipe"]
    });
    this.initProcess = n, n.stdin?.end();
    const r = setTimeout(() => {
        try {
          n.kill("SIGKILL");
        } catch {}
      }, 6e5),
      o = e => {
        if (t += e.toString(), !this.verificationUrl) {
          const e = FH(t).match(PH);
          e && (this.verificationUrl = e[0], LH(`[LarkCli:${this.brand}] Verification URL:`, this.verificationUrl), this.generateQr(this.verificationUrl).catch(e => LH(`[LarkCli:${this.brand}] QR generation failed:`, e?.message)));
        }
      };
    n.stdout?.on("data", o), n.stderr?.on("data", o), n.on("error", e => {
      clearTimeout(r), this.initProcess = null, this.phase = "error", this.lastError = e.message;
    }), n.on("exit", e => {
      clearTimeout(r), this.initProcess = null, "pending_scan" === this.phase && this.finalizeConnect(e ?? -1, t).catch(e => {
        this.phase = "error", this.lastError = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
      });
    }), LH(`[LarkCli:${this.brand}] config init --new started`);
  }
  async finalizeConnect(e, t) {
    if (this.phase = "finalizing", this.verificationUrl = null, this.qrDataUrl = null, 0 !== e) {
      this.phase = "error";
      const n = FH(t).trim().split("\n").slice(-3).join(" ").slice(0, 300);
      return this.lastError = n || `lark-cli config init exited with code ${e}`, void LH(`[LarkCli:${this.brand}] config init failed:`, this.lastError);
    }
    (await this.isConfigured()) ? (await this.ensureUserSessionAndConnect()) && LH(`[LarkCli:${this.brand}] Connected (app + user). Profile:`, this.profileName) : (this.phase = "error", this.lastError = "连接验证失败：lark-cli 配置未生效");
  }
  async hasUserSession() {
    try {
      const e = await this.run(["auth", "status"], {
          timeoutMs: 15e3
        }),
        t = JH(e.stdout || e.stderr);
      return !0 === t?.identities?.user?.available;
    } catch {
      return !1;
    }
  }
  async ensureUserSessionAndConnect() {
    if (await this.refreshAppInfo(), !(await this.hasUserSession())) {
      this.loginCancelled = !1;
      try {
        await this.runUserLogin();
      } catch (e) {
        return this.loginCancelled || (this.phase = "error", this.lastError = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e), LH(`[LarkCli:${this.brand}] user auth login failed:`, this.lastError)), !1;
      }
    }
    return this.verificationUrl = null, this.qrDataUrl = null, this.phase = "connected", this.lastError = null, this.onConnected?.(), !0;
  }
  async runUserLogin() {
    const e = await this.run(["auth", "login", "--no-wait", "--json", "--domain", "drive,docs,sheets,wiki"], {
        timeoutMs: 3e4
      }),
      t = JH(e.stdout || e.stderr),
      n = t?.device_code,
      r = t?.verification_url;
    if (!n || !r) {
      const t = FH(e.stderr || e.stdout).trim().slice(0, 200);
      throw new Error(t || "auth login 初始化失败");
    }
    const o = 1e3 * ("number" == typeof t.expires_in ? t.expires_in : 600);
    this.verificationUrl = r, this.scanPurpose = "user", await this.generateQr(r).catch(e => LH(`[LarkCli:${this.brand}] user QR generation failed:`, e?.message)), this.phase = "pending_scan", LH(`[LarkCli:${this.brand}] user auth login device flow started`);
    const s = Date.now() + o;
    for (; Date.now() < s;) {
      if (this.loginCancelled) throw new Error("cancelled");
      if (await this.run(["auth", "login", "--device-code", n], {
        timeoutMs: 3e4
      }).catch(() => {}), this.loginCancelled) throw new Error("cancelled");
      if (await this.hasUserSession()) return;
      await GH(3e3);
    }
    throw new Error("用户授权超时，请重试 Drive/文档授权");
  }
  async generateQr(e) {
    const {
      default: t
    } = await import("qrcode");
    this.qrDataUrl = await t.toDataURL(e, {
      width: 320,
      margin: 2
    });
  }
  cancelConnect() {
    if (this.loginCancelled = !0, this.initProcess) {
      try {
        this.initProcess.kill("SIGKILL");
      } catch {}
      this.initProcess = null;
    }
    "pending_scan" !== this.phase && "installing" !== this.phase && "error" !== this.phase || (this.phase = "idle", this.verificationUrl = null, this.qrDataUrl = null, this.lastError = null);
  }
  async disconnect() {
    this.cancelConnect(), WH() ? (await this.isConfigured().catch(() => !1), this.profileName && (await this.run(["auth", "logout"], {
      timeoutMs: 2e4,
      stdin: "y\n"
    }).catch(() => {}), await XH(["profile", "remove", this.profileName], {
      timeoutMs: 2e4,
      stdin: "y\n"
    }).catch(() => {}), (await this.isConfigured().catch(() => !1)) && (await this.run(["config", "remove"], {
      timeoutMs: 2e4,
      stdin: "y\n"
    }).catch(() => {}), await this.isConfigured().catch(() => !1))), this.profileName = null, this.appInfo = null, this.phase = "idle", LH(`[LarkCli:${this.brand}] Disconnected (profile removed)`)) : this.phase = "idle";
  }
}

        t && (s = await this.downloadMessageResource(t, i, "file", o), this.log(`${this.logTag} File downloaded: ${s}`)), l = s ? `[用户发来一个文件「${n}」，已保存到本地: ${s}（可用工具读取/分析其内容）]` : `[文件: ${n}]`;
      } else if ("audio" === a) {
        const t = e.file_key;
        this.log(`${this.logTag} Audio message received, file_key=${t}, duration=${e.duration}`);
        let n = null,

      } else if ("post" === a) {

    }
    if (c) {

        t = e.some(e => e.id?.open_id === this.botOpenId || "Alma" === e.name),
        s = l.toLowerCase().includes("alma");

          from: a,
          text: l || "[media]",
          isBot: !1,

  async transcribeAudio(e) {
    try {
      if (!T.existsSync(e)) return null;
      const {
          databaseService: n
        } = await Promise.resolve().then(() => bi),
        r = n.getSettings(),
        o = r ? JSON.parse(r.settingsData) : {};
      try {
        const {
            whisperService: t
          } = await Promise.resolve().then(() => Kz),
          n = o?.whisper?.model || "base",
          r = o?.whisper?.language || "auto";
        if (t.isModelDownloaded(n)) {
          await t.initialize(n, r);
          const o = Y.join(D.tmpdir(), `alma-feishu-stt-${Date.now()}.wav`);
          try {
            await QH("ffmpeg", ["-y", "-i", e, "-ac", "1", "-ar", "16000", "-f", "wav", o], {
              timeout: 3e4,
              windowsHide: !0
            });
            const n = await T.promises.readFile(o),
              r = n.indexOf(Buffer.from("data"));
            if (r > 0) {
              const e = n.readUInt32LE(r + 4),
                o = r + 8,
                s = n.subarray(o, o + e),
                i = new Int16Array(s.buffer, s.byteOffset, Math.floor(s.byteLength / 2)),
                a = new Float32Array(i.length);
              for (let t = 0; t < i.length; t++) a[t] = i[t] / 32768;
              const c = (await t.transcribe(a, 16e3)).trim();
              if (c) return c;
            }
          } finally {
            await T.promises.rm(o, {
              force: !0
            });
          }
        }
      } catch (t) {
        this.log(`${this.logTag} Local STT failed, trying remote:`, t instanceof Error ? t.message : t);
      }
      const {
          databaseService: s
        } = await Promise.resolve().then(() => bi),
        i = s.getAllProviders();
      let a = null;
      for (const e of i) if ("openai" === e.type && e.apiKey && "dummy" !== e.apiKey && !e.baseURL) {
        a = e.apiKey;
        break;
      }
      if (!a) return null;
      const {
          networkFetch: c
        } = await Promise.resolve().then(() => ac),
        l = await T.promises.readFile(e),
        d = new FormData();
      d.append("file", new Blob([l], {
        type: "audio/ogg"
      }), "voice.opus"), d.append("model", "whisper-1");
      const u = await c("https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/transcriptions", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${a}`
        },
        body: d
      });
      if (!u.ok) return null;
      const h = await u.json();
      return h.text?.trim() || null;
    } catch (t) {
      return this.log(`${this.logTag} transcribeAudio error:`, t instanceof Error ? t.message : t), null;
    }
  }
  static MAX_TEXT_CHUNK_CHARS = 2e4;
  splitTextForSend(e) {
    const t = tq.MAX_TEXT_CHUNK_CHARS;
    if (e.length <= t) return [e];
    const n = [];
    let r = e;
    for (; r.length > t;) {
      let e = r.lastIndexOf("\n", t);
      e < .5 * t && (e = t), n.push(r.slice(0, e)), r = r.slice(e);
    }
    return r.trim().length > 0 && n.push(r), n;
  }
  async sendMessage(e, t, n) {
    return (await this.sendMessageWithOutcome(e, t, n)).messageId;
  }
  async sendMessageWithOutcome(e, t, n) {
    const r = this.splitTextForSend(t);
    let o = null,
      s = 0;
    try {
      for (let t = 0; t < r.length; t++) {
        let i;
        i = n && 0 === t ? await this.api("POST", `/open-apis/im/v1/messages/${n}/reply`, {
          data: {
            msg_type: "text",
            content: JSON.stringify({
              text: r[t]
            })
          }
        }) : await this.api("POST", "/open-apis/im/v1/messages", {
          params: {
            receive_id_type: "chat_id"
          },
          data: {
            receive_id: e,
            msg_type: "text",
            content: JSON.stringify({
              text: r[t]
            })
          }
        }), s++, o = i?.message_id || o;
      }
    } catch (i) {
      return this.log(`${this.logTag} sendMessage error:`, i instanceof Error ? i.message : i), {
        messageId: o,
        delivery: 0 === s && i instanceof eq ? "failed" : "unknown"
      };
    }
    try {
      this.addToGroupHistory(e, "Alma", t.substring(0, 200), !0, void 0, void 0, o || void 0), this.lastBotReplyTime.set(e, Date.now()), this.saveState();
    } catch (i) {
      this.log(`${this.logTag} sendMessage bookkeeping error:`, i instanceof Error ? i.message : i);
    }
    return {
      messageId: o,
      delivery: "sent"
    };
  }

  addToGroupHistory(e, t, n, r, o, s, i) {

  }

  getGroupChatStatus() {

      t = [],

        i = n.length > 0 ? n[n.length - 1].timestamp : null;
      t.push({
        chatId: r,
        platform: this.brand,
        skippedCount: o.length,
        recentMessages: n.slice(-10),
        lastBotReply: s,
        minutesSinceLastBotReply: s ? Math.floor((e - s) / 6e4) : null,

  }
  clearSkippedMessages(e) {
    this.skippedMessages.delete(e);

  loadState() {
    try {
      if (!T.existsSync(this.stateFile)) return;
      const e = JSON.parse(T.readFileSync(this.stateFile, "utf-8")),
        t = Date.now();
      if (e.lastBotReplyTime) for (const [n, r] of Object.entries(e.lastBotReplyTime)) this.lastBotReplyTime.set(n, r);
      if (e.groupHistory) for (const [n, r] of Object.entries(e.groupHistory)) {
        const e = r.filter(e => t - e.timestamp < tq.GROUP_HISTORY_TTL_MS);
        e.length > 0 && this.groupHistory.set(n, e);
      }
      this.log(`${this.logTag} Loaded state: ${this.lastBotReplyTime.size} reply times, ${this.groupHistory.size} histories`);
    } catch (e) {
      this.log(`${this.logTag} Failed to load state:`, e);
    }
  }
  saveState() {
    this.stateSaveTimer && clearTimeout(this.stateSaveTimer), this.stateSaveTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      try {
        const e = Y.dirname(this.stateFile);
        T.existsSync(e) || T.mkdirSync(e, {
          recursive: !0
        });
        const t = {
          lastBotReplyTime: Object.fromEntries(this.lastBotReplyTime),
          groupHistory: Object.fromEntries(Array.from(this.groupHistory.entries()).map(([e, t]) => [e, t.slice(-30)])),
          savedAt: new Date().toISOString()
        };
        T.writeFileSync(this.stateFile, JSON.stringify(t, null, 2));
      } catch (e) {
        this.log(`${this.logTag} Failed to save state:`, e);
      }
    }, 2e3);
  }
  startEventConsumer() {
    if (!this.running) return;
    const e = this.manager.findCli();
    if (!e) return void this.log(`${this.logTag} lark-cli not found, cannot consume events`);
    this.stopEventConsumer();
    const t = It(e, [...this.manager.profileArgs(), "event", "consume", "im.message.receive_v1", "--as", "bot", "--quiet"], {
      env: (() => {
        const e = {
          ...process.env
        };
        return delete e.OPENCLAW_HOME, delete e.HERMES_HOME, e;
      })(),
      stdio: ["pipe", "pipe", "pipe"]
    });
    this.consumerProcess = t;
    let n = "";
    t.stdout?.on("data", e => {
      let t;
      for (n += e.toString(); (t = n.indexOf("\n")) >= 0;) {
        const e = n.slice(0, t).trim();
        if (n = n.slice(t + 1), e) try {
          const t = JSON.parse(e);
          this.consumerRestartDelayMs = 5e3, this.handleConsumeEvent(t).catch(e => this.log(`${this.logTag} Event handling error:`, e instanceof Error ? e.message : e));
        } catch {
          this.log(`${this.logTag} Non-JSON consumer line:`, e.slice(0, 200));
        }
      }
    }), t.stderr?.on("data", e => {
      const t = e.toString().trim();
      t && this.log(`${this.logTag} consumer stderr:`, t.slice(0, 500));
    }), t.on("error", e => {
      this.log(`${this.logTag} consumer spawn error:`, e.message), this.scheduleConsumerRestart();
    }), t.on("exit", e => {
      this.consumerProcess === t && (this.consumerProcess = null), this.log(`${this.logTag} Event consumer exited with code ${e}`), this.scheduleConsumerRestart();
    }), this.log(`${this.logTag} Event consumer started (im.message.receive_v1)`);
  }
  scheduleConsumerRestart() {
    if (!this.running) return;
    if (this.consumerRestartTimer) return;
    const e = this.consumerRestartDelayMs;
    this.consumerRestartDelayMs = Math.min(2 * this.consumerRestartDelayMs, tq.MAX_CONSUMER_RESTART_DELAY_MS), this.log(`${this.logTag} Restarting event consumer in ${e}ms`), this.consumerRestartTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      this.consumerRestartTimer = null, this.startEventConsumer();
    }, e);
  }
  stopEventConsumer() {
    if (this.consumerRestartTimer && (clearTimeout(this.consumerRestartTimer), this.consumerRestartTimer = null), this.consumerProcess) {
      const e = this.consumerProcess;
      this.consumerProcess = null;
      try {
        e.stdout?.removeAllListeners(), e.stderr?.removeAllListeners(), e.removeAllListeners();
      } catch {}
      try {
        e.kill("SIGTERM");
      } catch {}
      const t = setTimeout(() => {
        try {
          null === e.exitCode && e.kill("SIGKILL");
        } catch {}
      }, 3e3);
      t.unref?.(), e.on("exit", () => clearTimeout(t));
    }
  }
  startHealthCheck() {
    this.healthCheckTimer && clearInterval(this.healthCheckTimer), this.consecutiveHealthFailures = 0, this.healthCheckTimer = setInterval(async () => {
      if (!this.running) return;
      if (!this.consumerProcess && !this.consumerRestartTimer) return this.log(`${this.logTag} Event consumer not running, restarting...`), void this.startEventConsumer();
      const e = Date.now(),
        t = this.lastEventTime ? e - this.lastEventTime : e - (this.startedAt || e);
      if (t < tq.MAX_SILENCE_MS) this.consecutiveHealthFailures = 0;else if (!(0 === this.consecutiveHealthFailures && e - this.lastConnectivityProbeTime < tq.IDLE_PROBE_INTERVAL_MS)) {
        this.lastConnectivityProbeTime = e, this.log(`${this.logTag} No events for ${Math.round(t / 1e3)}s, checking connectivity...`);
        try {
          const e = await this.api("GET", "/open-apis/bot/v3/info", {
            timeoutMs: 2e4
          });
          if (e?.bot || e) return this.consecutiveHealthFailures = 0, void this.log(`${this.logTag} Health check passed (API reachable, connection likely idle)`);
          this.consecutiveHealthFailures++;
        } catch (n) {
          this.consecutiveHealthFailures++, this.log(`${this.logTag} Health check failed: ${n instanceof Error ? n.message : n}, failures=${this.consecutiveHealthFailures}`);
        }
        this.consecutiveHealthFailures >= 3 && (this.log(`${this.logTag} 3 consecutive health check failures, restarting event consumer...`), this.consecutiveHealthFailures = 0, this.startEventConsumer());
      }
    }, tq.HEALTH_CHECK_INTERVAL_MS);
  }
  async start() {
    if (!this.running || !this.consumerProcess) {
      this.running = !0, this.startedAt = Date.now();
      try {
        const e = await this.api("GET", "/open-apis/bot/v3/info", {
            timeoutMs: 3e4
          }),
          t = e?.bot || e;
        t?.open_id && (this.botOpenId = t.open_id, this.log(`${this.logTag} Bot info: ${t.app_name || ""} (open_id: ${this.botOpenId})`));
      } catch (e) {
        this.log(`${this.logTag} Failed to get bot info:`, e instanceof Error ? e.message : e);
      }
      this.startEventConsumer(), this.startHealthCheck(), this.log(`${this.logTag} Started via lark-cli event bus (health check enabled)`);
    }
  }
  async stop() {
    this.running = !1, this.healthCheckTimer && (clearInterval(this.healthCheckTimer), this.healthCheckTimer = null), this.stopEventConsumer(), this.log(`${this.logTag} Stopped`);
  }
  isRunning() {
    return !!this.running && (null !== this.consumerProcess || null !== this.consumerRestartTimer);
  }
  getBotOpenId() {
    return this.botOpenId;
  }
  getStatus() {
    const e = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
      t = Y.join(D.tmpdir(), "alma-logs", `${this.logName}-${e}.log`);
    return {
      running: this.running,
      startedAt: this.startedAt,
      lastEventTime: this.lastEventTime,
      wsConnected: null !== this.consumerProcess,
      consecutiveHealthFailures: this.consecutiveHealthFailures,
      logFile: t
    };
  }
}

  startHealthCheck() {
    this.healthCheckTimer && clearInterval(this.healthCheckTimer), this.healthCheckTimer = setInterval(async () => {
      if (this.bot && !this.bot.isRunning()) {
        this.log("[FeishuBridge] Bot died unexpectedly, restarting...");
        try {
          await this.bot.start(), this.log("[FeishuBridge] Bot restarted successfully");

  connectWebSocket() {
    if (this.ws) try {
      this.ws.close();
    } catch {}
    this.ws = new on(`ws://127.0.0.1:${this.port}/ws/threads`), this.ws.on("open", () => {
      this.log("[FeishuBridge] WebSocket connected"), this.reconnectAttempts = 0, this.startPing();
    }), this.ws.on("message", e => {
      try {
        const t = JSON.parse(e.toString());
        this.handleWsMessage(t);
      } catch (t) {
        this.log("[FeishuBridge] WS parse error:", t);
      }
    }), this.ws.on("close", () => {
      this.log("[FeishuBridge] WebSocket disconnected"), this.stopPing(), this.cleanupAllGenerations("WebSocket disconnected"), this.scheduleReconnect();
    }), this.ws.on("error", e => {
      this.log("[FeishuBridge] WebSocket error:", e.message);
    });
  }
  startPing() {
    this.stopPing(), this.pingTimer = setInterval(() => {
      this.ws?.readyState === on.OPEN && this.ws.ping();
    }, rq.PING_INTERVAL_MS);
  }
  stopPing() {
    this.pingTimer && (clearInterval(this.pingTimer), this.pingTimer = null);
  }
  scheduleReconnect() {
    if (!this.bot?.isRunning()) return;
    this.reconnectTimer && clearTimeout(this.reconnectTimer);
    const e = Math.min(rq.BASE_RECONNECT_DELAY_MS * Math.pow(2, this.reconnectAttempts), rq.MAX_RECONNECT_DELAY_MS);
    this.reconnectAttempts++, this.log(`[FeishuBridge] Reconnecting in ${e}ms (attempt ${this.reconnectAttempts})`), this.reconnectTimer = setTimeout(() => this.connectWebSocket(), e);
  }

  }

  }

  handleWsMessage(e) {
    const {
      type: t,
      data: n
    } = e;
    switch (t) {
      case "message_delta":
        this.handleMessageDelta(n);
        break;
      case "generation_completed":
        this.handleGenerationCompleted(n);
        break;
      case "generation_error":
        this.handleGenerationError(n);
    }
  }
  handleMessageDelta(e) {
    const t = this.activeGenerations.get(e.threadId);
    if (t && !t.completed) {
      t.generationTimer && (t.lastActivity = Date.now());
      for (const n of e.deltas) if ("text_append" === n.type && "text" === n.partType) t.accumulatedText += n.text;else if ("text-delta" === n.type && n.textDelta) t.accumulatedText += n.textDelta;else if ("part_add" === n.type && "text" === n.part?.type && n.part?.text) t.accumulatedText += n.part.text;else if ("part_add" === n.type && ("tool-invocation" === n.part?.type || n.part?.type?.startsWith?.("tool-"))) {
        const e = n.part?.toolInvocation?.toolName || n.part?.toolName || "unknown";
        if (t.toolStatus.push(`🔧 Using: ${e}`), t.hadToolCalls = !0, 1 === t.toolStatus.length) {
          const e = t.accumulatedText.trim();
          e && (this.bot?.sendMessage(t.channelId, e).catch(() => {}), t.earlySentText = e);
        }
      }
    }
  }
  async sendFilesFromToolResults(e, t, n) {
    try {
      const o = [...wi.getMessagesByThreadId(t)].reverse().find(e => "assistant" === ("string" == typeof e.message ? JSON.parse(e.message) : e.message).role);
      if (!o) return;
      const s = ("string" == typeof o.message ? JSON.parse(o.message) : o.message).parts || [],
        i = /([/~](?:[^\s`"'<>()[\]{}])+\.\w+)/g,
        a = new Set(["jpg", "jpeg", "png", "gif", "webp", "bmp", "svg", "tiff", "heic", "heif", "avif"]);
      for (const t of s) {
        if (!(t.type || "").startsWith("tool-")) continue;
        const o = "string" == typeof t.result ? t.result : t.text || "";
        if (o) for (const t of o.matchAll(i)) {
          let o = t[1].replace(/[.,;:!?)]+$/, "");
          if (o.startsWith("~") && (o = o.replace("~", process.env.HOME || D.homedir())), o.includes("/selfies/") || o.includes("/alma/selfies")) continue;
          if (n.has(o)) continue;
          if (!T.existsSync(o)) continue;
          try {
            if (!T.statSync(o).isFile()) continue;
          } catch {
            continue;
          }
          const s = Y.extname(o).replace(".", "").toLowerCase();
          try {
            a.has(s) ? await this.bot?.sendPhoto(e, o) : await this.bot?.sendFile(e, o), n.add(o);
          } catch (r) {
            this.log(`[FeishuBridge] Failed to send tool result file ${o}:`, r);
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (r) {
      this.log("[FeishuBridge] sendFilesFromToolResults error:", r);
    }
  }

function lq() {

async function pq(e, t) {
  const n = new AbortController(),
    r = setTimeout(() => n.abort(), 15e3);
  try {
    const r = await fetch(e, {
        method: "GET",
        headers: {
          "X-WECHAT-UIN": lq(),
          ...t
        },
        signal: n.signal
      }),
      o = await r.text();
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}: ${o}`);
    return JSON.parse(o);
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(r);
  }
}
async function fq(e, t, n, r) {

}
async function mq(e, t) {
  if (!e) return null;
  if (!e.encrypt_query_param && !e.full_url) return null;
  try {
    const n = e.full_url || `${iq}/download?encrypted_query_param=${encodeURIComponent(e.encrypt_query_param)}`,
      r = t ? Buffer.from(t, "hex").toString("base64") : e.aes_key;
    cq("[WeixinBot] CDN downloading:", n.substring(0, 120));
    const o = await fetch(n);
    if (!o.ok) {
      const e = await o.text().catch(() => "");
      return cq("[WeixinBot] CDN download failed:", o.status, e.substring(0, 200)), null;
    }
    const s = Buffer.from(await o.arrayBuffer());
    if (cq("[WeixinBot] CDN downloaded:", s.length, "bytes"), r) {
      const e = function (e, t) {
        const n = kt.createDecipheriv("aes-128-ecb", t, null);
        return Buffer.concat([n.update(e), n.final()]);
      }(s, function (e) {
        if (/^[0-9a-fA-F]{32}$/.test(e)) return Buffer.from(e, "hex");
        const t = Buffer.from(e, "base64");
        if (16 === t.length) return t;
        if (32 === t.length && /^[0-9a-fA-F]{32}$/.test(t.toString("ascii"))) return Buffer.from(t.toString("ascii"), "hex");
        throw new Error(`Invalid AES key: ${e}`);
      }(r));
      return cq("[WeixinBot] CDN decrypted:", e.length, "bytes, magic:", e.slice(0, 4).toString("hex")), e;
    }
    return s;
  } catch (n) {
    return cq("[WeixinBot] CDN error:", n instanceof Error ? n.message : n), null;
  }
}
function gq(e) {
  if (!e) return "application/octet-stream";
  const t = e.split(".").pop()?.toLowerCase();
  return {
    jpg: "image/jpeg",
    jpeg: "image/jpeg",
    png: "image/png",
    gif: "image/gif",
    webp: "image/webp",
    mp4: "video/mp4",
    mov: "video/quicktime",
    avi: "video/x-msvideo",
    webm: "video/webm",
    mp3: "audio/mpeg",
    wav: "audio/wav",
    ogg: "audio/ogg",
    m4a: "audio/mp4",
    pdf: "application/pdf",
    doc: "application/msword",
    docx: "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
    xls: "application/vnd.ms-excel",
    xlsx: "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
    ppt: "application/vnd.ms-powerpoint",
    pptx: "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation",
    txt: "text/plain",
    csv: "text/csv",
    json: "application/json",
    xml: "application/xml",
    zip: "application/zip",
    rar: "application/x-rar-compressed",
    "7z": "application/x-7z-compressed"
  }[t || ""] || "application/octet-stream";
}
function yq(e) {
  let t = e;
  return t = t.replace(/^```[a-zA-Z]*\s*$/gm, ""), t = t.replace(/^#{1,6}\s+(.+)$/gm, "$1"), t = t.replace(/\*{1,3}([^*]+)\*{1,3}/g, "$1"), t = t.replace(/_{1,3}([^_]+)_{1,3}/g, "$1"), t = t.replace(/`([^`]+)`/g, "$1"), t = t.replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)/g, "$1 ($2)"), t = t.replace(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\([^)]+\)/g, "$1"), t = t.replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n"), t.trim();
}

  async processMessages(e, t) {

  }
  isMediaItem(e) {

  }
  async downloadMediaItem(e) {
    try {
      if (2 === e.type) {

        };
      }
    } catch (t) {

    }
    return null;
  }
  async sendReply(e, t) {

      await this.sendVoiceMessage(e, t.voiceBuffer);
    } catch (n) {
      cq("[WeixinBot] sendVoiceMessage failed:", n instanceof Error ? n.message : n);
    }
    if (t.mediaFiles) for (const r of t.mediaFiles) try {
      await this.sendMediaMessage(e, r);
    } catch (n) {
      cq("[WeixinBot] sendMediaMessage failed:", r, n instanceof Error ? n.message : n);
    }
  }
  async sendTextMessage(e, t) {
    if (!this.credentials) return;
    const n = this.contextTokens.get(e) || "",
      r = yq(t);
    cq("[WeixinBot] Sending text to", e, ":", r.substring(0, 100)), await this.sendMessageItem(e, n, {
      type: 1,
      text_item: {
        text: r
      }
    });
  }
  async sendMediaMessage(e, t, n) {
    if (!this.credentials) return;
    const r = this.contextTokens.get(e) || "",
      o = gq(t),
      s = Y.basename(t);
    let i;
    i = o.startsWith("image/") ? 1 : o.startsWith("video/") ? 2 : 3, cq("[WeixinBot] Uploading media:", s, "type:", i, "mime:", o);
    try {
      const o = await this.uploadToCdn(t, e, i);
      if (n) {
        const t = yq(n);
        t.trim() && (await this.sendMessageItem(e, r, {
          type: 1,
          text_item: {
            text: t
          }
        }));
      }
      const a = Buffer.from(o.aeskey).toString("base64"),
        c = {
          encrypt_query_param: o.downloadParam,
          aes_key: a,
          encrypt_type: 1
        };
      let l;
      l = 1 === i ? {
        type: 2,
        image_item: {
          media: c,
          mid_size: o.ciphertextSize
        }
      } : 2 === i ? {
        type: 5,
        video_item: {
          media: c,
          video_size: o.ciphertextSize
        }
      } : {
        type: 4,
        file_item: {
          media: c,
          file_name: s,
          len: String(o.plaintextSize)
        }
      }, await this.sendMessageItem(e, r, l), cq("[WeixinBot] Media sent:", s);
    } catch (a) {
      throw cq("[WeixinBot] sendMediaMessage failed:", a instanceof Error ? a.message : a), a;
    }
  }
  async sendVoiceMessage(e, t) {
    if (!this.credentials) return;
    const n = Date.now(),
      r = Y.join(D.tmpdir(), `alma-voice-in-${n}`),
      o = Y.join(D.tmpdir(), `alma-voice-${n}.mp3`);
    await T.promises.writeFile(r, t);
    try {
      await oq("ffmpeg", ["-i", r, "-c:a", "libmp3lame", "-b:a", "128k", "-y", o], {
        timeout: 3e4,
        windowsHide: !0
      }), await this.sendMediaMessage(e, o), cq("[WeixinBot] Voice MP3 sent to", e);
    } catch {
      const r = Y.join(D.tmpdir(), `alma-voice-${n}.ogg`);
      await T.promises.writeFile(r, t);
      try {
        await this.sendMediaMessage(e, r), cq("[WeixinBot] Voice file sent to", e);
      } finally {
        await T.promises.rm(r, {
          force: !0
        });
      }
    } finally {
      await Promise.all([T.promises.rm(r, {
        force: !0
      }), T.promises.rm(o, {
        force: !0
      })]);
    }
  }
  async sendMessageItem(e, t, n) {
    this.credentials && (await fq(this.credentials.base_url, "/ilink/bot/sendmessage", {
      msg: {
        to_user_id: e,
        from_user_id: "",
        client_id: kt.randomUUID(),
        message_type: 2,
        message_state: 2,
        context_token: t,
        item_list: [n]
      },
      base_info: aq
    }, this.credentials.bot_token));
  }
  async uploadToCdn(e, t, n) {
    if (!this.credentials) throw new Error("No credentials");
    const r = await T.promises.readFile(e),
      o = r.length,
      s = kt.createHash("md5").update(r).digest("hex"),
      i = 16 * Math.ceil((o + 1) / 16),
      a = kt.randomBytes(16).toString("hex"),
      c = kt.randomBytes(16);
    cq("[WeixinBot] CDN upload: rawsize=", o, "cipherSize=", i);
    const l = await fq(this.credentials.base_url, "/ilink/bot/getuploadurl", {
        filekey: a,
        media_type: n,
        to_user_id: t,
        rawsize: o,
        rawfilemd5: s,
        filesize: i,
        no_need_thumb: !0,
        aeskey: c.toString("hex"),
        base_info: aq
      }, this.credentials.bot_token),
      d = l.upload_full_url?.trim(),
      u = l.upload_param;
    if (!d && !u) throw new Error("getUploadUrl returned no upload URL");
    const h = function (e, t) {
        const n = kt.createCipheriv("aes-128-ecb", t, null);
        return Buffer.concat([n.update(e), n.final()]);
      }(r, c),
      p = d || `${iq}/upload?encrypted_query_param=${encodeURIComponent(u)}&filekey=${encodeURIComponent(a)}`;
    let f;
    cq("[WeixinBot] CDN uploading to:", p.substring(0, 120));
    for (let m = 1; m <= 3; m++) {
      const e = await fetch(p, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/octet-stream"
        },
        body: new Uint8Array(h)
      });
      if (e.status >= 400 && e.status < 500) {
        const t = e.headers.get("x-error-message") || (await e.text());
        throw new Error(`CDN upload client error ${e.status}: ${t}`);
      }
      if (200 === e.status) {
        if (f = e.headers.get("x-encrypted-param") || void 0, f) break;
        throw new Error("CDN response missing x-encrypted-param header");
      }
      cq("[WeixinBot] CDN upload attempt", m, "failed:", e.status);
    }
    if (!f) throw new Error("CDN upload failed after 3 attempts");
    return {
      downloadParam: f,
      aeskey: c.toString("hex"),
      plaintextSize: o,
      ciphertextSize: i
    };
  }
  async sendTyping(e) {
    if (!this.credentials) return;
    const t = this.contextTokens.get(e) || "";
    if (t) try {
      const n = await fq(this.credentials.base_url, "/ilink/bot/getconfig", {
        ilink_user_id: e,
        context_token: t,
        base_info: aq
      }, this.credentials.bot_token);
      n.typing_ticket && (await fq(this.credentials.base_url, "/ilink/bot/sendtyping", {
        ilink_user_id: e,
        typing_ticket: n.typing_ticket,
        status: 1,
        base_info: aq
      }, this.credentials.bot_token));
    } catch {}
  }
  startTypingLoop(e, t = 1e4) {
    let n = !1;
    const r = Date.now(),
      o = () => {
        if (n || Date.now() - r > 6e5) return n = !0, void clearInterval(s);
        this.sendTyping(e).catch(() => {});
      };
    o();
    const s = setInterval(o, t);
    return () => {
      n = !0, clearInterval(s);
    };
  }
  async stop() {
    cq("[WeixinBot] Stopping..."), this.running = !1, this.abortController?.abort(), this.abortController = null, this.startedAt = null;
  }
  async doLogout() {
    await this.stop(), function () {
      try {
        T.unlinkSync(Y.join(dq(), "credentials.json"));
      } catch {}
      try {
        T.unlinkSync(Y.join(dq(), "cursor.json"));
      } catch {}
    }(), this.credentials = null, this.loggedIn = !1, this.qrUrl = null, this.qrToken = null, this.contextTokens.clear();
  }
  isRunning() {
    return this.running;
  }
  isUserLoggedIn() {
    if (this.loggedIn) return !0;
    const e = uq();
    return !!e && (this.credentials = e, this.loggedIn = !0, !0);
  }
  getCapturedQrUrl() {
    return this.qrUrl;
  }
  isQrExpired() {
    return this.qrExpired;
  }
  isTokenStale() {
    return this.tokenStale;
  }
  isLoginInProgress() {
    return this.loginInProgress;
  }
  getStatus() {
    const e = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    return {
      running: this.running,
      loggedIn: this.isUserLoggedIn() && !this.tokenStale,
      startedAt: this.startedAt,
      lastEventTime: this.lastEventTime,
      logFile: Y.join(D.tmpdir(), "alma-logs", `weixin-bot-${e}.log`)
    };
  }
  sleep(e) {
    return new Promise(t => {
      const n = setTimeout(t, e);
      this.abortController?.signal.addEventListener("abort", () => {
        clearTimeout(n), t();
      }, {
        once: !0
      });
    });
  }
}
function bq(e, ...t) {
  const n = `${new Date().toISOString()} ${e} ${t.map(e => "object" == typeof e ? JSON.stringify(e) : String(e)).join(" ")}\n`;
  try {
    const e = Y.join(D.tmpdir(), "alma-logs");
    T.existsSync(e) || T.mkdirSync(e, {
      recursive: !0
    });
    const t = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    T.appendFileSync(Y.join(e, `weixin-bridge-${t}.log`), n);
  } catch {}
  console.log(e, ...t);
}
function vq(e) {
  return {
    "image/jpeg": "jpg",
    "image/png": "png",
    "image/gif": "gif",
    "image/webp": "webp",
    "video/mp4": "mp4",
    "video/quicktime": "mov",
    "video/webm": "webm",
    "audio/mpeg": "mp3",
    "audio/wav": "wav",
    "audio/ogg": "ogg",
    "application/pdf": "pdf",
    "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document": "docx",
    "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet": "xlsx",
    "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation": "pptx",
    "application/msword": "doc",
    "application/vnd.ms-excel": "xls",
    "application/zip": "zip",
    "text/plain": "txt",
    "application/json": "json"
  }[e] || e.split("/")[1]?.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "") || "bin";
}
class Eq {
  bot = null;
  ws = null;
  settings;
  port;
  pendingGenerations = new Map();
  reconnectTimer = null;
  reconnectAttempts = 0;
  pingTimer = null;
  static MAX_RECONNECT_DELAY_MS = 3e4;
  static BASE_RECONNECT_DELAY_MS = 1e3;
  static PING_INTERVAL_MS = 3e4;
  static IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS = 3e5;
  static IDLE_TIMEOUT_TOOL_MS = 9e5;
  static DETACHED_MAX_MS = 72e5;
  static WATCHDOG_TICK_MS = 15e3;
  constructor(e, t) {
    this.settings = e, this.port = t;
  }
  async start() {
    this.settings.enabled ? (this.bot = new wq((e, t, n, r) => this.handleMessage(e, t, n, r)), this.connectWebSocket(), this.bot.isUserLoggedIn() && (bq("[WeixinBridge] Resuming from persisted session"), await this.bot.start()), bq("[WeixinBridge] Started")) : bq("[WeixinBridge] WeChat not enabled");
  }
  async stop() {
    await this.bot?.stop(), this.bot = null, this.stopPing(), this.ws?.close(), this.ws = null, this.reconnectTimer && clearTimeout(this.reconnectTimer);
    for (const [, e] of this.pendingGenerations) clearInterval(e.watchdog), e.reject(new Error("Bridge stopped"));
    this.pendingGenerations.clear(), bq("[WeixinBridge] Stopped");
  }
  isRunning() {
    return this.bot?.isRunning() ?? !1;
  }
  getStatus() {
    const e = this.bot?.getStatus() ?? {
        running: !1,
        loggedIn: !1,
        startedAt: null,
        lastEventTime: null,
        logFile: ""
      },
      t = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    return {
      ...e,
      bridgeLogFile: Y.join(D.tmpdir(), "alma-logs", `weixin-bridge-${t}.log`)
    };
  }
  updateSettings(e, t) {
    this.settings = e, this.port = t;
  }
  getBot() {
    return this.bot;
  }
  async startLogin() {
    this.bot || (this.bot = new wq((e, t, n, r) => this.handleMessage(e, t, n, r))), await this.bot.startLogin();
  }
  async waitForLoginAndStart() {
    if (this.bot) {
      for (this.ws && this.ws.readyState === on.OPEN || this.connectWebSocket(); this.bot.isLoginInProgress();) {
        const e = await this.bot.pollLoginStatus();
        if ("confirmed" === e.status) return bq("[WeixinBridge] Login confirmed, starting bot"), void (await this.bot.start());
        if ("expired" === e.status && this.bot.isQrExpired()) return void bq("[WeixinBridge] QR expired, giving up");
        await new Promise(e => setTimeout(e, 2e3));
      }
      this.bot.isUserLoggedIn() && !this.bot.isRunning() && (await this.bot.start());
    }
  }
  async doLogout() {
    await this.bot?.doLogout();
  }
  getQrCodeUrl() {
    return this.bot?.getCapturedQrUrl() ?? null;
  }
  isQrExpired() {
    return this.bot?.isQrExpired() ?? !1;
  }
  connectWebSocket() {
    if (this.ws) try {
      this.ws.close();
    } catch {}
    this.ws = new on(`ws://127.0.0.1:${this.port}/ws/threads`), this.ws.on("open", () => {
      bq("[WeixinBridge] WebSocket connected"), this.reconnectAttempts = 0, this.startPing();
    }), this.ws.on("message", e => {
      try {
        this.handleWsMessage(JSON.parse(e.toString()));
      } catch (t) {
        bq("[WeixinBridge] WS parse error:", t);
      }
    }), this.ws.on("close", () => {
      bq("[WeixinBridge] WebSocket disconnected"), this.stopPing(), this.scheduleReconnect();
    }), this.ws.on("error", e => {
      bq("[WeixinBridge] WebSocket error:", e.message);
    });
  }
  startPing() {
    this.stopPing(), this.pingTimer = setInterval(() => {
      this.ws?.readyState === on.OPEN && this.ws.ping();
    }, Eq.PING_INTERVAL_MS);
  }
  stopPing() {
    this.pingTimer && (clearInterval(this.pingTimer), this.pingTimer = null);
  }
  scheduleReconnect() {
    if (!this.bot?.isRunning()) return;
    this.reconnectTimer && clearTimeout(this.reconnectTimer);
    const e = Math.min(Eq.BASE_RECONNECT_DELAY_MS * Math.pow(2, this.reconnectAttempts), Eq.MAX_RECONNECT_DELAY_MS);
    this.reconnectAttempts++, this.reconnectTimer = setTimeout(() => this.connectWebSocket(), e);
  }
  async handleMessage(e, t, n, r) {
    if (bq("[WeixinBridge] handleMessage", {
      conversationId: e,
      text: t?.substring(0, 100),
      media: r?.length || 0
    }), !(t.trim() || r && 0 !== r.length)) return {};
    try {
      const n = wi.getSettings(),
        o = n ? JSON.parse(n.settingsData) : {},
        s = o?.weixin?.defaultModel,
        i = s || o?.chat?.defaultModel,
        a = Rg("weixin", e),
        {
          threadId: c,
          isNew: l
        } = await Pg.getOrCreateMapping("weixin", e, e, i, a);
      if (l && wi.updateThread(c, {
        title: `WeChat: ${e}`
      }), !l && a) {
        const e = wi.getThreadById(c);
        e && e.workspaceId !== a && wi.updateThread(c, {
          workspaceId: a
        });
      }
      const d = wi.getThreadById(c),
        u = s || d?.model || i;
      if (!u) return {
        text: "No model configured. Please set a default model in Alma settings."
      };
      if (this.ws?.readyState !== on.OPEN) return {
        text: "Connection to Alma is not available."
      };
      const h = r?.some(e => "audio" === e.type) ?? !1;
      return await this.generateAndWait(c, e, u, t, r, h);
    } catch (o) {
      const e = o instanceof Error ? o.stack || o.message : String(o);
      return bq("[WeixinBridge] handleMessage error:", e), {
        text: `⚠️ Error:\n${e}`
      };
    }
  }
  generateAndWait(e, t, n, r, o, s = !1) {
    return new Promise((i, a) => {
      const c = Date.now(),
        l = {
          threadId: e,
          conversationId: t,
          accumulatedText: "",
          earlySentText: "",
          hadToolCalls: !1,
          isVoiceInput: s,
          resolve: i,
          reject: a,
          watchdog: setInterval(() => this.checkIdle(l), Eq.WATCHDOG_TICK_MS),
          startedAt: c,
          lastActivity: c,
          detached: !1
        },
        d = this.pendingGenerations.get(e);
      d && clearInterval(d.watchdog), this.pendingGenerations.set(e, l);
      const u = [];
      if (r.trim() && u.push({
        type: "text",
        text: r
      }), o) {
        for (const e of o) u.push({
          type: "file",
          mediaType: e.mimeType,
          url: `data:${e.mimeType};base64,${e.buffer.toString("base64")}`,
          ...(e.fileName ? {
            filename: e.fileName
          } : {})
        });
        if (!r.trim()) {
          const e = "image" === o[0].type ? "What is in this image?" : "audio" === o[0].type ? "Please transcribe this audio." : `Received a ${o[0].type} file${o[0].fileName ? `: ${o[0].fileName}` : ""}.`;
          u.unshift({
            type: "text",
            text: e
          });
        }
      }
      this.ws.send(JSON.stringify({
        type: "generate_response",
        data: {
          threadId: e,
          model: n,
          userMessage: {
            role: "user",
            parts: u
          },
          ephemeralContext: '[System: The user is chatting via WeChat (微信). This is a messaging channel with FULL file-sending capability.\n\nWECHAT CHANNEL FILE SENDING: You CAN send files (PDF, images, videos, documents, etc.) to the user. When the user asks for a file, use a tool to write it to disk. The file will be AUTOMATICALLY detected and sent to the user via WeChat — do NOT mention the file path in your text reply. Just say something like "Here is the PDF" and the file will be delivered alongside your message. Do NOT say you cannot send files.\n\nTEXT FORMATTING: WeChat does NOT render Markdown. Keep responses in plain text. Do not use markdown headers, bold, italic, or code blocks — they will be stripped before sending.]',
          source: "weixin"
        }
      }));
    });
  }
  handleWsMessage(e) {
    switch (e.type) {
      case "message_delta":
        this.handleMessageDelta(e.data);
        break;
      case "generation_completed":
        this.handleGenerationCompleted(e.data);
        break;
      case "generation_error":
        this.handleGenerationError(e.data);
    }
  }
  checkIdle(e) {
    if (this.pendingGenerations.get(e.threadId) !== e) return void clearInterval(e.watchdog);
    const t = Date.now();
    if (e.detached) return void (t - e.startedAt > Eq.DETACHED_MAX_MS && (clearInterval(e.watchdog), this.pendingGenerations.delete(e.threadId), bq("[WeixinBridge] Detached generation expired:", e.threadId)));
    const n = e.hadToolCalls ? Eq.IDLE_TIMEOUT_TOOL_MS : Eq.IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS;
    t - e.lastActivity < n || (e.detached = !0, bq("[WeixinBridge] Generation idle, detaching; reply will be sent on completion:", e.threadId), e.resolve({
      text: "⏳ 还在处理中，完成后会把结果发给你。"
    }));
  }
  async deliver(e, t) {
    if (e.detached) try {
      await this.bot?.sendReply(e.conversationId, t);
    } catch (n) {
      bq("[WeixinBridge] Late delivery failed:", n instanceof Error ? n.message : n);
    } else e.resolve(t);
  }
  handleMessageDelta(e) {
    const t = this.pendingGenerations.get(e.threadId);
    if (t) {
      t.lastActivity = Date.now();
      for (const n of e.deltas) if ("text_append" !== n.type || "text" !== n.partType && "output_text" !== n.partType ? "text-delta" === n.type && n.textDelta ? t.accumulatedText += n.textDelta : "part_add" === n.type && "text" === n.part?.type && n.part?.text && (t.accumulatedText += n.part.text) : t.accumulatedText += n.text, "part_add" === n.type && ("tool-invocation" === n.part?.type || "dynamic-tool" === n.part?.type || n.part?.type?.startsWith?.("tool-") && !n.part?.type?.includes?.("result")) && !t.hadToolCalls) {
        t.hadToolCalls = !0;
        const e = t.accumulatedText.trim();
        e && this.bot && (this.bot.sendTextMessage(t.conversationId, e).catch(() => {}), t.earlySentText = e, bq("[WeixinBridge] Sent early acknowledgment:", e.substring(0, 80)));
      }
    }
  }
  async handleGenerationCompleted(e) {
    const t = this.pendingGenerations.get(e.threadId);
    if (!t) return;
    clearInterval(t.watchdog), this.pendingGenerations.delete(e.threadId);
    let n = t.accumulatedText.trim();
    const r = [];
    try {
      const t = wi.getMessagesByThreadId(e.threadId),
        o = e.assistantMessageId && t.find(t => t.id === e.assistantMessageId) || [...t].reverse().find(e => "assistant" === ("string" == typeof e.message ? JSON.parse(e.message) : e.message).role);
      if (o) {
        const e = ("string" == typeof o.message ? JSON.parse(o.message) : o.message).parts || [],
          t = e.filter(e => ("text" === e.type || "output_text" === e.type) && "string" == typeof e.text).map(e => e.text).join("\n").trim(),
          s = e.find(e => "tool-AttemptCompletion" === e.type && "string" == typeof e.output?.result),
          i = s ? String(s.output.result).trim() : "",
          a = i && !xH(t).includes(xH(i)) ? [t, i].filter(Boolean).join("\n") : t;
        a && (n = a), bq("[WeixinBridge] Assistant parts count:", e.length, "types:", e.map(e => `${e.type}${e.result ? "(has result)" : ""}${e.output ? "(has output)" : ""}`).join(", "));
        const c = /(\/[^\s,.)。，"'`]+\.[a-zA-Z0-9]{1,10})/g;
        for (const n of e) {
          if ("file" === n.type && n.url) if (!n.url.startsWith("data:") && T.existsSync(n.url)) r.push(n.url);else if (n.url.startsWith("data:")) {
            const e = n.url.match(/^data:([^;]+);base64,(.+)$/);
            if (e) {
              const t = n.mediaType || e[1] || "application/octet-stream",
                o = Buffer.from(e[2], "base64"),
                s = vq(t),
                i = Y.join(D.tmpdir(), `alma-weixin-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}.${s}`);
              await T.promises.writeFile(i, o), r.push(i);
            }
          }
          const e = n.output || n.result || (n.type?.startsWith?.("tool-") ? "" : null);
          if ("string" == typeof e && e.includes("/")) {
            let t;
            for (bq("[WeixinBridge] Scanning tool output for files:", n.type, e.substring(0, 200)), c.lastIndex = 0; null !== (t = c.exec(e));) {
              const e = t[1];
              try {
                !r.includes(e) && T.existsSync(e) && T.statSync(e).isFile() && (r.push(e), bq("[WeixinBridge] Extracted file from tool output:", e));
              } catch {}
            }
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (c) {
      bq("[WeixinBridge] DB recovery error:", c);
    }
    if (t.earlySentText && (n = IH(n, t.earlySentText)), n) {
      const e = /(\/[^\s,.)。，]+\.[a-zA-Z0-9]{1,10})/g;
      let t;
      for (; null !== (t = e.exec(n));) {
        const e = t[1];
        try {
          T.existsSync(e) && T.statSync(e).isFile() && !r.includes(e) && (r.push(e), bq("[WeixinBridge] Extracted file path from text:", e));
        } catch {}
      }
      for (const o of r) n = n.split(o).join("");
      n = n.replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n").trim();
    }
    const o = new Set(["wav", "mp3", "ogg", "opus", "m4a", "silk"]),
      s = [],
      i = [];
    for (const l of r) {
      const e = l.split(".").pop()?.toLowerCase() || "";
      o.has(e) ? s.push(l) : i.push(l);
    }
    let a;
    if (s.length > 0) try {
      a = await T.promises.readFile(s[0]), bq("[WeixinBridge] Using audio file as voice:", s[0], a.length, "bytes");
    } catch {} else t.isVoiceInput && n && !t.hadToolCalls && (a = (await this.textToSpeech(n)) ?? void 0);
    bq("[WeixinBridge] Generation completed:", e.threadId, "text:", n.length, "files:", i.length, "voice:", !!a), await this.deliver(t, {
      text: a ? void 0 : n || void 0,
      mediaFiles: i.length > 0 ? i : void 0,
      voiceBuffer: a
    });
  }
  handleGenerationError(e) {
    const t = this.pendingGenerations.get(e.threadId);
    t && (clearInterval(t.watchdog), this.pendingGenerations.delete(e.threadId), bq("[WeixinBridge] Generation error:", e.threadId, e.error), this.deliver(t, {
      text: `⚠️ Generation error:\n${e.error || "Unknown error"}`
    }));
  }
  async textToSpeech(e) {
    try {
      const t = 4e3,
        n = e.length > t ? e.substring(0, t) + "..." : e,
        r = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${this.port}/api/tts/generate`, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: {
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            text: n
          })
        });
      if (!r.ok) return bq("[WeixinBridge] TTS failed:", r.status), null;
      const o = Buffer.from(await r.arrayBuffer());
      return bq("[WeixinBridge] TTS generated:", o.length, "bytes"), o;
    } catch (t) {
      return bq("[WeixinBridge] TTS error:", t instanceof Error ? t.message : t), null;
    }
  }
}
function kq(e) {
  const t = e.trim().replace(/\s+/g, " ");
  return /^HEARTBEAT_OK/i.test(t) || /HEARTBEAT_OK\s*$/i.test(t);
}
function Tq(e, t) {
  return "heartbeat" === e && kq(function (e) {
    return (Array.isArray(e?.parts) ? e.parts : []).filter(e => "text" === e?.type && "string" == typeof e.text).map(e => e.text).join("\n").trim();
  }(t));
}

  getOrCreateHeartbeatThread() {
    try {
      const t = wi.getSettings(),
        n = t ? JSON.parse(t.settingsData) : {},
        r = n?.chat?.defaultModel,

        if (t) {

            const e = wi.getSqlite();
            e?.prepare("UPDATE chat_threads SET workspace_id = ? WHERE id = ?").run(o, t.id), console.log(`[Heartbeat] Migrated thread to default workspace: ${o}`);
          } catch (e) {
            console.error("[Heartbeat] Failed to migrate thread workspace:", e);
          }
          return t.id;
        }
      }
      const s = wi.createThread("💓 Heartbeat", r, o);
      return n.heartbeat = n.heartbeat || {}, n.heartbeat.threadId = s.id, wi.saveSettings(JSON.stringify(n)), s.id;
    } catch (t) {
      return console.error("[Heartbeat] Failed to get/create thread:", t), null;
    }
  }
  getGlobalConfigDir() {
    return K.join(P.homedir(), ".config", "alma");
  }
  getDateStr(e) {
    const t = new Date(Date.now() - 24 * e * 60 * 60 * 1e3);
    if (this.config.timezone) try {
      return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", {
        timeZone: this.config.timezone
      }).format(t);
    } catch {}
    const n = e => String(e).padStart(2, "0");
    return `${t.getFullYear()}-${n(t.getMonth() + 1)}-${n(t.getDate())}`;
  }
  isDiaryRecorded(e) {
    const t = this.getGlobalConfigDir(),
      n = e => {
        try {
          return _.readFileSync(K.join(t, e), "utf-8").split(/\s+/);
        } catch {
          return [];
        }
      };
    if (n(".reflection-dates").includes(e)) return !0;
    if (n(".last-reflection-date").includes(e)) return !0;
    try {
      const n = _.realpathSync(K.join(t, "diary")),
        r = K.join(t, "memory");
      return !(_.existsSync(r) && _.realpathSync(r) === n) && _.existsSync(K.join(n, `${e}.md`));
    } catch {
      return !1;
    }
  }
  getMissedDiaryDates(e) {
    const t = [];
    for (let n = 1; n <= e; n++) {
      const e = this.getDateStr(n);
      this.isDiaryRecorded(e) || t.push(e);
    }
    return t;
  }
  mayHintReflection(e) {
    const t = this.reflectionHintsSent.get(e) ?? [];
    if (t.length >= 2) return !1;
    const n = t[t.length - 1];
    return void 0 === n || Date.now() - n >= 15e5;
  }
  recordReflectionHint(e) {
    const t = e.slice(e.indexOf(":") + 1);
    for (const n of this.reflectionHintsSent.keys()) n.endsWith(`:${t}`) || this.reflectionHintsSent.delete(n);
    this.reflectionHintsSent.set(e, [...(this.reflectionHintsSent.get(e) ?? []), Date.now()]);
  }
  ensureHeartbeatMd() {
    try {
      const e = this.getGlobalConfigDir();
      _.existsSync(e) || _.mkdirSync(e, {
        recursive: !0
      });
      const t = K.join(e, "HEARTBEAT.md");
      if (_.existsSync(t)) return;
      const n = "# Heartbeat Checklist\n\n- If the user hasn't interacted in over 4 hours (during active hours), send a brief check-in\n- If nothing needs attention, reply HEARTBEAT_OK\n\n\x3c!-- Alma will update this file as you add periodic tasks via chat --\x3e\n";
      _.writeFileSync(t, n, "utf-8"), console.log("[Heartbeat] Created default HEARTBEAT.md at", t);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("[Heartbeat] Failed to create HEARTBEAT.md:", e);
    }
  }
  getConfig() {
    return {
      ...this.config
    };
  }
  getLastHeartbeatTime() {
    return this.lastHeartbeatTime;
  }

const $q = new Set(["application/json", "application/x-ndjson", "application/yaml", "application/x-yaml", "application/toml", "application/xml", "application/javascript", "application/x-javascript", "application/typescript", "application/x-typescript", "application/x-sh", "application/x-shellscript", "application/x-python", "application/x-python-script", "application/sql", "application/x-sql", "application/graphql", "application/x-tex", "application/x-subrip"]),
