function Iq(e, t) {
  if (Oq(e)) return !0;
  const n = (e || "").toLowerCase().split(";")[0].trim();
  return !(n.startsWith("image/") || n.startsWith("audio/") || "application/pdf" === n || n.includes("officedocument")) && xq.has(function (e) {
    if (!e) return "";
    const t = K.basename(e).toLowerCase(),
      n = t.lastIndexOf(".");
    return n >= 0 ? t.slice(n + 1) : t;
  }(t));
}
async function Cq(e, t, n, r) {
  const o = Tt.createHash("sha256").update(t).digest("hex").slice(0, 16),
    s = K.join(e, o),
    i = K.join(s, function (e, t) {
      const n = K.basename(e || "").replace(/[/\\:*?"<>|]/g, "_").replace(/\p{Cc}/gu, "_").replace(/^\.+/, "").trim().slice(0, 180);
      if (n) return n;
      const r = (t || "").split("/")[1]?.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi, "").slice(0, 8);
      return `attachment.${r || "bin"}`;
    }(n, r));
  try {
    if ((await _.promises.stat(i)).size === t.length) return i;
  } catch {}
  return await _.promises.mkdir(s, {
    recursive: !0
  }), await _.promises.writeFile(i, t), i;
}
function Nq(e, t, n, r) {
  return `[Attachment ${e ? `"${e}"` : "file"} (${t || "unknown type"}, ${function (e) {
    return e >= 1048576 ? `${(e / 1048576).toFixed(1)} MB` : `${Math.max(1, Math.round(e / 1024))} KB`;
  }(n)}) was uploaded by the user and saved to: ${r}\nRead or process it from that path with your tools.]`;
}
function Oq(e) {
  const t = (e || "").toLowerCase().split(";")[0].trim();
  return t.startsWith("text/") || $q.has(t) || /\+(json|xml|yaml)$/.test(t);
}
function Rq(e) {
  const t = e.subarray(0, 8192);
  if (t.includes(0)) return !1;
  try {
    return new TextDecoder("utf-8", {
      fatal: !0
    }).decode(t.length < e.length ? function (e) {
      let t = e.length;
      for (let n = 1; n <= 3 && t - n >= 0; n++) {
        const r = e[t - n];
        if (128 != (192 & r)) {
          192 & ~r || (t -= n);
          break;
        }
      }
      return e.subarray(0, t);
    }(t) : t), !0;
  } catch {
    return !1;
  }
}

function Lq(e) {
  const t = e.match(/^(\d+)(s|m|h|d)$/);
  if (!t) throw new Error(`Invalid interval: ${e}`);
  const n = parseInt(t[1]),
    r = t[2];
  switch (r) {
    case "s":
      return 1e3 * n;
    case "m":
      return 60 * n * 1e3;
    case "h":
      return 60 * n * 60 * 1e3;
    case "d":
      return 24 * n * 60 * 60 * 1e3;
    default:
      throw new Error(`Unknown unit: ${r}`);
  }
}

    ...t

}

}

  handleWsMessage(e) {
    if ("generation_completed" === e.type) {
      for (const [, t] of this.activeIsolatedGenerations) if (t.threadId === e.data?.threadId) {
        if (t.settling) return;
        if ("cron" !== e.data?.source || e.data?.cronRunId !== t.runId || e.data?.cronAttemptId !== t.attemptId) continue;
        t.settling = !0, this.handleIsolatedJobResponse(t.jobId, t.threadId, e.data?.assistantMessageId).finally(() => {
          this.activeIsolatedGenerations.get(t.jobId) === t && (this.activeIsolatedGenerations.delete(t.jobId), this.consumedOneShots.delete(t.jobId));
        });
        break;
      }
    } else if ("generation_error" === e.type) for (const [, t] of this.activeIsolatedGenerations) if (t.threadId === e.data?.threadId) {
      if (t.settling) return;

        const e = 5e3 * (t.retryCount + 1);
        console.log(`[CronService] Retrying job "${t.jobId}" in ${e}ms (attempt ${t.retryCount + 1}/3)...`);

          if (this.retryTimers.delete(t.jobId), this.activeIsolatedGenerations.get(t.jobId) !== t) return;
          const e = this.getJob(t.jobId);
          e && (e.enabled || this.consumedOneShots.has(e.id)) ? ("main" === e.executionMode ? this.executeMainSession(e, t.retryCount + 1) : this.executeIsolated(e, t.retryCount + 1)).catch(e => {
            console.error(`[CronService] Failed to start retry for job "${t.jobId}":`, e), this.recordRun(t.jobId, null, String(e)), this.activeIsolatedGenerations.delete(t.jobId), this.consumedOneShots.delete(t.jobId);
          }) : (this.recordRun(t.jobId, null, "Job disabled before retry"), this.activeIsolatedGenerations.delete(t.jobId), this.consumedOneShots.delete(t.jobId));
        }, e);
        this.retryTimers.set(t.jobId, n);
      } else console.error(`[CronService] Job "${t.jobId}" failed permanently after ${t.retryCount} retries.`), this.recordRun(t.jobId, null, `[Failed after ${t.retryCount} retries] ${n}`), this.activeIsolatedGenerations.delete(t.jobId), this.consumedOneShots.delete(t.jobId);
      break;
    }
  }
  async handleIsolatedJobResponse(e, t, n) {
    const r = this.activeIsolatedGenerations.get(e),
      o = () => !!this.getJob(e) && !!r && this.activeIsolatedGenerations.get(e) === r;
    if (o() && r?.threadId === t) try {
      const r = this.getJob(e);
      if (!r) return;
      const i = n ? wi.getMessageById(n) : null;
      if (!i || i.threadId !== t || "assistant" !== i.message.role) return void this.recordRun(e, null, "Completed generation has no persisted assistant result");
      const a = i.message.parts.filter(e => "text" === e.type).map(e => e.text || "").join("\n").trim();
      if (!a) return void this.recordRun(e, null, "Generation completed without a text result");
      const c = jq(r.payload),
        l = "discord" === c ? this.sendToDiscord : this.sendToTelegram;
      if (console.log(`[CronService] Delivery check: platform=${c}, hasTarget=${!!r.payload.deliverTo}, hasSendFn=${!!l}`), r.payload.deliverTo && l && a) {
        if ("(no output)" === a.trim()) console.log(`[CronService] Skipping delivery — response indicates nothing to report: ${a.substring(0, 80)}`), this.recordRun(e, a, "[Delivery Skipped] Nothing to report");else try {
          if (await l(r.payload.deliverTo, a), !o()) return;
          console.log(`[CronService] Delivered to ${r.payload.deliverTo}`), this.recordRun(e, a, "[Delivery Success]");
        } catch (s) {
          if (!o()) return;
          const t = s instanceof Error ? s.message : String(s);
          console.error(`[CronService] Delivery failed to ${r.payload.deliverTo}:`, t), this.recordRun(e, a, `[Delivery Failed] ${t}`);
        }
      } else if (r.payload.deliverTo && a && !l) {
        const t = "discord" === c ? "Discord" : "Telegram";
        console.error(`[CronService] ${t} delivery is unavailable — result not delivered`), this.recordRun(e, a, `[Delivery Failed] ${t} bot not configured or active (Settings → ${t})`);
      } else this.recordRun(e, a || "(no output)", null);
      console.log(`[CronService] Keeping cron thread ${t} for diary review`);
    } catch (i) {
      if (!o()) return;
      console.error(`[CronService] Failed to handle isolated job response for ${e}:`, i), this.recordRun(e, null, `Failed to finalize response: ${String(i)}`);
    }
  }
  loadAndScheduleAll() {
    const e = this.listJobs();
    let t = !1;
    for (const n of e) {
      const e = Uq(n.scheduleType, n.payload);
      JSON.stringify(e) !== JSON.stringify(n.payload) && (n.payload = e, t = !0), n.enabled && this.scheduleJob(n);
    }

  }
  scheduleJob(e) {
    this.unscheduleJob(e.id);
    try {
      switch (e.scheduleType) {
        case "at":
          {
            let t;
            const n = "string" == typeof e.schedule ? e.schedule : e.schedule?.at || String(e.schedule);
            if (/^\d+(s|m|h|d)$/.test(n)) t = Date.parse(e.createdAt) + Lq(n);else if (t = new Date(n).getTime(), isNaN(t)) return void console.error(`[CronService] Invalid schedule for at job "${e.name}": ${e.schedule}`);
            if (t - Date.now() <= 0) return e.lastRunAt ? (console.log(`[CronService] One-shot job "${e.name}" already ran at ${e.lastRunAt}, auto-disabling`), void this.toggleJob(e.id, !1)) : (console.log(`[CronService] One-shot job "${e.name}" is in the past, executing now`), void this.executeOneShot(e));
            const r = function (e, t) {
              let n = null;
              const r = () => {
                const o = e - Date.now();
                n = o > Fq ? setTimeout(r, Fq) : setTimeout(t, Math.max(0, o));
              };
              return r(), {
                clear: () => {
                  n && clearTimeout(n), n = null;
                }
              };
            }(t, async () => {
              try {
                await this.executeOneShot(e);
              } catch (t) {
                console.error(`[CronService] One-shot job "${e.name}" error:`, t);
              }
            });
            this.activeJobs.set(e.id, r), console.log(`[CronService] Scheduled one-shot "${e.name}" at ${e.schedule}`);
            break;
          }
        case "every":
          {
            const t = "string" == typeof e.schedule ? e.schedule : e.schedule?.every;
            if (!t || "string" != typeof t) return void console.error(`[CronService] Invalid schedule for every job "${e.name}":`, e.schedule);
            const n = Lq(t);
            CL(this, e.id, t, n);
            let r = !1;
            const o = setInterval(async () => {
              if (CL(this, e.id, t, n), this.notifyStateChanged(), r) console.warn(`[CronService] Interval job "${e.name}" is still running, skipping tick.`);else {
                r = !0;
                try {
                  await this.executeJob(e);
                } catch (o) {
                  console.error(`[CronService] Interval job "${e.name}" error:`, o);
                } finally {
                  r = !1;
                }
              }
            }, n);
            this.activeJobs.set(e.id, {
              clear: () => clearInterval(o)
            }), console.log(`[CronService] Scheduled interval "${e.name}" every ${e.schedule}`);
            break;
          }
        case "cron":
          {
            const t = "string" == typeof e.schedule ? e.schedule : e.schedule?.cron || String(e.schedule),
              n = {
                protect: !0
              };
            e.payload.timezone && (n.timezone = e.payload.timezone);
            const r = new or(t, n, async () => {
              try {
                await this.executeJob(e);
              } catch (t) {
                console.error(`[CronService] Cron job "${e.name}" error:`, t);
              }
            });
            this.activeJobs.set(e.id, r), console.log(`[CronService] Scheduled cron "${e.name}" with pattern ${t}${e.payload.timezone ? ` (TZ: ${e.payload.timezone})` : ""}`);
            break;
          }
      }
    } catch (t) {
      console.error(`[CronService] Failed to schedule job "${e.name}":`, t);
    }
  }
  unscheduleJob(e) {
    NL(this, e);
    const t = this.activeJobs.get(e);
    t && (t instanceof or ? t.stop() : t.clear(), this.activeJobs.delete(e));
  }
  async executeOneShot(e) {
    this.consumedOneShots.add(e.id), this.toggleJob(e.id, !1);
    try {
      await this.executeJob(e);
    } catch (t) {
      this.recordRun(e.id, null, t instanceof Error ? t.message : String(t)), this.activeIsolatedGenerations.delete(e.id), this.pendingMainDispatches.delete(e.id);
    } finally {
      this.activeIsolatedGenerations.has(e.id) || this.consumedOneShots.delete(e.id);
    }
  }
  async executeJob(e) {
    const t = this.activeIsolatedGenerations.get(e.id);
    if (t) {
      if (t.settling) return;
      const r = Date.now() - t.startedAt;
      if (r < 48e4) return;
      console.warn(`[CronService] Force-cleaning stuck job "${e.name}" (thread: ${t.threadId}, age: ${Math.round(r / 1e3)}s) — will start fresh`);
      try {
        this.stopOwnedGeneration(t);
      } catch (n) {
        console.error("[CronService] Error cleaning stuck generation:", n);
      }
      this.recordRun(e.id, null, `Previous execution timed out after ${Math.round(r / 1e3)}s — force-cleaned`), this.activeIsolatedGenerations.delete(e.id);
    }
    console.log(`[CronService] Executing job "${e.name}" (${e.executionMode})`);
    try {
      "main" === e.executionMode ? await this.executeMainSession(e) : await this.executeIsolated(e);
    } catch (n) {
      const t = n instanceof Error ? n.message : String(n);
      console.error(`[CronService] Job "${e.name}" failed:`, t), this.recordRun(e.id, null, t);
    }
  }
  async executeMainSession(e, t = 0) {
    let n = e.payload.threadId;
    if (!n) try {
      const e = wi.getSettings(),
        t = e ? JSON.parse(e.settingsData) : {};
      n = t?.heartbeat?.threadId;
    } catch {}
    if (!n) throw new Error("No threadId specified for main session execution and no heartbeat thread found");
    const r = wi.getThreadById(n);
    if (!r) throw new Error(`Thread ${n} not found`);
    const o = e.payload.systemEvent || e.payload.agentTurn || `[CronJob: ${e.name}]`,
      s = e.payload.deliverTo ? `${o}\n\n[System: This is a cron job. Your ENTIRE response will be sent directly to Telegram chat ${e.payload.deliverTo}. Output ONLY the final content — no meta-commentary. If there is NOTHING to report, output EXACTLY "(no output)" and nothing else.]` : o,
      i = wi.getSettings(),
      a = i ? JSON.parse(i.settingsData) : {},
      c = e.payload.model || r.model || a?.chat?.defaultModel;
    if (!c) throw new Error("No model configured for main session cron job");
    const l = await this.waitForMainDispatch(e.id, n, t);

class Jq {
  constructor(e) {
    this.binaryPath = e;
  }
  proc = null;
  buffer = "";
  pending = null;
  run(e, t) {
    if (this.pending) return Promise.reject(new Error("AppleScript helper is busy"));
    const n = this.ensureProcess();
    return new Promise((r, o) => {
      const s = setTimeout(() => {
        this.settle(new Gq(`AppleScript timed out after ${t}ms`)), this.stop();
      }, t);
      this.pending = {
        resolve: r,
        reject: o,
        timer: s
      }, n.stdin.write(`${Buffer.from(e, "utf-8").toString("base64")}\n`);
    });
  }
  stop() {
    const e = this.proc;
    if (this.proc = null, this.buffer = "", e) try {
      e.kill("SIGKILL");
    } catch {}
  }
  ensureProcess() {
    if (this.proc) return this.proc;
    const e = z(this.binaryPath, [], {
      env: Xq()
    });
    return e.stdout.on("data", t => {
      if (this.proc !== e) return;
      this.buffer += t.toString("utf-8");
      const n = this.buffer.split("\n");
      this.buffer = n.pop() ?? "";
      for (const e of n) this.handleLine(e);
    }), e.stderr.on("data", e => {
      const t = e.toString("utf-8").trim();
      t && console.error("[AppleScriptHelper] stderr:", t);
    }), e.stdin.on("error", () => {}), e.on("error", t => {
      this.proc === e && (this.proc = null), this.settle(t);
    }), e.on("exit", t => {
      this.proc === e && (this.proc = null, this.settle(new Error(`AppleScript helper exited (${t})`)));
    }), this.proc = e, e;
  }
  handleLine(e) {
    const t = e.trim();
    if (!t) return;
    let n;
    try {
      n = JSON.parse(t);
    } catch {
      return;
    }
    n.ok ? this.settle(null, (n.out ?? "").trim()) : this.settle(new Error(`${n.error ?? "AppleScript error"} (${n.code ?? 0})`));
  }
  settle(e, t = "") {
    const n = this.pending;
    n && (this.pending = null, clearTimeout(n.timer), e ? n.reject(e) : n.resolve(t));
  }

        }

        if (!i || !/^https?:\/\//.test(i)) return;
        const c = this.lastBrowserVisit;
        if (c && c.app === e && c.url === i && c.title === a) return;
        const l = this.frontmost.appName ?? e,
          d = Date.now();
        this.store.insertEvent(this.currentSession.id, {
          timestamp: d,
          kind: "browser_visit",
          appName: l,
          data: {
            url: i,
            title: a,
            bundleId: e
          }
        }), a && this.store.insertEvent(this.currentSession.id, {
          timestamp: d,
          kind: "window_title",
          appName: l,
          data: {
            title: a,
            bundleId: e,
            source: "browser"
          }
        }), this.lastBrowserVisit = {
          app: e,
          url: i,
          title: a
        };
      } catch (r) {
        const t = r instanceof Error ? r.message : String(r),
          n = (this.browserPollFailures.get(e) ?? 0) + 1;
        this.browserPollFailures.set(e, n), (r instanceof Gq || t.includes("-1743") || n >= 3) && (this.browserPollDisabled.add(e), console.warn(`[ActivityRecorder] browser URL polling stopped for ${e}: ${t}`));
      } finally {
        this.browserPollInFlight = !1;
      }
    }
  }
  async maybeGenerateYesterdaysSummary() {
    const e = new Date();
    e.setDate(e.getDate() - 1);
    const t = gG(e),
      n = this.store.getSummary("daily", t);
    if (!n || n.isPartial || !n.summary) try {
      await rG(this.store, t, {
        withNarrative: !0
      }), console.log(`[ActivityRecorder] Generated daily summary for ${t}`);
    } catch (r) {
      console.error(`[ActivityRecorder] Failed to generate summary for ${t}:`, r);
    }
  }
}
function gG(e) {
  return `${e.getFullYear()}-${String(e.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(e.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}
function yG(e) {
  const t = (e, t) => !Number.isFinite(e) || e <= 0 ? 0 : Math.max(t, e);
  return {
    ...e,
    snapshotDebounceMs: Math.max(3e3, e.snapshotDebounceMs || hG.snapshotDebounceMs),
    heartbeatIntervalMs: Math.max(6e4, e.heartbeatIntervalMs || hG.heartbeatIntervalMs),
    typingPauseMs: Math.max(800, e.typingPauseMs || hG.typingPauseMs),
    visualCheckIntervalMs: t(e.visualCheckIntervalMs, 1e4),
    browserPollIntervalMs: t(e.browserPollIntervalMs, 1e4),
    ocrEveryN: Math.max(1, Math.round(e.ocrEveryN || hG.ocrEveryN)),
    jpegQuality: Math.max(30, Math.min(95, Math.round(e.jpegQuality || hG.jpegQuality)))
  };
}

const AG = {
  checkIntervalMs: 6e5,
  minDurationMs: 3e4,
  minEventCount: 20,
  minSnapshotCount: 3,
  minAppCount: 1,
  maxOcrChars: 18e3,
  maxEventsInPrompt: 80,
  mergeGapMs: 3e5
};
class $G {
  constructor(e, t = AG, n) {
    this.store = e, this.config = t, this.isUserActive = n;
  }
  timer = null;
  running = !1;
  start() {
    this.timer || (setTimeout(() => {
      this.isUserActive?.() || this.runOnce().catch(e => console.error("[ActivityAnalyzer] first pass error:", e));
    }, 12e4), this.timer = setInterval(() => {
      this.isUserActive?.() || this.runOnce().catch(e => console.error("[ActivityAnalyzer] periodic error:", e));
    }, this.config.checkIntervalMs));
  }
  stop() {
    this.timer && (clearInterval(this.timer), this.timer = null);
  }
  async analyzeSession(e) {
    const t = this.store.getSession(e);
    t && (await this.processSession(t));
  }
  async runOnce() {
    if (this.running) return {
      processed: 0,
      skipped: 0,
      analyzed: 0,
      failed: 0,
      merged: 0
    };
    this.running = !0;
    let e = 0,
      t = 0,
      n = 0,
      r = 0,
      o = 0;
    try {
      o = this.mergePendingAdjacent();
      const s = this.store.listSessions({
        analysisStatus: "pending",
        limit: 10
      });
      for (const o of s) {
        if (!o.endedAt) continue;
        e++;
        const s = await this.processSession(o).catch(e => (console.error("[ActivityAnalyzer] session failed:", o.id, e), r++, "failed"));
        "skipped" === s ? t++ : "analyzed" === s && n++, await new Promise(e => setTimeout(e, 3e3));
      }
      (e || o) && console.log(`[ActivityAnalyzer] processed=${e} analyzed=${n} skipped=${t} failed=${r} merged=${o}`);
    } finally {
      this.running = !1;
    }
    return {
      processed: e,
      skipped: t,
      analyzed: n,
      failed: r,
      merged: o
    };
  }
  async pushToMemory(e, t, n) {
    if (!ri.isReady()) return;
    if (!t.length) return;
    const r = {
        feedback: .8,
        user: .8,
        project: .7,
        reference: .7
      },
      o = e.project?.trim();
    for (const i of t) {
      const t = i.content.trim();
      if (!t) continue;
      let a = [];
      try {
        a = await nE.generateEmbedding(t);
      } catch (s) {
        return void console.error("[ActivityAnalyzer] local embedding unavailable, skipping memory push:", s);
      }
      try {
        const s = o ? [i.type, `project:${o}`] : [i.type],
          {
            skipped: c,
            reason: l
          } = await ri.addMemoryWithLLMDedup(t, a, n, {
            metadata: {
              source: "auto",
              tags: s,
              importance: r[i.type] ?? .7,
              rationale: i.why?.trim() || void 0,
              activitySource: "activity_session",
              activitySessionId: e.id
            }
          });
        c && console.log(`[ActivityAnalyzer] dedup skipped candidate (${i.type}): ${l ?? "duplicate"}`);
      } catch (s) {
        console.error("[ActivityAnalyzer] addMemoryWithLLMDedup failed:", s);
      }
    }
  }
  mergePendingAdjacent() {
    const e = this.store.listSessions({
      analysisStatus: "pending",
      limit: 200
    }).filter(e => e.endedAt).sort((e, t) => e.startedAt - t.startedAt);
    let t = 0;
    for (let n = 0; n < e.length - 1; n++) {

function xG(e, t, n) {
  if (!Array.isArray(e)) return [];
  const r = [];
  for (const o of e) {
    if ("string" != typeof o) continue;
    const e = o.trim().slice(0, n);
    if (e && (r.push(e), r.length >= t)) break;
  }
  return r;
}
function IG(e, t) {
  if (!Array.isArray(e)) return [];
  const n = [];
  for (const r of e) {
    if (!r || "object" != typeof r) continue;
    const e = r,
      o = "string" == typeof e.label ? e.label.trim().slice(0, 80) : "";
    if (!o) continue;
    const s = {
      label: o
    };
    if ("string" == typeof e.ref && e.ref.trim() && (s.ref = e.ref.trim().slice(0, 80)), "string" == typeof e.repo && e.repo.trim() && (s.repo = e.repo.trim().slice(0, 120)), "string" == typeof e.url && /^https?:\/\//.test(e.url) && (s.url = e.url.slice(0, 500)), n.push(s), n.length >= t) break;
  }
  return n;
}
function CG(e, t) {
  if (!Array.isArray(e)) return [];
  const n = [];
  for (const r of e) {
    if (!r || "object" != typeof r) continue;
    const e = r,
      o = "string" == typeof e.handle ? e.handle.trim().slice(0, 80) : "";
    if (!o) continue;
    const s = {
      handle: o
    };
    if ("string" == typeof e.name && e.name.trim() && (s.name = e.name.trim().slice(0, 80)), n.push(s), n.length >= t) break;
  }
  return n;
}
function NG(e) {
  if (!e || "object" != typeof e) return {};
  const t = e;
  return {
    prs: IG(t.prs, 20),
    issues: IG(t.issues, 20),
    commits: IG(t.commits, 20),
    people: CG(t.people, 20),
    identifiers: xG(t.identifiers, 30, 120),
    repos: xG(t.repos, 10, 120),
    versions: xG(t.versions, 10, 40),
    events: xG(t.events, 10, 80),
    decisions: xG(t.decisions, 10, 200),
    urls: xG(t.urls, 30, 500).filter(e => /^https?:\/\//.test(e))
  };
}
const OG = new Set(["project", "feedback", "reference", "user"]);
function RG(e) {
  if (!Array.isArray(e)) return [];
  const t = [];
  for (const n of e) {
    if (!n || "object" != typeof n) continue;
    const e = n,
      r = "string" == typeof e.type ? e.type.trim().toLowerCase() : null;
    if (!r || !OG.has(r)) continue;
    const o = "string" == typeof e.content ? e.content.trim().slice(0, 240) : "";
    if (!o) continue;
    const s = {
      type: r,
      content: o
    };
    if ("string" == typeof e.why && e.why.trim() && (s.why = e.why.trim().slice(0, 200)), t.push(s), t.length >= 5) break;
  }
  return t;
}
function MG(e, t) {
  if (!e || !t) return 0;
  const n = new Set(DG(e)),
    r = new Set(DG(t));
  if (!n.size || !r.size) return 0;
  let o = 0;
  for (const i of n) r.has(i) && o++;
  const s = n.size + r.size - o;
  return 0 === s ? 0 : o / s;
}
function DG(e) {
  return e.toLowerCase().split(/[^a-z0-9\u4e00-\u9fff]+/).filter(Boolean);
}
const PG = {
  checkIntervalMs: 3e5,
  batchSize: 4,
  maxPerRun: 32,
  modelId: "multilingual-e5-small"
};
class LG {
  constructor(e, t = PG, n) {
    this.store = e, this.config = t, this.isUserActive = n;
  }
  timer = null;
  stopped = !0;
  running = !1;
  loaded = !1;
  start() {
    this.timer || (this.stopped = !1, this.scheduleNext(Math.max(this.config.checkIntervalMs, 3e5)));
  }
  stop() {
    this.stopped = !0, this.timer && (clearTimeout(this.timer), this.timer = null);
  }
  isModelLoaded() {
    return this.loaded;
  }
  getModelInfo() {
    return eE.find(e => e.id === this.config.modelId) ?? null;
  }
  async runOnce() {
    if (this.running) return {
      embedded: 0
    };
    this.running = !0;
    let e = 0;
    try {
      const n = this.store.listOcrPendingEmbedding(this.config.maxPerRun);
      if (0 === n.length) return {
        embedded: 0
      };
      await this.ensureModel();
      for (let r = 0; r < n.length; r += this.config.batchSize) {
        const o = n.slice(r, r + this.config.batchSize);
        for (const n of o) try {
          const t = await nE.generateEmbedding(n.text, this.config.modelId);
          if (!t || 0 === t.length) continue;
          this.store.updateOcrEmbedding(n.id, new Float32Array(t), this.config.modelId), e++;
        } catch (t) {
          console.error("[ActivityEmbedder] frame embedding failed:", n.id, t);
        }
        await new Promise(e => setTimeout(e, 250));
      }
      e && console.log(`[ActivityEmbedder] embedded=${e} frames (model=${this.config.modelId})`);
    } finally {
      this.running = !1;
    }
    return {
      embedded: e
    };
  }
  scheduleNext(e) {
    this.timer = setTimeout(async () => {
      if (this.timer = null, !this.stopped) if (this.isUserActive?.()) this.scheduleNext(3e4);else try {
        await this.runOnce();
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("[ActivityEmbedder] periodic error:", e);
      } finally {
        this.stopped || this.scheduleNext(this.config.checkIntervalMs);
      }
    }, e);
  }
  async ensureModel() {
    if (!this.loaded) try {
      await nE.loadModel(this.config.modelId), this.loaded = !0;
    } catch (e) {
      throw console.error("[ActivityEmbedder] model load failed:", e), e;
    }
  }
  async search(e, t) {
    if (!e.trim()) return [];
    await this.ensureModel();
    const n = await nE.generateEmbedding(e, this.config.modelId),
      r = new Float32Array(n),
      o = this.store.listOcrWithEmbeddings(5e3),
      s = [];
    for (const i of o) {
      if (!i.embedding || i.embedding.length !== r.length) continue;
      const e = FG(r, i.embedding);
      Number.isFinite(e) && s.push({
        frame: i,
        score: e
      });
    }
    return s.sort((e, t) => t.score - e.score), s.slice(0, Math.min(Math.max(t, 1), 100));
  }
}
function FG(e, t) {
  if (e.length !== t.length) return NaN;
  let n = 0,
    r = 0,
    o = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < e.length; i++) n += e[i] * t[i], r += e[i] * e[i], o += t[i] * t[i];
  const s = Math.sqrt(r) * Math.sqrt(o);
  return 0 === s ? 0 : n / s;
}
const BG = {
  lookbackMs: 72e5,
  maxAnalyzed: 8,
  includeOpen: !0,
  maxChars: 1200
};
function UG(e, t = {}) {
  const n = {
      ...BG,
      ...t
    },
    r = Date.now(),
    o = r - n.lookbackMs,
    s = e.listOpenSessions(),
    i = n.includeOpen && s.length > 0 ? s[0] : null,
    a = e.listSessions({
      since: o,
      limit: 200
    }).filter(e => "analyzed" === e.analysisStatus && e.analysisTitle).slice(0, n.maxAnalyzed),
    c = new Date();
  c.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  const l = e.listSessions({
    since: c.getTime(),
    limit: 500
  });
  let d = 0;
  const u = new Map();
  for (const p of l) {
    const t = p.durationMs ?? (p.endedAt ? p.endedAt - p.startedAt : 0);
    d += Math.max(0, t);
    const n = e.perAppDurationsForSession(p.id);
    if (n.size > 0) for (const [e, r] of n) u.set(e, (u.get(e) ?? 0) + r);
  }
  const h = [...u.entries()].map(([e, t]) => ({
    app: e,
    durationMs: Math.round(t)
  })).sort((e, t) => t.durationMs - e.durationMs).slice(0, 5);
  return {
    now: r,
    activeSession: i,
    recentAnalyzed: a,
    todayTotalActiveMs: d,
    todaySessionCount: l.length,
    topApps: h
  };
}
function jG(e) {
  const t = Math.round(e / 6e4);
  return t < 1 ? "just now" : t < 60 ? `${t}m` : `${Math.round(t / 60)}h`;
}
function WG(e, t) {
  const n = function (e, t = {}) {
    const n = {
        ...BG,
        ...t
      },
      r = [];
    if (r.push("## Recent activity context"), e.activeSession) {
      const t = e.activeSession,
        n = Math.round((e.now - t.startedAt) / 6e4),
        o = t.appNames.slice(0, 3).join(", ") || "(unknown)";
      r.push(`- Currently active: ${o} (${n} min, ${t.eventCount} events, ${t.snapshotCount} snapshots)`);
    }
    if (e.todayTotalActiveMs > 0) {
      const t = Math.round(e.todayTotalActiveMs / 6e4),
        n = e.topApps.slice(0, 3).map(e => `${e.app} (${Math.round(e.durationMs / 6e4)}m)`).join(", ");
      r.push(`- Today so far: ${t} min across ${e.todaySessionCount} sessions${n ? ` — top: ${n}` : ""}`);
    }
    if (e.recentAnalyzed.length > 0) {
      r.push(`- Recent sessions (last ${Math.round(n.lookbackMs / 6e4)} min):`);
      for (const t of e.recentAnalyzed) {
        const n = jG(e.now - t.startedAt),
          o = Math.round((t.durationMs ?? 0) / 6e4),
          s = (t.analysisDescription ?? "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").slice(0, 140);
        r.push(`  - ${n} ago, ~${o}m: **${t.analysisTitle}** — ${s}`);
      }
    }
    if (1 === r.length) return "";
    let o = r.join("\n");
    return o.length > n.maxChars && (o = o.slice(0, n.maxChars - 15) + "\n… [truncated]"), o;
  }(UG(e, t), t);
  return n || null;
}

function qG(e) {
  const t = [];
  for (const r of e.nodes) HG.has(r.role) && (r.text.length < 2 || t[t.length - 1] !== r.text && t.push(r.text));
  if (0 === t.length) return null;
  const n = t.join("\n");
  return n.length > 5e3 ? n.slice(-5e3) : n;
}

function XG(e) {

            n[e.partIndex] && (n[e.partIndex].state = "input-streaming"), yield p();
          }
          break;
        }
      case "tool-input-end":
        {
          const e = f(g.id);
          e && (m(e), e.state = "input-available", n[e.partIndex] && (n[e.partIndex].state = "input-available"), yield p());
          break;
        }
      case "tool-call":
        {
          const e = f(g.toolCallId);
          if (e) {
            m(e);
            const t = g.input ?? g.args ?? {},
              r = t.args && "object" == typeof t.args ? t.args : t;
            e.args = r, e.state = "input-available", n[e.partIndex] && (n[e.partIndex].input = r, n[e.partIndex].state = "input-available"), yield p();
          }
          break;
        }
      case "tool-result":
        {
          let e = f(g.toolCallId);
          if (e && ("output-available" === e.state || "output-error" === e.state)) for (const [, t] of a) if (t.originalPartId === g.toolCallId && "output-available" !== t.state && "output-error" !== t.state) {
            e = t;
            break;
          }
          if (e) {
            m(e);
            const t = g.output ?? g.result;
            e.output = t, e.state = "output-available", n[e.partIndex] && (n[e.partIndex].output = t, n[e.partIndex].state = "output-available"), yield p();
          }
          break;
        }
      case "tool-error":
        {
          let e = f(g.toolCallId);
          if (e && ("output-available" === e.state || "output-error" === e.state)) for (const [, t] of a) if (t.originalPartId === g.toolCallId && "output-available" !== t.state && "output-error" !== t.state) {
            e = t;
            break;
          }
          if (e) {
            m(e);
            const t = "string" == typeof g.error ? g.error : String(g.error);
            e.error = t, e.state = "output-error", n[e.partIndex] && (n[e.partIndex].errorText = t, n[e.partIndex].state = "output-error"), yield p();
          }
          break;
        }
      case "file":
        {
          const e = g.file;
          n.push({
            type: "file",
            url: e.url || (e.base64 ? `data:${e.mediaType};base64,${e.base64}` : ""),
            mediaType: e.mediaType
          }), yield p();
          break;
        }
      case "source":
        break;
      case "finish-step":
      case "finish":
        u(), h(), yield p();
        break;
      case "error":
        throw t?.onError?.(g.error), g.error;
      case "abort":
        return;
      default:
        console.log(`[processACPFullStream] Skipping unknown stream part type: ${g.type}`);
    }
    u(), h();
    for (const [, e] of a) "input-streaming" !== e.state && "input-available" !== e.state || (console.log(`[processACPFullStream] Fixing stuck tool ${e.toolCallId} from ${e.state} to output-available`), e.state = "output-available", void 0 === e.output && (e.output = ""), n[e.partIndex] && (n[e.partIndex].state = "output-available", void 0 === n[e.partIndex].output && (n[e.partIndex].output = "")));
    yield p();
  } catch (g) {
    throw console.error("[processACPFullStream] Stream error (yielding accumulated content):", g instanceof Error ? g.message : g), u(), h(), yield p(), t?.onError?.(g), g;
  }
}

        return {
          id: e.id,
          name: e.name,
          capabilities: {
            ...s,
            ...(s.reasoning && (a ?? i) ? {
              reasoningLevels: a ?? i
            } : {})
          },
          autoDetectedCapabilities: i ? {
            ...r,
            reasoningLevels: i
          } : r,
          isManual: e.isManual,
          apiFormat: e.apiFormat
        };
      });
      t.json({
        data: s.map(e => e.id),
        models: s
      });
    } catch (n) {
      console.error("Error getting provider models:", n), t.status(500).json({
        error: `Failed to get provider models: ${n instanceof Error ? n.message : String(n)}`
      });
    }
  }
  async getACPCommands(e, t) {
    try {
      const {
          threadId: r,
          providerId: o
        } = e.params,
        s = wi.getProviderByIdFromDatabaseOnly(o);
      if (!s) return t.status(404).json({
        error: "Provider not found"
      });
      if ("acp" !== s.type) return t.status(400).json({
        error: "Provider is not an ACP provider"
      });
      if (!s.acpCommand) return t.status(400).json({
        error: "ACP command is not configured"
      });
      if ("gemini" === s.acpCommand || "agy-acp" === s.acpCommand) return console.log(`[ACP] ${s.acpCommand} doesn't support slash commands, returning empty array`), t.json({
        commands: [],
        threadId: r,
        providerId: o
      });
      const i = !rS.hasSession(r, o);
      if (i) {
        console.log(`[ACP] Creating session for commands request: thread=${r}, provider=${o}`);
        const e = wi.getThreadById(r);
        let t = null;
        if (e?.enableArtifacts && e?.artifactWorkspaceId) {
          const n = wi.getWorkspaceById(e.artifactWorkspaceId);
          t = n?.path || null, console.log(`[ACP] Using artifact workspace for thread ${r}: ${t}`);
        } else if (e?.workspaceId) {
          const n = wi.getWorkspaceById(e.workspaceId);
          t = n?.path || null;
        }
        const i = s.acpMcpServerIds?.length ? s.acpMcpServerIds.map(e => wi.getMCPServerById(e)).filter(e => null != e) : [],
          a = "claude-code-acp" === s.acpCommand || "agy-acp" === s.acpCommand,
          c = tS(s.acpCommand, s.acpArgs || []),
          l = {
            command: c.command,
            args: c.args,
            cwd: t || process.cwd(),
            mcpServers: i,
            authMethodId: a ? void 0 : s.acpAuthMethodId || void 0
          },
          d = await rS.getOrCreateSession(r, o, l);
        await rS.cleanupOtherProvidersForThread(r, o);
        try {
          const e = await d.initSession();
          console.log("[ACP] Session initialized for commands request. Session keys:", Object.keys(e || {}));
          const t = e;
          if (t?.availableCommands?.length > 0) {
            console.log("[ACP] Found commands in session object:", t.availableCommands.length);
            const e = rS.getSession(r, o);
            e && (e.availableCommands = t.availableCommands);
          }
        } catch (n) {
          console.error("[ACP] Error initializing session for commands:", n);
        }
        rS.setupSessionUpdateHandler(r, o);
      }
      let a = rS.getAvailableCommands(r, o);
      if (0 === a.length && i) {
        console.log("[ACP] No commands yet for new session, waiting for available_commands_update...");
        const e = new Promise(e => {
          let t = 0,
            n = !1;
          const s = rS.subscribeToCommandUpdates(r, o, t => {
              n || (n = !0, console.log(`[ACP] Commands received via subscription: ${t.length}`), s(), e(t));
            }),
            i = setInterval(() => {
              if (n) return void clearInterval(i);
              t += 100;
              const a = rS.getAvailableCommands(r, o);
              a.length > 0 ? (n = !0, clearInterval(i), s(), e(a)) : t >= 5e3 && (n = !0, clearInterval(i), s(), console.log("[ACP] Timeout waiting for commands"), e([]));
            }, 100);
        });
        a = await e;
      } else 0 === a.length && console.log("[ACP] Existing session has no commands yet, returning empty (commands will arrive after first message)");
      t.json({
        commands: a,
        threadId: r,
        providerId: o
      });
    } catch (r) {
      console.error("Error getting ACP commands:", r), t.status(500).json({
        error: `Failed to get ACP commands: ${r instanceof Error ? r.message : String(r)}`
      });
    }
  }

  async processFilePartsToText(t, n) {
    const r = e => {
        try {
          if (!e.startsWith("data:")) return;
          const t = e.indexOf(",");
          if (t < 0) return;
          const n = e.slice(0, t),
            r = e.slice(t + 1),
            o = /;base64/i.test(n);
          return {
            data: o ? Buffer.from(r, "base64") : Buffer.from(decodeURIComponent(r), "utf-8"),
            isBase64: o
          };
        } catch {
          return;
        }
      },
      o = e => "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document" === e,
      s = (e, t) => {
        if (null != e) {
          if ("string" == typeof e) return e;
          if (e instanceof URL) return e.href;
          if (e instanceof Uint8Array) return `data:${t || "application/octet-stream"};base64,${Buffer.from(e).toString("base64")}`;
          if ("object" == typeof e) {
            if ("url" === e.type && null != e.url) return e.url instanceof URL ? e.url.href : String(e.url);
            if ("data" === e.type && null != e.data) try {
              return `data:${t || "application/octet-stream"};base64,${("string" == typeof e.data ? Buffer.from(e.data, "base64") : Buffer.from(e.data)).toString("base64")}`;
            } catch {
              return;
            }
          }
        }
      },
      i = [];
    for (const a of t) {
      if (!a || !Array.isArray(a.content) || "user" !== a.role) {
        i.push(a);
        continue;
      }
      const t = [];
      for (const i of a.content) {
        if ("string" == typeof i) {
          t.push(i);
          continue;
        }
        if ("file" !== i.type) {
          t.push(i);
          continue;
        }
        const a = i,
          c = a.filename,
          l = s(a.data, a.mediaType),
          d = async (t, n) => {

              };

          };

        }

            });
            continue;
          }
        }

            }
          }
        }
        const p = l && u(a.mediaType, l, !0) ? (await d(a.mediaType || "application/octet-stream", l)) ?? u(a.mediaType, l) : void 0;
        t.push(p ?? i);
      }
      i.push({
        ...a,
        content: t
      });
    }
    return i;
  }
  async inlineLocalFileUrl(t, n) {

          }

      }

        e = new URL(t);

        return;
      }

    }
  }

  static ensureSchemaRequired(e) {
    if (!e || "object" != typeof e) return e;
    const t = {
      ...e
    };

      });

      });

  persistCompactionResult(e, t, n) {
    if (!t.success || 0 === t.compactedMessageCount) return;
    const r = new Set(t.compactedMessageIds),
      o = [];
    for (const c of n) {
      const t = c.id.replace(`${e}--`, "");
      r.has(t) && (o.push(c.id), wi.updateMessageMetadata(c.id, {
        isCompacted: !0
      }));
    }
    const s = new Set(t.partialCompactions?.map(e => e.messageId) ?? []);
    for (const c of n) {
      const n = c.id.replace(`${e}--`, "");
      if (!s.has(n)) continue;
      const r = t.partialCompactions.find(e => e.messageId === n);
      o.push(c.id), wi.updateMessageMetadata(c.id, {
        compactedPartsBefore: r.keepFromPart
      });
    }
    for (const c of o) {
      const e = wi.getMessageById(c);
      e && this.broadcastThreadSync("message_updated", this.enrichMessageForBroadcast(e));
    }
    const i = {
        id: `compaction-${Date.now()}`,
        role: "assistant",
        parts: [{
          type: "text",
          text: `---\n\n🗜️ **Context Compacted**\n\n${t.compactedMessageCount} earlier messages were summarized to save context space.\nTokens: ${t.originalTokenCount.toLocaleString()} → ${t.compactedTokenCount.toLocaleString()} (saved ~${(t.originalTokenCount - t.compactedTokenCount).toLocaleString()})\n\n---`
        }]
      },
      [a] = wi.addMessage(e, i, {
        appendToActivePath: !0,
        metadata: {
          isCompactionIndicator: !0,
          compactedMessageCount: t.compactedMessageCount,
          compactedMessageIds: o,
          compactionSummary: t.summary,
          originalTokens: t.originalTokenCount,
          compactedTokens: t.compactedTokenCount
        }
      });
    this.broadcastThreadSync("message_added", this.enrichMessageForBroadcast(a)), console.log(`[Compaction] Persisted: ${t.compactedMessageCount} messages marked, indicator added. Tokens: ${t.originalTokenCount} -> ${t.compactedTokenCount}`);
  }
  persistLiveCompactionAtTurnEnd(e, t, n, r, o) {
    const s = wi.getMessageById(t);
    if (!s) return void console.warn(`[AutoCompact] Live compaction not persisted: bubble ${t} not found`);
    const i = s.message.parts || [],
      a = i.map((e, t) => "step-start" === e.type ? t : -1).filter(e => e >= 0),
      c = n.keepFromStep < a.length ? a[n.keepFromStep] : -1;
    let l = -1;
    if (n.anchorToolCallId) {
      const e = i.findIndex(e => e.toolCallId === n.anchorToolCallId);
      if (e >= 0) for (l = e; l > 0 && "step-start" !== i[l].type;) l--;
    }
    let d = -1;
    if (l >= 0 && c >= 0 ? (d = Math.min(l, c), l !== c && console.log(`[AutoCompact] Live compaction kept tail on bubble ${t} starts at step ${n.keepFromStep} (part ${c}); its first tool call ${n.anchorToolCallId} is at part ${l}; keeping from part ${d}`)) : d = l >= 0 ? l : c, d < 0) return void console.warn(`[AutoCompact] Live compaction not persisted: kept-tail anchor ${n.anchorToolCallId ?? "(none)"} is not in bubble ${t} and step ${n.keepFromStep} is past its ${a.length} steps`);
    const u = wi.getThreadById(e),
      h = Array.isArray(u?.metadata?.activePath) ? new Set(u.metadata.activePath) : null,
      p = new Set(r),
      f = [];
    for (const y of wi.getMessagesByThreadId(e)) {
      if (y.id === t || y.metadata?.isCompacted) continue;
      if (h && !h.has(y.id)) continue;
      const n = y.id.replace(`${e}--`, ""),
        r = Date.parse(y.createdAt || y.timestamp || ""),
        s = !0 === y.metadata?.isCompactionIndicator && Number.isFinite(r) && r >= o;
      (p.has(n) || s) && (wi.updateMessageMetadata(y.id, {
        isCompacted: !0
      }), f.push(y.id));
    }
    d > 0 && (wi.updateMessageMetadata(t, {
      compactedPartsBefore: d
    }), f.push(t));
    for (const y of f) {
      const e = wi.getMessageById(y);
      e && this.broadcastThreadSync("message_updated", this.enrichMessageForBroadcast(e));
    }
    const m = f.length,
      [g] = wi.addMessage(e, {
        id: `compaction-${Date.now()}`,
        role: "assistant",
        parts: [{
          type: "text",
          text: `---\n\n🗜️ **Context Compacted**\n\n${m} earlier messages were summarized to save context space.\nTokens: ${n.originalTokens.toLocaleString()} → ${n.compactedTokens.toLocaleString()} (saved ~${(n.originalTokens - n.compactedTokens).toLocaleString()})\n\n---`
        }]
      }, {
        appendToActivePath: !0,
        metadata: {
          isCompactionIndicator: !0,
          compactedMessageCount: m,
          compactedMessageIds: f,
          compactionSummary: n.summary,
          originalTokens: n.originalTokens,
          compactedTokens: n.compactedTokens,
          liveTurnMessageId: t
        }
      });
    this.broadcastThreadSync("message_added", this.enrichMessageForBroadcast(g)), console.log(`[AutoCompact] Persisted live compaction at turn end: ${f.length - (d > 0 ? 1 : 0)} rows marked, bubble ${t} keeps parts from ${d}/${i.length}. Tokens: ${n.originalTokens} -> ${n.compactedTokens}`);
  }
  async compactThread(e, t) {

      id: n
    } = e.params;

  getThreadDiffStats(e, t) {
    try {
      const {
          threadId: n
        } = e.params,
        r = wi.getThreadById(n);
      if (!r) return void t.json({
        additions: 0,
        deletions: 0,

      });
      const o = wi.getThreadDiffStatsCache(n);
      if (o && o.threadUpdatedAt === r.updatedAt) return void t.json({
        additions: o.additions,
        deletions: o.deletions,
        filesChanged: o.filesChanged
      });
      const s = wi.getDiffToolMessagesByThreadId(n);
      let i = 0,
        a = 0;
      const c = new Set(),
        l = e => e ? e.split("\n").length : 0;
      for (const e of s) {
        const t = e.message;
        if (t && t.parts) for (const e of t.parts) {
          const t = e,
            n = "done" === t.state || "output-available" === t.state;
          if ("tool-Write" === e.type && n && t.input?.file_path && t.input?.content && (i += l(t.input.content), c.add(t.input.file_path)), "tool-Edit" === e.type && n && t.input?.file_path && void 0 !== t.input?.old_string && void 0 !== t.input?.new_string) {
            const e = l(t.input.old_string),
              n = l(t.input.new_string) - e;
            if (n > 0 ? i += n : n < 0 && (a += Math.abs(n)), 0 === n && t.input.old_string !== t.input.new_string) {
              const e = t.input.old_string.length,
                n = t.input.new_string.length;
              n > e ? i += 1 : (e > n || (i += 1), a += 1);
            }
            c.add(t.input.file_path);
          }
        }
      }
      const d = {
        additions: i,
        deletions: a,
        filesChanged: c.size
      };
      wi.setThreadDiffStatsCache(n, r.updatedAt, d), t.json(d);
    } catch (n) {
      console.error("Error getting thread diff stats:", n), t.status(500).json({
        error: `Failed to get thread diff stats: ${n instanceof Error ? n.message : String(n)}`
      });
    }
  }
  applyDeltaToPartsArray(e, t) {
    switch (t.type) {
      case "text_append":
        {
          const n = e[t.partIndex];
          !n || "text" !== n.type && "reasoning" !== n.type || (n.text = (n.text || "") + t.text);
          break;
        }
      case "text_done":
        {
          const n = e[t.partIndex];
          n && (n.state = "done");
          break;
        }
      case "part_add":
        e.push(structuredClone(t.part));
        break;
      case "part_update":
        {
          let n = t.partIndex;
          if (-1 === n && t.toolCallId && (n = e.findIndex(e => e?.toolCallId === t.toolCallId)), -1 === n) break;
          const r = e[n];
          r && Object.assign(r, t.updates);
          break;
        }
      case "tool_input_append":
        {
          const n = e[t.partIndex];
          n && n.type?.startsWith("tool-") && (n.input || (n.input = {}), n.input[t.inputKey] = (n.input[t.inputKey] || "") + t.text);
          break;
        }
      case "tool_output_set":
        {
          const n = e[t.partIndex];
          n && n.type?.startsWith("tool-") && (n.output = t.output, n.state = t.state, t.errorText && (n.errorText = t.errorText));
          break;
        }
    }
  }
  handleSubagentStreamEvent(e, t, n) {
    if ("subagent_message_delta" === t) {
      const e = n,
        r = this.subagentAccumulators.get(e.context.subagentMessageId)?.message.parts,
        o = SY(e.deltas, e => r?.[e]?.type);
      this.broadcastThreadSync(t, o === e.deltas ? n : {
        ...e,
        deltas: o
      });
    } else if ("subagent_message_completed" === t) {
      const e = n,
        r = e.finalMessage ? TY(e.finalMessage) : e.finalMessage;
      this.broadcastThreadSync(t, r === e.finalMessage ? n : {
        ...e,
        finalMessage: r
      });
    } else {
      const e = n,
        r = e.message ? TY(e.message) : e.message;
      this.broadcastThreadSync(t, r === e.message ? n : {
        ...e,
        message: r
      });
    }
    if ("subagent_message_added" === t) {
      const t = n;
      if (!t.context.parentToolCallId) return;
      try {
        const n = t.context.subagentMessageId;
        this.subagentAccumulators.set(n, {
          threadId: e,
          taskId: t.context.taskId,
          parentMessageId: t.context.parentMessageId,
          message: {
            id: t.context.subagentMessageId,
            role: "assistant",
            parts: structuredClone(t.message.parts || [])
          },
          parentToolCallId: t.context.parentToolCallId,
          lastSeq: 0,
          lastDbWriteMs: 0
        }), wi.addMessage(e, this.persistUIMessageImages({
          id: t.context.subagentMessageId,
          role: "assistant",
          parts: t.message.parts || []
        }), {
          parentToolCallId: t.context.parentToolCallId,
          metadata: {
            subagentTaskId: t.context.taskId,
            subagentParentMessageId: t.context.parentMessageId
          }
        });
      } catch (i) {
        console.error("[Server] Failed to save initial subagent message:", i);
      }
      return;
    }
    if ("subagent_message_delta" === t) {
      const t = n;
      if (!t.context.parentToolCallId) return;
      const r = t.context.subagentMessageId;
      let o = this.subagentAccumulators.get(r);
      o || (o = {
        threadId: e,
        taskId: t.context.taskId,
        parentMessageId: t.context.parentMessageId,
        message: {
          id: t.context.subagentMessageId,
          role: "assistant",
          parts: []
        },
        parentToolCallId: t.context.parentToolCallId,
        lastSeq: 0,
        lastDbWriteMs: 0
      }, this.subagentAccumulators.set(r, o));
      const s = [...t.deltas].sort((e, t) => e.seq - t.seq);
      for (const e of s) e.seq <= o.lastSeq || o.lastSeq > 0 && e.seq > o.lastSeq + 1 || (this.applyDeltaToPartsArray(o.message.parts, e), o.lastSeq = e.seq);
      const a = Date.now();
      if (a - o.lastDbWriteMs < 1e3) return;
      o.lastDbWriteMs = a;
      const c = `${e}--${r}`;
      try {
        wi.updateMessageContent(c, this.persistUIMessageImages(TY(o.message)));
      } catch (i) {
        try {
          wi.addMessage(e, this.persistUIMessageImages(TY(o.message)), {
            parentToolCallId: o.parentToolCallId,
            metadata: {
              subagentTaskId: t.context.taskId,
              subagentParentMessageId: t.context.parentMessageId
            }
          });
        } catch {
          console.error("[Server] Failed to backfill subagent message after delta:", i);
        }
      }
      return;
    }
    const r = n,
      o = r.context.subagentMessageId,
      s = `${e}--${o}`;
    if (r.finalMessage && r.context.parentToolCallId) try {
      wi.updateMessageContent(s, this.persistUIMessageImages(TY(r.finalMessage))), console.log("[Server] Saved final subagent message:", s);
    } catch (i) {
      console.error("[Server] Failed to save final subagent message:", i);
      try {
        wi.addMessage(e, this.persistUIMessageImages(TY(r.finalMessage)), {
          parentToolCallId: r.context.parentToolCallId,
          metadata: {
            subagentTaskId: r.context.taskId,
            subagentParentMessageId: r.context.parentMessageId
          }
        });
      } catch {}
    }
    this.subagentAccumulators.delete(o);
  }

  findTaskToolCallIdForTask(e, t) {
    for (const n of e.parts || []) {
      if (!n || "object" != typeof n) continue;
      const e = n;
      if (!("string" == typeof e.type && "tool-Task" === e.type || "dynamic-tool" === e.type && "Task" === e.toolName)) continue;
      const r = e.output,
        o = r && "object" == typeof r ? r : null;
      if (o && o.taskId === t && "string" == typeof e.toolCallId) return e.toolCallId;
    }
    return null;
  }
  buildResumedTaskPrompt(e, t) {
    const n = t.filter(e => "string" == typeof e.content && e.content.trim().length > 0).slice(-40).map(e => `[${e.role || "unknown"}] ${e.content.trim()}`);
    let r = 0;
    const o = [];
    for (let i = n.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
      const e = n[i],
        t = r + e.length + (o.length > 0 ? 2 : 0);
      if (t > 2e4) break;
      o.unshift(e), r = t;
    }
    const s = o.join("\n\n");
    return ["You are resuming a previously interrupted task.", "Continue from the exact interruption point instead of restarting the whole task from scratch.", "Treat completed steps, tool calls, file edits, discoveries, and partial outputs in the transcript below as already done unless you must verify them.", "Inspect the current workspace state before repeating anything with side effects.", `Original task description: ${e.description}`, "Original task prompt:", e.prompt, s ? "Previous execution transcript:" : "", s, "Resume instructions:", "- Continue from the last incomplete step.", "- Preserve prior work and avoid repeating completed work.", "- If the prior run left partial state behind, continue from that current state instead of overwriting it.", "- Only redo the minimum work required after the interruption."].filter(Boolean).join("\n\n");
  }
  updateTaskToolPartMessage(e, t, n) {

  async getThreadContextUsage(e, t) {
    try {
      const {
          threadId: n
        } = e.params,
        {
          model: r
        } = e.query;
      if (!r || "string" != typeof r) return t.status(400).json({

      });
      if (!wi.getThreadById(n)) return t.status(404).json({
        error: "Thread not found"
      });
      const o = wi.getActivePathMessages(n);

  canSendTo(e, t, n) {
    const r = e.bufferedAmount ?? 0;
    if (r <= 1048576) return !0;
    if (r > 16777216) {
      console.warn(`[WS] client ${r} bytes behind — closing it rather than growing the write buffer further (${n} ${t})`);
      try {
        e.terminate();
      } catch {}
      return !1;
    }
    return !tY.has(t) || (console.warn(`[WS] dropping '${t}' for a client ${r} bytes behind; the next snapshot supersedes it`), !1);
  }

  setLoopApi(e, t) {
    const n = e.params.id,
      r = String(e.body?.prompt ?? "").trim();
    if (!r) return void t.status(400).json({
      error: "prompt is required"
    });

      error: "thread not found"
    });
    const o = function (e) {
        const t = e.trim(),
          n = t.match(/^(\d+)\s*([smhd])\b\s*/i);
        if (n) return {
          intervalMs: Number(n[1]) * {
            s: 1e3,

            h: 36e5,
            d: 864e5
          }[n[2].toLowerCase()],
          prompt: t.slice(n[0].length).trim()

        const r = t.match(/\s+every\s+(\d+)?\s*(second|minute|hour|day)s?\s*$/i);
        return r ? {
          intervalMs: (r[1] ? Number(r[1]) : 1) * {
            second: 1e3,
            minute: 6e4,
            hour: 36e5,
            day: 864e5
          }[r[2].toLowerCase()],
          prompt: t.slice(0, t.length - r[0].length).trim()
        } : {
          intervalMs: null,
          prompt: t
        };
      }(r),
      s = LW(Number(e.body?.intervalMs) || o.intervalMs || 0),
      i = function (e, t, n = Date.now()) {
        const r = e.trim();
        if (!r) throw new Error("A loop needs a prompt");
        return {
          prompt: r.slice(0, 4e3),
          intervalMs: LW(t),
          startedAt: n,
          iterations: 0
        };
      }(o.prompt || r, s);
    e.body?.model && wi.updateThread(n, {
      model: e.body.model
    }), this.setLoop(n, i), this.ensureLoopTimer(), t.json({
      loop: i,
      interval: WW(i.intervalMs)
    });
  }
  clearLoopApi(e, t) {

  ensureLoopTimer() {
    this.loopTimer || 0 === this.loopingThreadIds.size || (this.loopTimer = setInterval(() => {
      this.tickLoops().catch(e => console.error("[Loop] tick failed:", e));
    }, 2e4), this.loopTimer.unref?.());
  }
  stopLoopTimerIfIdle() {
    this.loopTimer && 0 === this.loopingThreadIds.size && (clearInterval(this.loopTimer), this.loopTimer = null);
  }
  restoreLoops() {
    try {
      for (const e of wi.getAllThreads?.() ?? []) {
        const t = (e.metadata || {}).loop;
        t && FW(t) && this.loopingThreadIds.add(e.id);
      }
      this.loopingThreadIds.size > 0 && (console.log(`[Loop] restored ${this.loopingThreadIds.size} loop(s) from disk`), this.ensureLoopTimer());
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("[Loop] could not restore loops:", e);
    }
  }
  async tickLoops() {
    for (const e of [...this.loopingThreadIds]) {
      const t = wi.getThreadById(e),
        n = t ? this.getLoop(e) : null;
      if (!t || !FW(n) || !n) {
        this.loopingThreadIds.delete(e), this.stopLoopTimerIfIdle();
        continue;
      }
      const r = BW(n, {
        busy: this.activeGenerations.has(e)
      });
      if ("stop" === r.action) {
        console.log(`[Loop] thread ${e}: ${r.reason}`), this.setLoop(e, jW(n, r.reason));
        continue;
      }
      if ("fire" !== r.action) continue;
      const o = t.model;
      o ? (this.setLoop(e, UW(n)), console.log(`[Loop] thread ${e}: firing iteration ${n.iterations + 1} every ${WW(n.intervalMs)}`), this.generateChatResponse(e, o, {
        role: "user",

          type: "text",

        }]
      }, {
        source: "loop",
        userMessageMetadata: {
          almaLoopTurn: !0
        }
      }).catch(e => console.error("[Loop] iteration failed:", e))) : (console.warn(`[Loop] thread ${e} has no model — stopping the loop`), this.setLoop(e, jW(n, "thread has no model")));
    }
  }

      });

      };

      });
    }
    const i = function (e) {

      if (!t) throw new Error("A goal needs a condition");
      return {

      };
    }(r);
    this.setGoal(n, i);

  }

  async evaluateGoalAfterTurn(e) {
    if (this.goalEvaluationsInFlight.has(e)) return;
    const t = this.getGoal(e);
    if (t && DW(t) && (console.log(`[Goal] post-turn check on ${e}: active=${MW(t)} busy=${this.activeGenerations.has(e)} turns=${t.turnsEvaluated}`), MW(t))) {
      this.goalEvaluationsInFlight.add(e);
      try {
        await this.runGoalEvaluation(e, t);
      } finally {
        this.goalEvaluationsInFlight.delete(e);
      }
    }
  }
  async runGoalEvaluation(e, t) {
    if (this.activeGenerations.has(e)) return;
    const n = wi.getThreadById(e);
    if (!n) return;
    const r = function (e, t = 12e3) {
      const n = [];
      let r = 0;
      for (let o = e.length - 1; o >= 0; o--) {
        const s = e[o],
          i = `${s.role}: ${s.text}`;
        if (r + i.length > t) {
          n.unshift("[earlier turns omitted]");
          break;
        }
        n.unshift(i), r += i.length;
      }
      return n.join("\n\n");
    }((wi.getThreadWithMessages(e)?.messages ?? []).slice(-12).map(e => {
      const t = "string" == typeof e.message ? JSON.parse(e.message) : e.message,
        n = (t?.parts ?? []).filter(e => "text" === e?.type || "tool-result" === e?.type).map(e => "string" == typeof e.text ? e.text : JSON.stringify(e.output ?? "").slice(0, 500)).join("\n");
      return {
        role: String(t?.role ?? "assistant"),
        text: n
      };
    }));
    let o = {
      met: !1,
      reason: "Evaluator unavailable — treating as not met."
    };
    try {
      const e = await Hw(),
        n = e.model ? km(e.model) : null;
      if (n) {
        const e = await Uv(n.providerId, n.modelId);
        e && (o = function (e) {
          const t = (e ?? "").trim(),
            n = t.match(/\{[\s\S]*?\}/);
          if (n) try {
            const e = JSON.parse(n[0]);
            if ("boolean" == typeof e.met) {
              const t = "string" == typeof e.reason && e.reason.trim() ? e.reason.trim() : e.met ? "Condition met." : "Not met yet.";
              return {
                met: e.met,
                reason: t.slice(0, 200)
              };
            }
          } catch {}
          return {
            met: !1,
            reason: `Evaluator gave no usable verdict (${t.slice(0, 80) || "empty"}) — treating as not met.`
          };
        }((await ke({
          model: e,
          prompt: PW(t.condition, r)
        })).text));
      }
    } catch (a) {
      console.warn("[Goal] evaluator call failed, treating as not met:", a);
    }
    const s = function (e, t) {
      return DW(e) && e ? t.met ? {
        action: "achieved",
        reason: t.reason
      } : e.turnsEvaluated + 1 >= 50 ? {
        action: "exhausted",
        reason: `Stopped after 50 goal turns without meeting the condition. Last check: ${t.reason}`
      } : {
        action: "continue",
        reason: t.reason,
        nextTurnGuidance: ["<system-reminder>", `You are working toward this goal: ${e.condition}`, `A separate evaluator judged the goal not yet met: ${t.reason}`, "Continue from where you left off. Do not repeat work already done, and make the evidence for the", "condition visible in your output so it can be judged.", "</system-reminder>"].join("\n")
      } : {
        action: "none"
      };
    }(t, o);
    if ("none" === s.action) return;
    if (this.setGoal(e, function (e, t, n = 0) {
      const r = {
        ...e,
        turnsEvaluated: e.turnsEvaluated + 1,
        tokensSpent: (e.tokensSpent ?? 0) + n
      };
      return "achieved" === t.action ? (r.achievedAt = Date.now(), r.lastReason = t.reason) : "continue" !== t.action && "exhausted" !== t.action || (r.lastReason = t.reason, "exhausted" === t.action && (r.achievedAt = Date.now())), r;
    }(t, s)), console.log(`[Goal] thread ${e}: ${s.action} — ${"reason" in s ? s.reason : ""}`), "continue" !== s.action) return;
    if (this.activeGenerations.has(e)) return;
    const i = n.model;
    i ? this.generateChatResponse(e, i, {
      role: "user",
      parts: [{
        type: "text",
        text: s.nextTurnGuidance
      }]
    }, {
      source: "goal",
      userMessageMetadata: {
        almaGoalTurn: !0,
        goalCondition: t.condition
      }
    }).catch(e => console.error("[Goal] continuation turn failed:", e)) : console.warn(`[Goal] thread ${e} has no model — cannot continue`);
  }

  async retrieveMemoriesForContext(e, t, n, r, o) {
    const s = wi.getThreadById(t);

      context: "",
      usedMemories: []
    };
    const i = this.getMemorySettings();

      context: "",
      usedMemories: []
    };
    const a = this.getEmbeddingProvider();
    if (!a) return console.log("No embedding provider available for memory retrieval"), {
      context: "",
      usedMemories: []
    };
    try {
      n?.({
        stage: "retrieving",
        message: "Retrieving memories..."
      });
      let t = e;
      i.queryRewriting && (t = await this.rewriteQueryForMemorySearch(e, o));
      const s = await ri.generateEmbedding(t, a),
        c = r ? this.resolveLinkedUserIds(r) : void 0,
        l = await ri.searchMemories(s, {
          limit: i.maxRetrievedMemories,
          threshold: i.similarityThreshold,
          userIds: c
        });
      if (l.length > 0) {
        console.log(`Retrieved ${l.length} relevant memories for context`);
        const e = l.map(e => ({
          id: e.id,
          content: e.content
        }));
        return n?.({
          stage: "ready",
          message: "Memories retrieved",
          retrievedMemories: e
        }), {
          context: ti(l),
          usedMemories: e
        };
      }
      n?.({
        stage: "ready",
        message: "No memories found",
        retrievedMemories: []
      });
    } catch (c) {
      console.error("Error retrieving memories:", c), n?.({
        stage: "ready",
        message: "Memory retrieval failed",
        retrievedMemories: []
      });
    }
    return {
      context: "",
      usedMemories: []
    };
  }

  scheduleThreadTitleGeneration(e, t, n) {
    const r = wi.getThreadById(e);

      if (r) return void this.threadTitleGenerationAttempts.delete(e);

          const n = e.find(e => "user" === e.role)?.parts?.filter(e => "text" === e.type && "string" == typeof e.text).map(e => e.text.trim()).filter(Boolean).join(" ");

  async generateImageViaPluginProvider(e, t, n, r, o) {

      url: e
    })));

        "Content-Type": "application/json"
      },
      body: JSON.stringify(u)
    });
    if (!p.ok) {
      const e = await p.text().catch(() => p.statusText);
      throw new Error(`Plugin provider image ${l ? "edit" : "generation"} failed: ${p.status} ${e}`);
    }
    const f = await p.text();
    let m;
    if ((p.headers.get("content-type") || "").includes("text/event-stream") || f.trimStart().startsWith("data:")) {
      let e;
      for (const t of f.split("\n")) {
        const n = /^data:\s*(.+)$/.exec(t.trim());
        if (n && "[DONE]" !== n[1]) try {
          const t = JSON.parse(n[1]);
          t?.data?.[0]?.b64_json || t?.data?.[0]?.url ? e = t : (t?.b64_json || t?.url) && (e = {
            data: [t]
          });
        } catch {}
      }
      if (!e) throw new Error(`Plugin provider image API streamed no final image event (SSE, ${f.length} bytes)`);
      m = e;
    } else m = JSON.parse(f);
    const g = m.data?.[0];
    if (!g) throw new Error("No image returned from plugin provider image API");
    if (g.b64_json) return `data:${g.mime_type || "image/png"};base64,${g.b64_json}`;
    if (g.url) {
      const e = await GJ(g.url);
      if (!e.ok) throw new Error(`Failed to download generated image: ${e.status}`);
      const t = Buffer.from(await e.arrayBuffer());
      return `data:${e.headers.get("content-type") || "image/png"};base64,${t.toString("base64")}`;
    }
    throw new Error("Plugin provider image API returned no image data (no url or b64_json)");
  }

  getEmbeddingProvider() {
    const e = wi.getAllProviders(),
      t = e => !!e.apiKey || "custom" === e.type && !!e.baseURL && this.isValidUrl(e.baseURL),
      n = wi.getSettings();
    let r,
      o = "text-embedding-3-small";
    if (n) try {
      const e = JSON.parse(n.settingsData);
      if (e.memory?.embeddingModel) {
        const t = e.memory.embeddingModel,
          n = km(t);
        n ? (r = n.providerId, o = n.modelId) : o = t;
      }
    } catch {}
    if ("__local__" === r) return {
      type: "local",
      model: o
    };
    if (r) {
      const n = e.find(e => e.id === r && e.enabled && t(e));
      if (n) {
        const e = n.baseURL && this.isValidUrl(n.baseURL) ? n.baseURL : void 0;
        return {
          type: Vo(n.type),
          apiKey: n.apiKey || void 0,
          baseURL: e,
          model: o
        };
      }
    }
    const s = e.find(e => "openai" === e.type && e.enabled && e.apiKey);
    if (s) {
      const e = s.baseURL && this.isValidUrl(s.baseURL) ? s.baseURL : void 0;
      return {
        type: "openai",
        apiKey: s.apiKey,
        baseURL: e,
        model: o
      };
    }
    const i = e.find(e => "aihubmix" === e.type && e.enabled && e.apiKey);
    if (i) {
      const e = i.baseURL && this.isValidUrl(i.baseURL) ? qr(i.baseURL) : qr();
      return {
        type: "openai",
        apiKey: i.apiKey,
        baseURL: e,
        model: o
      };
    }
    const a = e.find(e => "openrouter" === e.type && e.enabled && e.apiKey);
    if (a) {
      const e = a.baseURL && this.isValidUrl(a.baseURL) ? a.baseURL : "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1";
      return {
        type: "openai",
        apiKey: a.apiKey,
        baseURL: e,
        model: o
      };
    }
    const c = e.find(e => "google" === e.type && e.enabled && e.apiKey);
    if (c) return {
      type: "google",

      type: "custom",
      apiKey: l.apiKey || void 0,
      baseURL: l.baseURL || void 0,
      model: o
    } : (console.log("[Memory] Custom provider found but no embedding model configured for it; skipping embeddings."), null) : null;
  }

  parseFrontmatter(e) {
    const t = {};
    if (!e.startsWith("---")) return {
      frontmatter: t,
      content: e
    };
    const n = e.indexOf("---", 3);
    if (-1 === n) return {
      frontmatter: t,
      content: e
    };
    const r = e.slice(3, n).trim();
    for (const o of r.split("\n")) {
      const e = o.indexOf(":");
      if (-1 === e) continue;
      const n = o.slice(0, e).trim();
      let r = o.slice(e + 1).trim();
      (r.startsWith('"') && r.endsWith('"') || r.startsWith("'") && r.endsWith("'")) && (r = r.slice(1, -1)), t[n] = r;
    }
    return {
      frontmatter: t,
      content: e.slice(n + 3).replace(/^\n+/, "")
    };
  }
  buildFrontmatter(e) {
    const t = ["---"];
    for (const [n, r] of Object.entries(e)) r && t.push(`${n}: "${r}"`);
    return t.push("---"), t.length > 2 ? t.join("\n") + "\n" : "";
  }
  getPeopleDir() {
    return K.join(P.homedir(), ".config", "alma", "people");
  }
  findPersonAvatarPath(e) {
    const t = this.getPeopleDir(),
      n = K.join(t, `${e}.avatar.jpg`);
    if (_.existsSync(n)) return n;
    for (const r of ["discord", "telegram", "feishu", "team"]) {
      const n = K.join(t, `${e}.avatar.${r}.jpg`);
      if (_.existsSync(n)) return n;
    }
    return null;
  }
  readPersonFile(e) {
    const t = this.getPeopleDir(),
      n = K.join(t, `${e}.md`);
    if (!_.existsSync(n)) return null;
    const r = _.readFileSync(n, "utf-8"),
      {
        frontmatter: o,
        content: s
      } = this.parseFrontmatter(r);
    return {
      name: e,
      content: s,
      frontmatter: o,
      hasAvatar: !!this.findPersonAvatarPath(e)
    };
  }

  resetStuckGenerations() {
    try {

        if ((r.updatedAt ? new Date(r.updatedAt).getTime() : 0) < e) continue;

        if (o) {
          const e = "string" == typeof o.message ? JSON.parse(o.message) : o.message;
          if ("assistant" !== e.role) continue;

            model: r.model ?? void 0

        }

    }
  }

  resolveAttachmentPath(e, t) {
    try {

        o = n.indexOf(r);
      if (-1 === o) return t.status(404).json({
        error: "not a resolvable attachment url"
      });
      const s = n.slice(o + r.length).split(/[?#]/)[0],
        i = K.basename(decodeURIComponent(s));
      if (!i) return t.status(404).json({
        error: "not found"
      });
      const a = K.join(this.galleryCacheDir, i);

        path: a

        error: "not found"
      });
    } catch (n) {
      return t.status(500).json({
        error: n instanceof Error ? n.message : String(n)
      });
    }
  }

  async autoResumeInterruptedSubagents(e) {
    const t = [];
    try {
      const {
          listTasks: n
        } = await Promise.resolve().then(() => t_),
        r = n(),
        o = new Set(r.map(e => e.resumeFrom).filter(Boolean)),

      for (const i of s) {

        console.log(`[StartupRecovery] Auto-resuming interrupted subagent ${i.id} ("${i.description}") in thread ${e}`);
        const n = await this.resumeSubagentTaskById(i.id);
        n.ok ? t.push(i.id) : console.warn(`[StartupRecovery] Auto-resume of subagent ${i.id} skipped: ${n.error}`);
      }

      console.error(`[StartupRecovery] Failed to auto-resume subagents for thread ${e}:`, n);
    }
    return t;
  }

  async executePromptApp(e, t) {

          id: n
        } = e.params,

        } = e.body,

      for (const [e, t] of Object.entries(r || {})) {
        const n = e.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&"),
          r = new RegExp(`(?:\\{\\{|｛｛)\\s*${n}\\s*(?:\\}\\}|｝｝)`, "g");
        i = "boolean" == typeof t ? i.replace(r, t ? "Yes" : "No") : i.replace(r, String(t));
      }
      const a = s.name,
        c = wi.createThreadWithPromptApp(a, n, {
          model: s.model || void 0,
          tools: s.tools || void 0,
          reasoningEffort: s.reasoningEffort || void 0,
          isIncognito: s.isIncognito || void 0
        }),
        l = wi.createPromptAppExecution({
          promptAppId: n,
          threadId: c.id,
          inputValues: r || {},
          generatedPrompt: i,
          attachmentCount: o || 0
        });
      this.broadcastThreadSync("thread_created", c), t.status(201).json({
        execution: l,
        thread: c,
        generatedPrompt: i
      });
    } catch (n) {
      console.error("Error executing prompt app:", n), t.status(500).json({
        error: `Failed to execute prompt app: ${n instanceof Error ? n.message : String(n)}`
      });
    }

  async createMCPServer(e, t) {
    try {
      const {
        name: n,
        config: r
      } = e.body;
      if (!n || !r || !r.command && !r.url) return t.status(400).json({
        error: "Missing required fields: name and config (with command or url) are required"
      });
      const o = KC.getConfig();
      if (o.mcpServers[n]) return t.status(409).json({
        error: "MCP server with this name already exists"
      });
      let s;
      if (r.command) s = {
        command: r.command,
        args: r.args,
        env: r.env
      };else {
        s = {
          url: r.url,
          headers: r.headers
        };
        const e = `pending:${r.url}`;
        wi.migrateMCPOAuthToken(e, n) && console.log(`[MCP] Migrated OAuth tokens from ${e} to ${n}`);
      }
      o.mcpServers[n] = s, KC.saveConfig(o), KC.refresh().catch(e => {
        console.error("[MCP] Background refresh failed after adding server:", e);
      }), t.status(201).json({
        id: n,
        name: n,
        config: r,
        enabled: !0,
        status: "connecting",
        installedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
      });
    } catch (n) {
      console.error("Error creating MCP server:", n), t.status(500).json({
        error: `Failed to create MCP server: ${n instanceof Error ? n.message : String(n)}`
      });
    }
  }
  async updateMCPServer(e, t) {
    try {
      const {
          id: n
        } = e.params,
        r = e.body,
        o = KC.getConfig();
      if (!o.mcpServers[n]) return t.status(404).json({
        error: "MCP server not found"
      });
      if (r.config) {
        const e = o.mcpServers[n],
          t = r.config;
        if (t.url || $s(e)) {
          const r = $s(e) ? e : {
            url: "",
            headers: void 0,
            transport: void 0
          };
          o.mcpServers[n] = {
            url: t.url || r.url,
            headers: t.headers ?? r.headers,
            transport: t.transport ?? r.transport
          };
        } else {
          const r = As(e) ? e : {
            command: "",
            args: void 0,
            env: void 0
          };
          o.mcpServers[n] = {
            command: t.command || r.command,
            args: t.args ?? r.args,
            env: t.env ?? r.env
          };
        }
      }
      let s = n;
      r.name && r.name !== n && (o.mcpServers[r.name] = o.mcpServers[n], delete o.mcpServers[n], s = r.name), KC.saveConfig(o), KC.refresh().catch(e => {
        console.error("[MCP] Background refresh failed after updating server:", e);
      }), t.json({
        id: s,
        name: s,
        config: o.mcpServers[s],
        enabled: !0,
        status: "connecting",
        installedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
      });
    } catch (n) {
      console.error("Error updating MCP server:", n), t.status(500).json({
        error: `Failed to update MCP server: ${n instanceof Error ? n.message : String(n)}`
      });
    }
  }
  async deleteMCPServer(e, t) {
    try {

        r = KC.getConfig();
      if (!r.mcpServers[n]) return t.status(404).json({

          id: n
        } = e.params,

          ...e.body
        };
      if (delete r.pinnedReferences, delete r.projectCard, delete r.projectConfig, "name" in r) {
        const e = "string" == typeof r.name ? r.name.trim() : "";
        if (!e) return t.status(400).json({

        });
        r.name = e;
      }
      if ("icon" in r) {
        const e = "string" == typeof r.icon ? r.icon.trim() : "";
        if (e.startsWith("data:")) {
          if (!/^data:image\/png;base64,[A-Za-z0-9+/]+=*$/.test(e) || e.length > 2e5) return t.status(400).json({
            error: "Project icon must be an emoji or a small PNG"
          });
          r.icon = e;
        } else r.icon = e ? e.slice(0, 32) : null;
      }
      const o = wi.updateWorkspace(n, r);
      if (!o) return t.status(404).json({
        error: "Workspace not found"
      });
      t.json(o), this.broadcastThreadSync("workspace_updated", o);
    } catch (n) {
      console.error("Error updating workspace:", n), t.status(500).json({
        error: `Failed to update workspace: ${n instanceof Error ? n.message : String(n)}`
      });
    }
  }
