  async getPresentationModel(e, t) {
    try {
      const {
        workspaceId: n,
        filePath: r,
        isExternal: o,
        presentationId: s
      } = e.body || {};
      if (!n || "string" != typeof n) return t.status(400).json({
        error: "workspaceId is required"
      });
      if (!r || "string" != typeof r) return t.status(400).json({
        error: "filePath is required"
      });
      const i = wi.getWorkspaceById(n);
      if (!i) return t.status(404).json({
        error: "Workspace not found"
      });
      if (i.remoteHostId) return t.json({
        presentation: null
      });
      const a = K.resolve(i.path),
        c = o ? K.resolve(r) : K.resolve(a, r);
      if (o) {
        if (!K.isAbsolute(r)) return t.status(400).json({
          error: "External presentation path must be absolute"
        });
      } else {
        const e = K.relative(a, c);
        if (e.startsWith("..") || K.isAbsolute(e)) return t.status(403).json({
          error: "Access denied"
        });
      }
      const l = await async function (e, t, n) {
        const r = U.resolve(t),
          o = t => U.resolve(e, t.outputPath) === r;
        if (n) try {
          const t = await TM(e, n);
          if (o(t)) return t;
        } catch {}
        const s = U.join(e, ".alma", "presentations");
        let i;
        try {
          i = await En.readdir(s, {
            withFileTypes: !0
          });
        } catch {
          return null;
        }
        let a = null;
        for (const c of i.slice(0, 500)) if (c.isDirectory()) try {
          const t = await TM(e, c.name);
          if (!o(t)) continue;
          const n = Date.parse(t.updatedAt) || 0,
            r = a ? Date.parse(a.updatedAt) || 0 : -1;
          (!a || n > r || n === r && t.revision > a.revision || n === r && t.revision === a.revision && t.slides.length > a.slides.length) && (a = t);
        } catch {}
        return a;
      }(a, c, s);
      if (!l) return t.json({
        presentation: null
      });
      t.json({
        presentation: {
          id: l.id,
          revision: l.revision,
          title: l.title,
          layout: l.layout,
          statePath: K.relative(a, SM(a, l.id)),
          slides: l.slides.map((e, t) => {
            return {
              id: e.id,
              index: t,
              elements: (n = e.elements, n.flatMap(e => {
                const t = {
                  id: e.id,
                  type: e.type,
                  label: mW(e),
                  x: e.x,
                  y: e.y,
                  w: e.w,
                  h: e.h,
                  zIndex: e.zIndex
                };
                if ("chart" !== e.type || "column" !== e.chartType && "bar" !== e.chartType) return [t];
                const n = e.categories.length,
                  r = e.series.length,
                  o = e.series.flatMap(e => e.values),
                  s = e.valueAxisMin ?? Math.min(0, ...o),
                  i = e.valueAxisMax ?? 1.1 * Math.max(0, ...o),
                  a = Math.max(1e-4, i - s),
                  c = e => (e - s) / a;
                return [t, ...e.series.flatMap((t, o) => e.categories.map((s, i) => {
                  const a = "column" === e.chartType,
                    l = e.x + e.w * (a ? .08 : .14),
                    d = e.y + .07 * e.h,
                    u = e.w * (a ? .88 : .8),
                    h = e.h * (a ? .75 : .82),
                    p = (a ? u : h) / n,
                    f = .76 * p / r,
                    m = .12 * p + o * f,
                    g = c(0),
                    y = c(t.values[i]),
                    w = Math.min(g, y),
                    b = Math.max(.015, Math.abs(y - g));
                  return {
                    id: `${e.id}::series-${o}::point-${i}`,
                    type: "chart-point",
                    label: `${t.name} · ${s}: ${t.values[i]}`,
                    x: a ? l + i * p + m : l + u * w,
                    y: a ? d + h * (1 - Math.max(g, y)) : d + i * p + m,
                    w: a ? f : u * b,
                    h: a ? h * b : f,
                    zIndex: e.zIndex + .5,
                    parentElementId: e.id,
                    chartPoint: {
                      chartElementId: e.id,
                      seriesIndex: o,
                      pointIndex: i,
                      seriesName: t.name,
                      category: s,
                      value: t.values[i],
                      seriesColor: t.color,
                      pointColor: t.pointColors?.[i]
                    }
                  };
                }))];
              }))
            };
            var n;
          })
        }
      });
    } catch (n) {
      const e = n instanceof Error ? n.message : String(n);
      console.error("Error loading presentation model:", n), t.status(500).json({
        error: `Failed to load presentation model: ${e}`
      });
    }
  }
  async previewPresentationFile(e, t) {
    try {
      const {
        workspaceId: n,
        filePath: r,
        isExternal: o,
        slideIndex: s,
        previewSessionId: i
      } = e.body || {};
      if (!r || "string" != typeof r) return t.status(400).json({
        error: "filePath is required"
      });
      if (void 0 !== s && (!Number.isInteger(s) || s < 0)) return t.status(400).json({
        error: "slideIndex must be a non-negative integer"
      });
      if (void 0 !== i && ("string" != typeof i || i.length > 200)) return t.status(400).json({
        error: "previewSessionId must be a string no longer than 200 characters"
      });
      let a;
      if (o) {
        if (!K.isAbsolute(r)) return t.status(400).json({
          error: "External presentation path must be absolute"
        });
        a = K.resolve(r);
      } else {
        if (!n) return t.status(400).json({
          error: "workspaceId is required"
        });
        const e = wi.getWorkspaceById(n);
        if (!e) return t.status(404).json({
          error: "Workspace not found"
        });
        if (e.remoteHostId) return t.status(422).json({
          error: "Authoritative PowerPoint preview is not available for remote workspaces yet"
        });
        const o = K.resolve(e.path);
        a = K.resolve(o, r);
        const s = K.relative(o, a);
        if (s.startsWith("..") || K.isAbsolute(s)) return t.status(403).json({
          error: "Access denied"
        });
      }
      if (".pptx" !== K.extname(a).toLowerCase()) return t.status(400).json({
        error: "Only .pptx files can be previewed"
      });
      if (!_.existsSync(a)) return t.status(404).json({
        error: "File not found"
      });
      const c = await YM(process.resourcesPath, process.defaultApp ? process.cwd() : void 0, {
          install: !1
        }),
        l = new AbortController(),
        d = () => {
          t.writableEnded || l.abort();
        };
      t.once("close", d);
      const u = await fW({
        presentationPath: a,
        rendererPath: c,
        slideIndex: s,
        supersedeKey: i,
        signal: l.signal
      }).finally(() => t.off("close", d));
      t.json({
        imagePaths: u.images,
        slideCount: u.slideCount,
        width: u.width,
        height: u.height,
        cacheHit: u.cacheHit
      });
    } catch (n) {
      const e = n instanceof Error ? n.message : String(n);
      if (n instanceof Error && "AbortError" === n.name) return void (t.destroyed || t.headersSent || t.writableEnded || t.status(409).json({
        error: e
      }));
      if (console.error("Error rendering presentation preview:", n), e.includes("too large") || e.includes("too many slides")) return t.status(413).json({
        error: e
      });
      if (e.includes("renderer is unavailable")) return t.status(503).json({
        error: e
      });
      if (e.includes("exceeded") || e.includes("terminated")) return t.status(504).json({
        error: e
      });
      t.status(500).json({
        error: `Failed to render presentation preview: ${e}`
      });
    }
  }
  serveFileBytes(e, t, n, r) {
    const o = {
        ".png": "image/png",
        ".jpg": "image/jpeg",
        ".jpeg": "image/jpeg",
        ".gif": "image/gif",
        ".webp": "image/webp",
        ".svg": "image/svg+xml",
        ".ico": "image/x-icon",
        ".bmp": "image/bmp",
        ".avif": "image/avif",
        ".pdf": "application/pdf",
        ".mp4": "video/mp4",
        ".webm": "video/webm",
        ".mov": "video/quicktime",
        ".avi": "video/x-msvideo",
        ".mkv": "video/x-matroska",
        ".m4v": "video/x-m4v",
        ".ogv": "video/ogg",
        ".mp3": "audio/mpeg",
        ".wav": "audio/wav",
        ".ogg": "audio/ogg",
        ".m4a": "audio/mp4",
        ".flac": "audio/flac",
        ".aac": "audio/aac",
        ".docx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
        ".xlsx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
        ".xls": "application/vnd.ms-excel"
      }[K.extname(r).toLowerCase()] || "application/octet-stream",
      s = _.statSync(n).size;
    t.setHeader("Accept-Ranges", "bytes");
    const i = e.headers.range;
    if (i) {
      const e = i.replace(/bytes=/, "").split("-"),
        r = parseInt(e[0], 10),
        a = e[1] ? parseInt(e[1], 10) : s - 1,
        c = a - r + 1;
      t.status(206), t.setHeader("Content-Range", `bytes ${r}-${a}/${s}`), t.setHeader("Content-Length", c), t.setHeader("Content-Type", o);
      const l = _.createReadStream(n, {
        start: r,
        end: a
      });
      l.on("error", e => {
        console.error("Error streaming file:", e), t.headersSent ? t.end() : t.status(500).json({
          error: `Failed to stream file: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`
        });
      }), l.pipe(t);
    } else {
      t.setHeader("Content-Type", o), t.setHeader("Content-Length", s);
      const e = _.createReadStream(n);
      e.on("error", e => {
        console.error("Error streaming file:", e), t.headersSent ? t.end() : t.status(500).json({
          error: `Failed to stream file: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`
        });
      }), e.pipe(t);
    }
  }

    } catch (n) {

  async copyWorkspaceFile(e, t) {
    try {
      const {
          id: n
        } = e.params,
        {
          sourcePath: r,
          destinationPath: o
        } = e.body;
      if (!r || !o) return t.status(400).json({
        error: "Source and destination paths are required"
      });
      const s = wi.getWorkspaceById(n);
      if (!s) return t.status(404).json({
        error: "Workspace not found"
      });
      if (s.remoteHostId) {
        const e = NI(s.remoteHostId),
          n = K.posix.join(s.path, r),
          i = K.posix.join(s.path, o),
          a = K.posix.resolve(s.path);
        if (!K.posix.resolve(n).startsWith(a) || !K.posix.resolve(i).startsWith(a)) return t.status(403).json({
          error: "Access denied: path traversal detected"
        });
        if ("directory" === (await e.call("stat", {
          path: n
        })).type) return t.status(400).json({
          error: "Copying directories is not supported on remote workspaces yet"
        });
        const c = await e.call("readFile", {
          path: n
        });
        return await e.call("writeFile", {
          path: i,
          b64: c.b64,
          mkdirp: !0
        }), t.json({
          success: !0,
          destinationPath: o
        });
      }
      const i = K.join(s.path, r),
        a = K.join(s.path, o),
        c = K.resolve(i),
        l = K.resolve(a),
        d = K.resolve(s.path);
      if (!c.startsWith(d) || !l.startsWith(d)) return t.status(403).json({
        error: "Access denied: path traversal detected"
      });
      (await _.promises.stat(i)).isDirectory() ? await _.promises.cp(i, a, {
        recursive: !0
      }) : await _.promises.copyFile(i, a), t.json({
        success: !0,
        destinationPath: o
      });
    } catch (n) {
      if (console.error("Error copying file:", n), "ENOENT" === n.code) return t.status(404).json({
        error: "Source file not found"
      });
      t.status(500).json({
        error: `Failed to copy file: ${n instanceof Error ? n.message : String(n)}`
      });
    }
  }

          destinationPath: o
        })) : t.status(403).json({
          error: "Access denied: path traversal detected"
        });
      }
      const i = K.join(s.path, r),
        a = K.join(s.path, o),
        c = K.resolve(i),
        l = K.resolve(a),
        d = K.resolve(s.path);
      if (!c.startsWith(d) || !l.startsWith(d)) return t.status(403).json({
        error: "Access denied: path traversal detected"
      });
      await _.promises.rename(i, a), t.json({
        success: !0,
        destinationPath: o
      });
    } catch (n) {
      if (console.error("Error moving file:", n), "ENOENT" === n.code) return t.status(404).json({
        error: "Source file not found"
      });
      t.status(500).json({
        error: `Failed to move file: ${n instanceof Error ? n.message : String(n)}`
      });
    }
  }
  async deleteWorkspaceFile(e, t) {
    try {
      const {
          id: n,
          filePath: r
        } = e.params,
        o = Array.isArray(r) ? r.join("/") : r;
      if (!o) return t.status(400).json({
        error: "File path is required"
      });
      const s = wi.getWorkspaceById(n);
      if (!s) return t.status(404).json({
        error: "Workspace not found"
      });
      if (s.remoteHostId) {
        const e = K.posix.join(s.path, o);
        return K.posix.resolve(e).startsWith(K.posix.resolve(s.path)) ? (await NI(s.remoteHostId).call("rm", {
          path: e,
          recursive: !0
        }), t.json({
          success: !0
        })) : t.status(403).json({
          error: "Access denied: path traversal detected"
        });
      }
      const i = K.join(s.path, o),
        a = K.resolve(i),
        c = K.resolve(s.path);
      if (!a.startsWith(c)) return t.status(403).json({
        error: "Access denied: path traversal detected"
      });
      (await _.promises.stat(i)).isDirectory() ? await _.promises.rm(i, {
        recursive: !0
      }) : await _.promises.unlink(i), t.json({
        success: !0
      });
    } catch (n) {
      if (console.error("Error deleting file:", n), "ENOENT" === n.code) return t.status(404).json({
        error: "File not found"
      });
      t.status(500).json({
        error: `Failed to delete file: ${n instanceof Error ? n.message : String(n)}`
      });
    }
  }

  async getGitStatus(e, t) {
    try {
      const {
          id: r
        } = e.params,
        o = "true" === e.query.fetch,
        s = wi.getWorkspaceById(r);
      if (!s) return t.status(404).json({
        error: "Workspace not found"
      });
      if (o) {
        console.log("[Server] getGitStatus: fetching for", s.path);
        try {
          await wJ(s.path), console.log("[Server] getGitStatus: fetch completed");
        } catch (n) {
          console.error("[Server] getGitStatus: fetch error:", n);
        }
      }
      const i = await async function (e) {
        if (!(await cJ(e))) return {
          isGitRepo: !1,
          branch: null,
          upstream: null,
          ahead: 0,
          behind: 0,
          staged: [],
          unstaged: [],
          conflicted: []
        };
        try {
          const t = (await aJ(e, ["status", "--porcelain=v2", "--branch", "-u"], 8e3)).split("\n").filter(e => e.length > 0);
          let r = null,
            o = null,
            s = 0,
            i = 0;
          const a = [],
            c = [],
            l = [];
          for (const e of t) if (e.startsWith("# branch.head ")) r = e.substring(14), "(detached)" === r && (r = "HEAD (detached)");else if (e.startsWith("# branch.upstream ")) o = e.substring(18);else if (e.startsWith("# branch.ab ")) {
            const t = e.match(/# branch\.ab \+(\d+) -(\d+)/);
            t && (s = parseInt(t[1], 10), i = parseInt(t[2], 10));
          } else {
            const {
              staged: t,
              unstaged: n
            } = hJ(e);
            t && ("conflicted" === t.status ? l.push(t) : a.push(t)), n && ("conflicted" === n.status ? l.push(n) : c.push(n));
          }
          let d = null;
          const u = r ? await kJ(e) : null;
          if (r && u) {
            const t = `${u}/${r}`;
            try {
              await aJ(e, ["rev-parse", "--verify", t], 3e3), d = t, console.log("[GitService] getStatus: using branch remote ref:", d);
            } catch {
              d = o, console.log("[GitService] getStatus: branch remote ref not found, using upstream:", d);
            }
          } else d = o;
          if (console.log("[GitService] getStatus: branch=", r, "upstream=", o, "remoteRef=", d, "initial ahead=", s), d && r) try {
            const t = await aJ(e, ["rev-list", "--count", `${d}..HEAD`], 3e3),
              n = await aJ(e, ["rev-list", "--count", `HEAD..${d}`], 3e3),
              r = parseInt(t.trim(), 10) || 0,
              o = parseInt(n.trim(), 10) || 0;
            console.log("[GitService] getStatus: rev-list result ahead=", r, "behind=", o), s = r, i = o;
          } catch (n) {
            console.error("[GitService] getStatus: rev-list failed:", n);
          }
          return {
            isGitRepo: !0,
            branch: r,
            upstream: o,
            ahead: s,
            behind: i,
            staged: a,
            unstaged: c,
            conflicted: l
          };
        } catch (t) {
          return console.error("Error getting git status:", t), {
            isGitRepo: !0,
            branch: null,
            upstream: null,
            ahead: 0,
            behind: 0,
            staged: [],
            unstaged: [],
            conflicted: []
          };
        }
      }(s.path);
      console.log("[Server] getGitStatus: returning status, ahead=", i.ahead, "behind=", i.behind), t.json(i);
    } catch (r) {
      console.error("Error getting git status:", r), t.status(500).json({
        error: `Failed to get git status: ${r instanceof Error ? r.message : String(r)}`
      });
    }
  }

  async getGitDiffStats(e, t) {
    try {
      const {
          id: n
        } = e.params,
        r = wi.getWorkspaceById(n);
      if (!r) return t.status(404).json({
        error: "Workspace not found"
      });
      const o = await async function (e) {
        try {
          if (!(await cJ(e))) return {
            additions: 0,
            deletions: 0,
            filesChanged: 0
          };
          let t = 0,
            n = 0;
          const r = new Set(),
            o = e => {
              const o = e.split("\n").filter(e => e.trim());
              for (const s of o) {
                const e = s.split("\t");
                if (e.length >= 3) {
                  const o = "-" === e[0] ? 0 : parseInt(e[0], 10) || 0,
                    s = "-" === e[1] ? 0 : parseInt(e[1], 10) || 0,
                    i = e[2];
                  t += o, n += s, r.add(i);
                }
              }
            };
          try {
            o(await aJ(e, ["diff", "--cached", "--numstat"]));
          } catch {}
          try {
            o(await aJ(e, ["diff", "--numstat"]));
          } catch {}
          return {
            additions: t,
            deletions: n,
            filesChanged: r.size
          };
        } catch {
          return {
            additions: 0,
            deletions: 0,
            filesChanged: 0
          };
        }
      }(r.path);
      t.json(o);
    } catch (n) {
      console.error("Error getting git diff stats:", n), t.status(500).json({
        error: `Failed to get git diff stats: ${n instanceof Error ? n.message : String(n)}`
      });
    }
  }

  async getGitCommitDetail(e, t) {
    try {
      const {
          id: n,
          hash: r
        } = e.params,
        o = wi.getWorkspaceById(n);
      if (!o) return t.status(404).json({
        error: "Workspace not found"
      });
      const s = await async function (e, t) {
        const n = await aJ(e, ["log", "-1", "--format=%H%x00%h%x00%s%x00%b%x00%an%x00%ae%x00%aI%x00%P", t]),
          [r, o, s, i, a, c, l, d] = n.split("\0"),
          u = !d || "" === d.trim(),
          h = ["diff-tree", "-p", "--stat"];
        u && h.push("--root"), h.push(t);
        const p = (await aJ(e, h)).match(/(\d+) files? changed(?:, (\d+) insertions?\(\+\))?(?:, (\d+) deletions?\(-\))?/),
          f = {
            filesChanged: p ? parseInt(p[1], 10) : 0,
            additions: p && p[2] ? parseInt(p[2], 10) : 0,
            deletions: p && p[3] ? parseInt(p[3], 10) : 0
          },
          m = ["diff-tree", "-p"];
        u && m.push("--root"), m.push(t);
        const g = await aJ(e, m);
        return {
          hash: r.trim(),
          shortHash: o.trim(),
          message: s.trim(),
          body: i.trim(),
          author: a.trim(),
          authorEmail: c.trim(),
          date: l.trim(),
          parentHashes: d ? d.trim().split(" ").filter(Boolean) : [],
          diff: g,
          stats: f
        };
      }(o.path, r);
      t.json(s);
    } catch (n) {
      console.error("Error getting commit detail:", n), t.status(500).json({
        error: `Failed to get commit detail: ${n instanceof Error ? n.message : String(n)}`
      });
    }
  }

      });

  async getRebaseStatus(e, t) {

          id: n
        } = e.params,

              n = T.existsSync(Y.join(e, ".git", "rebase-apply"));
            return t || n;
          } catch {
            return !1;
          }
        }(r.path),
        s = o ? await async function (e) {
          try {
            const t = Y.join(e, ".git", "rebase-merge"),
              n = Y.join(e, ".git", "rebase-apply");
            let r = "";
            if (T.existsSync(t)) r = t;else {
              if (!T.existsSync(n)) return null;
              r = n;
            }
            const o = Y.join(r, "msgnum"),
              s = Y.join(r, "end");
            return T.existsSync(o) && T.existsSync(s) ? {

              total: parseInt(T.readFileSync(s, "utf-8").trim(), 10)
            } : null;
          } catch {
            return null;
          }
        }(r.path) : null;
      t.json({

        progress: s

  async startRebase(e, t) {
    try {
      const {
          id: n
        } = e.params,
        {
          onto: r
        } = e.body,
        o = wi.getWorkspaceById(n);
      if (!o) return t.status(404).json({
        error: "Workspace not found"
      });
      let s = r;
      if (!s) {
        const e = await kJ(o.path),
          t = e ? await TJ(o.path, e) : null;
        s = e && t ? `${e}/${t}` : "origin/main", e && (await wJ(o.path, e));
      }
      const i = await async function (e, t) {
        try {
          return await aJ(e, ["rebase", t]), {
            success: !0,
            hasConflicts: !1
          };
        } catch (n) {
          const e = n instanceof Error ? n.message : "";
          return e.includes("CONFLICT") || e.includes("could not apply") ? {
            success: !1,
            hasConflicts: !0
          } : {
            success: !1,
            hasConflicts: !1,
            error: e
          };
        }
      }(o.path, s);
      t.json(i);
    } catch (n) {
      console.error("Error starting rebase:", n), t.status(500).json({
        error: n.message || "Failed to start rebase"
      });
    }
  }

  async cleanupWorktreeAfterMerge(t, n) {
    try {
      const {
          id: r
        } = t.params,
        {
          action: o
        } = t.body,
        s = wi.getWorkspaceById(r);
      if (!s) return n.status(404).json({
        error: "Workspace not found"
      });
      if (!s.isWorktree || !s.parentWorkspaceId) return n.status(400).json({
        error: "Workspace is not a worktree"
      });
      if ("keep" === o) return wi.updateWorkspace(r, {
        prNumber: null,
        prUrl: null,
        prState: null,
        prBaseBranch: null
      }), n.json({
        success: !0,
        action: "keep"
      });
      const i = wi.getWorkspaceById(s.parentWorkspaceId);
      if ("delete" === o || "archive" === o) {
        const t = "archive" === o ? wi.getThreadsByWorkspaceId(r) : [];
        if (i) try {
          await EJ(i.path, s.path, !0);
        } catch (e) {
          console.error("Failed to delete git worktree:", e);
        }
        if (wi.deleteWorkspace(r), "archive" === o) for (const e of t) wi.deleteThread(e.id), wi.deleteThreadDiffStatsCache(e.id), rS.cleanupSession(e.id).catch(e => {
          console.error("[ACP] Error cleaning up sessions for deleted thread:", e);
        }), this.broadcastThreadSync("thread_deleted", {
          id: e.id
        });
        return n.json({
          success: !0,
          action: o
        });
      }
      n.status(400).json({
        error: "Invalid action. Must be keep, delete, or archive"
      });
    } catch (r) {
      console.error("Error cleaning up worktree:", r), n.status(500).json({
        error: r.message || "Failed to cleanup worktree"
      });
    }
  }

  async execTerminal(e, t) {
    try {
      const {
        command: n,
        sessionId: r,
        workspaceId: o,
        threadId: s,
        timeout: i
      } = e.body ?? {};
      if ("string" != typeof n || !n.trim()) return t.status(400).json({
        error: "command (string) is required"
      });
      let a;
      if (r) {
        if (!WX.getSession(r)) return t.status(404).json({
          error: `Terminal session ${r} not found`
        });
        a = r;
      } else {
        let e = o;
        if (!e && s) {
          const t = wi.getThreadById(s);
          e = t?.workspaceId ?? void 0;
        }
        if (!e) return t.status(400).json({
          error: "Provide sessionId, workspaceId, or a threadId whose thread has a workspace"
        });
        const n = wi.getWorkspaceById(e);
        if (!n) return t.status(404).json({
          error: `Workspace ${e} not found`
        });
        a = WX.getOrCreateAgentSession(e, n.path, s ?? null, n.remoteHostId ? $S(n.remoteHostId, n.path) : void 0);
      }
      if (!a) return t.status(500).json({
        error: "Failed to resolve terminal session"
      });
      const c = await WX.execAndWait(a, n, "number" == typeof i ? i : void 0);
      if (null === c) return t.status(404).json({
        error: "Terminal session not found"
      });
      t.json({
        sessionId: a,
        ...c
      });
    } catch (n) {
      console.error("Error exec-ing in terminal:", n), t.status(500).json({
        error: `Failed to exec in terminal: ${n instanceof Error ? n.message : String(n)}`
      });
    }
  }

  async handleMCPOAuthCallback(e, t) {
    try {
      const {
        code: n,
        error: r,
        state: o
      } = e.query;
      if (console.log("[MCP OAuth] Callback received:", {
        code: !!n,
        error: r,
        state: o
      }), !o || "string" != typeof o) return void t.status(400).send(this.renderOAuthCallbackPage(!1, "Missing state parameter"));
      if (!qC.handleOAuthCallback(o, "string" == typeof n ? n : null, "string" == typeof r ? r : null)) return void t.status(400).send(this.renderOAuthCallbackPage(!1, "Unknown authorization request"));
      r ? t.send(this.renderOAuthCallbackPage(!1, `Authorization failed: ${r}`)) : t.send(this.renderOAuthCallbackPage(!0, "Authorization successful! You can close this window."));
    } catch (n) {
      console.error("[MCP OAuth] Callback error:", n), t.status(500).send(this.renderOAuthCallbackPage(!1, "Internal server error"));
    }
  }

  async updatePluginPermissions(e, t) {
    try {
      const {
          id: n
        } = e.params,
        {
          permission: r,
          status: o
        } = e.body;
      if (!r || !o) return void t.status(400).json({
        error: "permission and status are required"
      });
      let s;
      if ("granted" === o) s = await Wz.grantPermission(n, r);else {
        if ("denied" !== o) return void t.status(400).json({
          error: 'Invalid status. Must be "granted" or "denied"'
        });
        s = await Wz.denyPermission(n, r);
      }
      if (!s) return void t.status(404).json({
        error: "Plugin not found"
      });
      const i = Wz.getPluginById(n);
      this.broadcastPluginsSync("plugin_permissions_updated", {
        id: n,
        permissions: i?.permissions
      }), t.json(i?.permissions);
    } catch (n) {
      console.error("Error updating plugin permissions:", n), t.status(500).json({
        error: `Failed to update plugin permissions: ${n instanceof Error ? n.message : String(n)}`
      });
    }
  }

  heartbeatInterval = null;
  startHeartbeat() {
    let e = 0;
    this.heartbeatInterval = setInterval(async () => {
      try {
        const t = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${this.port}/api/health`);
        t.ok ? e = 0 : (e++, console.warn(`[Heartbeat] Health check failed (${e}): status ${t.status}`));
      } catch (t) {
        e++, console.error(`[Heartbeat] Health check error (${e}):`, t);
      }
      if (e >= 3) {
        console.error(`[Heartbeat] ${e} consecutive failures! Attempting recovery...`);
        try {
          this.server && this.server.close(), this.server = dn(this.app), this.server.listen(this.port, "127.0.0.1", () => {
            console.log(`[Heartbeat] Server recovered on port ${this.port}`), T$(this.getApiBaseUrl()), this.setupWebSocket(), e = 0;
          });
        } catch (n) {
          console.error("[Heartbeat] Recovery failed, app may need manual restart:", n);
        }
      }
    }, 3e4), console.log("[Heartbeat] Started (every 30s)");
  }
  initializeTelegramBot() {
    try {
      const e = wi.getSettings();
      if (!e) return;
      const t = JSON.parse(e.settingsData),
        n = t?.telegram;
      if (!n?.enabled || !n?.botToken) return;
      this.messageBridge = new wH({
        enabled: n.enabled,
        botToken: n.botToken,
        allowedUserIds: "string" == typeof n.allowedUserIds ? JSON.parse(n.allowedUserIds) : n.allowedUserIds || [],
        ownerId: n.ownerId
      }, this.port), this.messageBridge.start().catch(e => {
        console.error("[TelegramBot] Failed to start:", e);
      });
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("[TelegramBot] Init error:", e);
    }
  }

  readMobileRelaySettings() {
    try {
      const e = wi.getSettings(),
        t = e?.settingsData ? JSON.parse(e.settingsData) : {},
        n = t?.mobileRelay || {};
      let r = "string" == typeof n.serverUrl ? n.serverUrl.replace(/\/+$/, "") : "";
      return "https://alma-relay.yetoneful.workers.dev" === r && (r = YJ), {
        enabled: !0 === n.enabled,
        serverUrl: r,
        connectCode: "string" == typeof n.connectCode ? n.connectCode : "",
        registrationKey: "string" == typeof n.registrationKey && n.registrationKey.length > 0 ? n.registrationKey : void 0,
        e2eEncryption: !1 !== n.e2eEncryption
      };
    } catch {
      return {
        enabled: !1,
        serverUrl: "",
        connectCode: "",
        e2eEncryption: !0
      };
    }
  }
  async mutateMobileRelaySettings(e) {
    const t = await this.acquireSettingsLock();
    try {
      const t = wi.getSettings(),
        n = t?.settingsData ? JSON.parse(t.settingsData) : {},
        r = e(this.readMobileRelaySettings());
      n.mobileRelay = {
        ...n.mobileRelay,
        ...r
      };
      const o = wi.saveSettings(JSON.stringify(n));
      this.broadcastSettingsSync("settings_updated", JSON.parse(o.settingsData));
    } finally {
      t();
    }
    this.syncMobileRelayFromSettings(), this.syncTeamHostFromSettings();
  }

  galleryFileNameFromUrl(e) {
    const t = `http://localhost:${this.port}/api/gallery/cache/`;
    if ("string" != typeof e || !e.startsWith(t)) return null;
    const n = decodeURIComponent(e.slice(t.length).split(/[?#]/)[0]);
    return n && n === K.basename(n) ? n : null;
  }
  readTeamHostSettings() {
    const e = e => {
      const t = e || this.getMobileRelayPublicStatus().accountEmail || "";
      return t ? mU(t) : null;
    };
    try {
      const t = wi.getSettings(),
        n = t?.settingsData ? JSON.parse(t.settingsData) : {},
        r = n?.team?.host || {},
        o = Number(r.port),
        s = "string" == typeof r.email ? r.email.trim() : "";
      return {
        enabled: !0 === r.enabled,
        port: Number.isInteger(o) && o > 0 && o < 65536 ? o : 23111,
        name: "string" == typeof r.name && r.name.trim() ? r.name.trim() : P.userInfo().username,
        email: s,
        avatar: e(s),
        relay: !1 !== r.relay,
        relayCode: "string" == typeof r.relayCode && /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,128}$/.test(r.relayCode) ? r.relayCode : ""
      };
    } catch {
      return {
        enabled: !1,
        port: 23111,
        name: P.userInfo().username,
        email: "",
        avatar: e(""),
        relay: !0,
        relayCode: ""
      };
    }
  }
  async persistTeamHostSettings(e) {
    const t = await this.acquireSettingsLock();
    try {
      const t = wi.getSettings(),
        n = t?.settingsData ? JSON.parse(t.settingsData) : {},
        {
          avatar: r,
          ...o
        } = this.readTeamHostSettings();
      n.team = {
        ...(n.team || {}),
        host: {
          ...o,
          ...(n.team?.host || {}),
          ...e
        }
      };
      const s = wi.saveSettings(JSON.stringify(n));
      this.broadcastSettingsSync("settings_updated", JSON.parse(s.settingsData));
    } finally {
      t();
    }
  }

  onTeamMemberEvent(e, t) {
    if (this.teamClient && !this.teamCore?.isHosting) try {
      if ("team_channels_changed" === e) {
        const e = t?.channels;
        if (Array.isArray(e)) for (const t of e) this.teamChannelTitles.set(t.threadId, t.name);
        return;
      }
      if ("message_deleted" === e) {
        const e = t?.id;
        return void (e && (function (e, t) {
          const n = wi.getSqlite();
          n.transaction(() => {
            n.prepare("DELETE FROM time_clue_seen WHERE clue_id IN (SELECT id FROM team_time_clues WHERE message_id=?)").run(t), n.prepare("DELETE FROM team_time_clues WHERE message_id=?").run(t), n.prepare("DELETE FROM time_clue_index_state WHERE message_id=?").run(`team:${t}`);
          })();
        }(0, e), this.broadcastThreadSync("time_clues_changed", {
          team: !0,
          id: e
        })));
      }
      if ("message_added" !== e && "message_updated" !== e) return;
      const n = t;
      if (!n?.id || !n.threadId) return;
      Do(wi, n, {
        name: this.teamClient.status().name
      }, this.teamChannelTitles.get(n.threadId) ?? "").then(({
        count: t
      }) => {
        (t > 0 || "message_updated" === e) && this.broadcastThreadSync("time_clues_changed", {
          team: !0,
          id: n.id
        });
      }).catch(e => console.warn("[Team] mention clue indexing failed:", e instanceof Error ? e.message : e));
    } catch (n) {
      console.warn("[Team] mention clue indexing failed:", n instanceof Error ? n.message : n);
    }
  }

  }

          model: l,

No prose, no markdown fence.\n- Each string is the prompt the user would send — written from the user\'s first-person perspective, imperative voice ("Continue …", "Help me …", "Summarize …", "Draft …").   async downloadWhisperModel(e, t) {
    try {
      const {
        modelId: n
      } = e.params;
      if (!["tiny", "tiny.en", "base", "base.en", "small", "small.en", "medium", "medium.en", "large-v1", "large-v2", "large-v3", "large-v3-turbo"].includes(n)) return t.status(400).json({
        error: `Invalid model ID: ${n}`
      });
      const r = this.getWhisperModelPath(n);
      if (_.existsSync(r)) return t.json({
        success: !0,
        message: "Model already downloaded",
        modelPath: r
      });
      if (this.whisperDownloads.has(n)) return t.json({
        success: !0,
        message: "Download already in progress"
      });
      const o = this.getWhisperModelUrl(n),
        s = new AbortController();
      this.whisperDownloads.set(n, {
        progress: 0,
        abortController: s,
        downloadedBytes: 0,
        totalBytes: 0,
        startTime: Date.now(),
        speed: 0
      }), this.performWhisperModelDownload(n, o, r, s.signal).catch(e => {
        console.error(`Failed to download whisper model ${n}:`, e), this.whisperDownloads.delete(n);
      }), t.json({
        success: !0,
        message: "Download started"
      });
    } catch (n) {
      console.error("Error starting whisper model download:", n), t.status(500).json({
        error: `Failed to start download: ${n instanceof Error ? n.message : String(n)}`
      });
    }
  }
  async performWhisperModelDownload(e, t, n, r) {
    const o = n + ".tmp";
    try {
      const s = await Ma(t, {
        signal: r,
        headers: {
          "User-Agent": "Alma-Desktop-App"
        }
      });
      if (!s.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${s.status}: ${s.statusText}`);
      const i = s.headers.get("content-length"),
        a = i ? parseInt(i, 10) : 0,
        c = this.whisperDownloads.get(e);
      c && (c.totalBytes = a);
      const l = _.createWriteStream(o),
        d = s.body?.getReader();
      if (!d) throw new Error("No response body");
      let u = 0,
        h = Date.now(),
        p = 0;
      const f = 500;
      for (;;) {
        const {
          done: t,
          value: n
        } = await d.read();
        if (t) break;
        if (r.aborted) throw d.cancel(), l.close(), _.existsSync(o) && _.unlinkSync(o), new Error("Download aborted");
        l.write(Buffer.from(n)), u += n.length;
        const s = this.whisperDownloads.get(e);
        if (s) {
          s.downloadedBytes = u, a > 0 && (s.progress = u / a * 100);
          const e = Date.now(),
            t = e - h;
          if (t >= f) {
            const n = u - p;
            s.speed = n / t * 1e3, h = e, p = u;
          }
        }
      }
      l.close(), await new Promise((e, t) => {
        l.on("close", e), l.on("error", t);
      }), _.renameSync(o, n), console.log(`Whisper model ${e} downloaded successfully to ${n}`);
    } catch (s) {
      throw _.existsSync(o) && _.unlinkSync(o), s;
    } finally {
      this.whisperDownloads.delete(e);
    }
  }

  async claimPlanApi(e, t) {
    this.handlePlanApi(e, t, e => function (e) {
      const t = LP(e),
        n = TP(e);
      OP(t, n);
      const r = RP(n);
      if (r) {
        const o = "feedback" === n.current?.kind && n.current.id === r.id;
        o || (n.current = {

        } = $P(t, r.sourceRef);

        };
      }
      if ("block" === n.current?.kind) {
        const r = n.current.id,
          {
            task: o,
            block: s
          } = $P(t, r);

          kind: "block",

        };

        const o = SP(i.id, r.id),
          s = CP(n, o);
        if ("ready" === s.status) return s.status = "in_progress", n.current = {
          kind: "block",
          id: o,

        }, _P(e, n), {
          kind: "block",
          ref: o,
          blockType: r.type,
          agent: r.agent ?? i.agent,
          packet: UP(e, t, n, i, r),
          alreadyClaimed: !1
        };
      }
      const o = MP(e);
      if (o.progress.done === o.progress.total) return {
        kind: "none",
        reason: "All blocks are done — the plan is complete. 🎉"
      };
      const s = o.tasks.flatMap(e => e.blocks.filter(e => "blocked" === e.status));
      return s.length > 0 ? {
        kind: "none",
        reason: `No claimable work. Blocked blocks: ${s.map(e => `${e.ref} (${e.blockedReason ?? "no reason"})`).join(", ")}. Unblock with: alma plan unblock <ref>`

      claimOwner: !0

                _depth: e.depth,
                _metadata: e.metadata,
                _createdAt: e.createdAt,
                _updatedAt: e.updatedAt
              }))
            };
          }),
          o = JSON.stringify(r, null, 2);
        console.log(`[Export] threads: ${r.length} items, ${o.length} bytes`), a.file("threads.json", o), c.includedData.push("threads");
      }
      if (i("promptApps")) {
        const e = wi.getAllPromptApps() || [],
          t = JSON.stringify(e, null, 2);
        console.log(`[Export] promptApps: ${e.length} items, ${t.length} bytes`), a.file("promptApps.json", t), c.includedData.push("promptApps");
      }
      if (i("prompts")) {
        const e = wi.getAllPrompts() || [],
          t = JSON.stringify(e, null, 2);
        console.log(`[Export] prompts: ${e.length} items, ${t.length} bytes`), a.file("prompts.json", t), c.includedData.push("prompts");
      }
      if (i("workspaces")) {
        const e = wi.getAllWorkspaces({
            includeHiddenTemporary: !0
          }) || [],
          t = JSON.stringify(e, null, 2);
        console.log(`[Export] workspaces: ${e.length} items, ${t.length} bytes`), a.file("workspaces.json", t), c.includedData.push("workspaces");
      }
      if (i("mcpServers")) {
        const e = (wi.getAllMCPServers() || []).map(e => ({
            ...e,
            config: e.config ? {
              ...e.config,
              env: void 0
            } : null
          })),
          t = JSON.stringify(e, null, 2);
        console.log(`[Export] mcpServers: ${e.length} items, ${t.length} bytes`), a.file("mcpServers.json", t), c.includedData.push("mcpServers");
      }
      if (i("customThemes")) {
        const e = wi.getAllCustomThemes() || [],
          t = JSON.stringify(e, null, 2);
        console.log(`[Export] customThemes: ${e.length} items, ${t.length} bytes`), a.file("customThemes.json", t), c.includedData.push("customThemes");
      }
      if (i("memories")) {
        let t = [];
        try {
          ri.isReady() && (t = (ri.getAllMemories({}) || []).map(e => ({
            id: e.id,
            content: e.content,
            metadata: e.metadata,
            threadId: e.threadId,
            messageId: e.messageId,
            createdAt: e.createdAt,
            updatedAt: e.updatedAt
          })));
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn("Could not export memories:", e);
        }
        const n = JSON.stringify(t, null, 2);
        console.log(`[Export] memories: ${t.length} items, ${n.length} bytes`), a.file("memories.json", n), c.includedData.push("memories");
      }
      if (i("settings")) {
        let t = {};
        const n = wi.getSettings();
        if (n?.settingsData) try {
          t = JSON.parse(n.settingsData);
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn("Could not parse settings:", e);
        }
        const r = JSON.stringify(t, null, 2);
        console.log(`[Export] settings: ${r.length} bytes`), a.file("settings.json", r), c.includedData.push("settings");
      }
      const l = JSON.stringify(c, null, 2);
      console.log(`[Export] manifest: ${l.length} bytes, included: ${c.includedData.join(", ")}`), a.file("manifest.json", l), console.log("[Export] Generating ZIP buffer...");
      const d = await a.generateAsync({
        type: "nodebuffer",
        compression: "DEFLATE",
        compressionOptions: {
          level: 9
        }
      });
      console.log(`[Export] ZIP generated: ${d.length} bytes`), n.setHeader("Content-Type", "application/zip"), n.setHeader("Content-Disposition", `attachment; filename="alma-backup-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.zip"`), n.setHeader("Content-Length", d.length), n.send(d), console.log("[Export] ZIP sent successfully");
    } catch (r) {
      console.error("Error exporting data:", r), n.headersSent || n.status(500).json({
        error: `Failed to export data: ${r instanceof Error ? r.message : String(r)}`
      });
    }
  }

  async getUsageStats(e, t) {
    try {
      const {
          period: n,
          startDate: r,
          endDate: o,
          providerId: s,
          modelId: i
        } = e.query,
        a = JSON.stringify({
          period: n,
          startDate: r,
          endDate: o,
          providerId: s,
          modelId: i
        });
      if (this.usageStatsCache && this.usageStatsCache.key === a && Date.now() - this.usageStatsCache.timestamp < BY.USAGE_STATS_CACHE_TTL) return t.json(this.usageStatsCache.data);
      let c = null,
        l = null;
      if (r && "string" == typeof r && (c = r), o && "string" == typeof o && (l = o), !c && n) {
        const e = new Date();
        switch (n) {
          case "day":
            c = new Date(e.getFullYear(), e.getMonth(), e.getDate()).toISOString();
            break;
          case "week":
            c = new Date(e.getTime() - 6048e5).toISOString();
            break;
          case "month":
            c = new Date(e.getFullYear(), e.getMonth(), 1).toISOString();
            break;
          case "year":
            c = new Date(e.getFullYear(), 0, 1).toISOString();
        }
      }

          fromDate: c,

        }) : wi.getUsageStatsAggregated({
          fromDate: c,
          toDate: l,
          providerId: "string" == typeof s ? s : null,
          modelId: "string" == typeof i ? i : null
        }),
        u = wi.getAllProviders(),
        h = new Map(u.map(e => [e.id, e])),
        p = Kf();
      p || Yf().catch(() => {});
      const f = new Map();
      if (p) for (const e of d.byModelAndDate) if (e.model && !f.has(e.model)) {

        } : c);
      }
      const m = e => {

              };
              e[a] > e[y[r].pricingStatus] && (y[r].pricingStatus = a);
            }
          } else y[r] = {
            providerId: r,

  async getUsageMigrationStatus(e, t) {
    try {
      const e = wi.getUsageMigrationStatus();
      if (!e) return void t.json({
        status: "pending",
        progress: 0,
        total: 0,
        percentage: 0
      });
      const n = (e.totalCount ?? 0) > 0 ? (e.migratedCount ?? 0) / (e.totalCount ?? 1) * 100 : 0;
      t.json({
        status: e.status,
        progress: e.migratedCount,
        total: e.totalCount,
        percentage: Math.round(10 * n) / 10,
        startedAt: e.startedAt,
        completedAt: e.completedAt,
        error: e.errorMessage
      });
    } catch (n) {
      console.error("Error getting usage migration status:", n), t.status(500).json({
        error: `Failed to get migration status: ${n instanceof Error ? n.message : String(n)}`
      });
    }
  }
  async startUsageMigration(e, t) {
    try {
      if (this.usageMigrationRunning) return void t.json({
        success: !0,
        message: "Migration already running"
      });
      this.runUsageMigration().catch(e => {
        console.error("Background migration failed:", e);
      }), t.json({
        success: !0,
        message: "Migration started"
      });
    } catch (n) {
      console.error("Error starting usage migration:", n), t.status(500).json({
        error: `Failed to start migration: ${n instanceof Error ? n.message : String(n)}`
      });
    }
  }
  async runUsageMigration() {
    if (!this.usageMigrationRunning) if (wi.isUsageMigrationComplete()) console.log("[UsageMigration] Already completed");else {
      this.usageMigrationRunning = !0;
      try {
        console.log("[UsageMigration] Starting background migration...");
        const e = wi.getMessagesWithUsageCount();
        if (wi.updateMigrationStatus({
          status: "running",
          totalCount: e,
          migratedCount: 0,
          startedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          errorMessage: null
        }), this.broadcastMigrationProgress(), 0 === e) return wi.updateMigrationStatus({
          status: "completed",
          completedAt: new Date().toISOString()
        }), this.broadcastMigrationProgress(), void console.log("[UsageMigration] No messages to migrate, marked as completed");
        const t = 500;
        let n = null,
          r = 0,
          o = !0;
        for (; o;) {
          const e = wi.getNextBatchToMigrate(n, t);
          0 !== e.length ? (wi.insertUsageRecordsBatch(e), n = e[e.length - 1].messageId, r += e.length, wi.updateMigrationStatus({
            migratedCount: r,
            lastMigratedId: n
          }), this.broadcastMigrationProgress(), await new Promise(e => setImmediate(e))) : o = !1;
        }
        wi.updateMigrationStatus({
          status: "completed",
          migratedCount: r,
          completedAt: new Date().toISOString()
        }), this.broadcastMigrationProgress(), this.usageStatsCache = null, console.log(`[UsageMigration] Completed. Migrated ${r} records.`);
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("[UsageMigration] Error during migration:", e), wi.updateMigrationStatus({
          status: "failed",
          errorMessage: e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Unknown error"
        }), this.broadcastMigrationProgress();
      } finally {
        this.usageMigrationRunning = !1;
      }
    }
  }
  broadcastMigrationProgress() {
    const e = wi.getUsageMigrationStatus();
    if (!e) return;
    const t = (e.totalCount ?? 0) > 0 ? (e.migratedCount ?? 0) / (e.totalCount ?? 1) * 100 : 0;
    this.broadcastThreadSync("usage_migration_progress", {
      status: e.status,
      progress: e.migratedCount,
      total: e.totalCount,
      percentage: Math.round(10 * t) / 10,
      startedAt: e.startedAt,
      completedAt: e.completedAt,

        height: n.height
      };
